kyoto_kokoro_standing_bar.gf_detail: Ask. Small plates that change monthly — sashimi, tamagoyaki, teppan egg, stuffed peppers with meat miso, a teppan hamburg, fried oysters, conger tempura; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kokoro_standing_bar.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-meat standing bar — sashimi, chicken, hamburg, oysters (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kokoro_standing_bar.hours_raw: Monday 15:00–23:00; Tuesday–Saturday 15:00–23:30; Sunday 13:00–22:00; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash or PayPay; no cards (Tabelog). A standing bar for about 40, with a large L-shaped counter and round tables (Tabelog; September 2026). Smoking outside the entrance (Tabelog). Down an alley across the Takase River from Kiyamachi, about 150 m from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Station (Tabelog; 2026).
kyoto_kokoro_standing_bar.notes: [Standing bar · Kawaramachi back alley, monthly small plates] A roomy, neon-lit standing bar down an alley off Kiyamachi, open from mid-afternoon: ¥480 draft beer and a monthly-changing list of more than fifty small plates — sashimi, peppers with meat miso, chicken-liver sashimi, a teppan egg you mix yourself. Cash or PayPay; no bookings.

chef_bio.background: Regulars praise food a level above a typical standing bar and a menu that changes every month (October and November 2026). A November 2026 reviewer calls it a sister shop of “Momiji”; reviewers describe a cheerful owner (October 2026) and four or five lively staff (August and September 2026).

anecdotes.text: A first-time solo visitor in August 2026 felt at ease among the regulars thanks to the cheerful staff, and resolved to return on every Kyoto trip.
An October 2026 visitor, whose usual standing bar was closed, ducked in out of the rain and stayed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ココロ、立ち飲み居酒屋・バー、下京区四条通小橋西入真町455-5 セザンヌビル1F、京都河原町駅から151m、月 15:00〜23:00、火〜土 15:00〜23:30、日 13:00〜22:00、予約不可、現金・PayPayのみ、40席、店外に灰皿。口コミ (2026年、英語): 立ち飲みとは思えない料理、毎月替わるメニュー、50品以上、生ビール480円、瓶ビール中580円、日本酒は1,000円以上が多い、肉味噌のせピーマン420円、鶏レバー刺し680円、日替わりソースの鉄板ハンバーグ580円、刺身、卵焼き、チーズと明太子の鉄板たまご、自家製タルタルのカキフライ、鱧の天ぷら、明るい店主、もみじの姉妹店 (2026年11月の口コミ)。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing bar; cash or PayPay; no bookings.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_hitokuchi_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto-vegetable izakaya dishes — meat-stuffed Kamo eggplant, nama-fu (wheat gluten) pizza, yuba, simmered dishes, meat sushi; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hitokuchi_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Seasonal Kyoto vegetables and yuba feature, but the signature dishes use meat, bacon and cheese, and nothing is described as vegan (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hitokuchi_kawaramachi.hours_raw: Sunday–Thursday and holidays 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); Friday, Saturday and the eve of holidays 17:00–2:00 (L.O. 1:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; at busy times seating may be limited to 2 hours, and from 27 December to 3 January to 90 minutes without free-flow drinks (Tabelog). Cards (Visa, Master, JCB) (Tabelog). 128 seats with private rooms (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; February 2026). On the 5th floor of a building above a club on Nishikiyamachi, a minute from Hankyu Kawaramachi exit 1A (Tabelog; 2024 and February 2026). Opened 20 July 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_hitokuchi_kawaramachi.notes: [Izakaya · Kawaramachi 5F, Kyoto vegetables for groups] A large upstairs izakaya a minute from Hankyu Kawaramachi, with private rooms and all-you-can-eat-and-drink plans from ¥2,400: Kyoto vegetables, a whole Kamo eggplant stuffed with minced meat, nama-fu pizza and yuba. Open late — until 2:00 on Fridays and Saturdays. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text pitches cheap all-you-can-eat-and-drink plans with private rooms for parties. Reviewers mention young, energetic staff (November 2025) and a slight smell of tobacco (February 2026).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner on the Kyoto cuisine course added meat sushi at ¥99 and called it a bargain.
A February 2025 guest chose it for the fully private rooms where smoking was allowed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 旬野菜×京居酒屋 ひとくち、居酒屋・日本料理・郷土料理、下京区西木屋町通四条上ル真町97 イマージアムビル5F、日〜木・祝 17:00〜24:00、金土・祝前日 17:00〜翌2:00、予約可 (混雑時は2時間制)、カード可、128席、個室あり、喫煙可、2021年7月20日オープン、140品以上の食べ飲み放題2,400円から。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 京野菜、賀茂なすの肉詰め、生麩のピザ、湯葉、京料理の飲み放題コース、肉寿司99円、抹茶ビール、若く元気な店員、たばこの匂い。

cultural_comfort.note: Group izakaya with private rooms; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_sendai_hanten_nakadachiuri.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: ramen, dan dan noodles, gyoza, breaded cutlets and fried chicken (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sendai_hanten_nakadachiuri.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat set meals, chashu ramen, egg soup (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sendai_hanten_nakadachiuri.hours_raw: Sun–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00; closed Saturday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). 20 seats (Tabelog). Menu on the wall; food comes fast (October 2025 and July 2025 reviews). Just east of Horikawa-Nakadachiuri, about 5 min from the bus stop (Tabelog; June and September 2026 reviews).
kyoto_sendai_hanten_nakadachiuri.notes: [Neighbourhood Chinese · Horikawa-Nakadachiuri] A family-run local Chinese shop serving big, cheap set meals to workers and students: "Chuben" bento sets, yakiniku and kara-age sets, dan dan noodles and ramen, mostly ¥750–1,000. No cards (QR yes); closed Saturday.

chef_bio.background: A family-run Chinese restaurant (February 2025 review). Two reviewers describe a lunch crowd of local workers and students (April 2025, June 2026).

anecdotes.text: On Kyoto Marathon day in February 2025, a walker cut off by road closures ordered wakame ramen and found it piled with vegetables like tanmen.
A November 2025 regular cycled old batteries to the junkyard across the road, then rewarded the effort with the ¥750 yakiniku set.
A June 2026 visitor sought out the ¥800 Chinese bento set, a style now rare.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 千代飯店、中華料理・ラーメン、上京区油小路通中立売上る油橋詰町89-9、日〜金 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜21:00、土曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、20席。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年9月、英語): 家族経営の町中華、Horikawa-Nakadachiuri のすぐ東、壁のメニュー、中華弁当 (チューベン) のセット800円 (唐揚げ、八宝菜、小鉢、漬物)、焼肉定食750円と卵スープ、ラーメンとカツとご飯のセット1,000円、唐揚げ定食、炒飯定食、担々麺のセット、水餃子と唐揚げの定食、冷やし中華のセット、野菜たっぷりのわかめラーメン、炒飯が焦げているという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Menu on the wall in Japanese.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_bisan_demachi.gf_detail: Ask. Falafel, hummus and stews, but sandwiches come in pita and desserts include a nut pie (2026 reviews).
kyoto_bisan_demachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; falafel, hummus and an okra-tomato stew sit beside chicken dishes and goat cheese (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_bisan_demachi.hours_raw: Mon, Wed and Thu 11:00–17:00; Fri–Sun 11:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; call for six or more (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 22 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). At the entrance of the Demachi Masugata shopping street, 5 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; March, June and September 2026 reviews).
kyoto_bisan_demachi.notes: [Palestinian · Demachi Masugata arcade] A rare Palestinian kitchen at the mouth of the Demachi arcade, the Kyoto branch of Bisan in Tokyo: falafel in pita, hummus, spinach-and-chicken sabaneh and okra stew, with sage tea or pomegranate juice. About ¥2,000–3,000. Dinner Friday to Sunday; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 29 November 2024 (Tabelog). A September 2026 reviewer heard the main shop is in Jujo, Tokyo — the Bisan there opened in January 2011 under owner-chef Sudqi Mansour (Arab News). Reviews differ on the Kyoto kitchen: "run by someone from Palestine" (April 2026) and "the Palestinian chef" (August 2026), but "the staff were Japanese" (June 2026).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor who had been reading about Palestine came here and was struck by the goat cheese, a warm dessert and sage tea.
On a value pair set in April 2026, a first-timer liked the falafel in pita and the okra and tomato stew, and planned to visit the Tokyo shop too.
A March 2026 fan of Middle Eastern food loved the flavours but found the portions small for the price.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Bisan 京都店、中東料理、上京区河原町通今出川上る青龍町234、出町柳駅から徒歩5分、月・水・木 11:00〜17:00、金〜日 11:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:30)、火曜休み、予約可 (6名以上は電話)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、22席、禁煙、子ども可、貸切20名まで、野菜にこだわる、ベジタリアンメニュー、2024年11月29日オープン。Arab News (英語): 東京・十条の Bisan、2011年1月開店、店主シェフ Sudqi Mansour。口コミ (2026年3〜9月、英語): 出町桝形商店街の入口、パレスチナ料理、ファラフェルをピタに、フムス、Sabaneh (ほうれん草と鶏)、オクラとトマトの煮込み、Fasoulia hamra、ナスとオクラの煮込み、ヤギのチーズ、ナッツのパイ、トルコ風アイス、ペアセット、コース、セージティー、ルイボスミントティー、ざくろジュース、本店は十条、料理人はパレスチナ出身とも日本人とも。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain how to eat the dishes.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_bisan_demachi.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260302/26042213/ (35.030252, 135.769627); GSI matched only the town 青龍町 (centroid 188 m north), so not lot-checked; the point fits the arcade entrance in the reviews; 2026-11-06

kyoto_gohandokoro_tanabeso.gf_detail: Ask. Pickles, rice and grilled fish, but miso, soy and nama-fu (wheat gluten) feature in the sets (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gohandokoro_tanabeso.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; pickle sets with tofu and miso could suit, but dashi is not described (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gohandokoro_tanabeso.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30); dinner 17:00–19:00 (last order 18:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Tabiiro (undated) gives 11:30–19:00, open daily. Bookings taken; private room for 8; lunch hire for 7+ (Tabelog). Check in at the first-floor pickle shop, then go up to the second-floor dining room (March 2026 review). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money (Tabelog). 46 seats incl. a 10-seat private room; sunken seating; non-smoking; kids' menu; 2 h parking tickets for 5 partner car parks (Tabelog). By the Aoi-bashi-nishizume bus stop, 5 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_gohandokoro_tanabeso.notes: [Pickle-house set meals · Demachi] The upstairs dining room of 田辺宗, a Kyoto pickle and miso maker founded in 1875, in a converted miso storehouse: Kyoto pickle sushi, long plates of house pickles with tofu and miso, and Saikyo-grilled fish with free rice refills. About ¥2,000–3,000. Pickles to buy downstairs. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Restaurant of the pickle and miso maker 田辺宗 (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Run directly by 田辺宗, a Kyoto pickle and miso house founded in 1875 (Meiji 8), in a renovated miso storehouse (Tabiiro). Formerly named 葵匠 (Tabelog). The pickle shop is on the first floor (2025–26 reviews).

anecdotes.text: Two friends in April 2026 just made the limited pickle-sushi and nama-fu gozen, bought pickles downstairs, then walked to Kawai and Shimogamo shrines under the Kamo River cherry blossoms.
In March 2026 the first taste of the Saikyo-grilled silver cod made a pair exchange surprised looks.
A late, unbooked traveller in September 2026 was seated at once for a Saikyo-yaki gozen of mackerel.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ごはん処 田辺宗 (旧店名 葵匠)、日本料理、上京区出町通桝形上ル青龍町218 2F、出町柳駅から徒歩5分、市バス Aoi-bashi-nishizume 前、昼 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)、夜 17:00〜19:00 (L.O. 18:00)、水曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー可、46席 (個室10席)、掘りごたつ、禁煙、お子様メニュー、提携駐車場5か所 (2時間券)、野菜・魚にこだわる、ベジタリアンメニュー。旅色: 明治8年創業の漬物と味噌の老舗「田辺宗」直営、味噌蔵を改装、名物「京漬物寿司」、漬物・味噌弁当、特選 田辺宗会席、11:30〜19:00、無休。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年9月、英語): 1階の漬物店で受付して2階へ、京漬物寿司と生麩の御膳、京漬物盛り合わせ御膳、銀だらや鯖の西京焼き御膳、朴葉焼きのイベリコ豚、白味噌の茶漬け、ご飯のおかわり、塩辛いという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Check in at the shop downstairs; table cards explain the dishes.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_menya_aito_imadegawa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: homemade wheat noodles; fried chicken (2026 reviews).
kyoto_menya_aito_imadegawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone and seafood broth, chashu, kara-age (2026 reviews).
kyoto_menya_aito_imadegawa.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 10:30–23:00; Sun 10:30–22:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). No bookings; ticket machine (Tabelog; June and October 2026 reviews). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 6 counter seats plus tables for 2, 4 and 6; non-smoking; no parking (Tabelog; October 2026 review). Free spicy bean sprouts to start; unlimited white rice with the sets (June 2026 reviews). A ramen shop that four 2026 reviewers describe as full of Doshisha University students. On Karasuma-dori, a minute from Imadegawa Stn (Tabelog; October 2026 review).
kyoto_menya_aito_imadegawa.notes: [Ramen · Imadegawa] A busy student ramen shop by Doshisha University: creamy pork-bone and seafood ramen on homemade noodles from ¥850, a clear-broth option, and a ramen, kara-age and bottomless-rice set for ¥1,250. Ticket machine; cash only; open till 23:00; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 13 December 2017 (Tabelog). The shop calls itself "98号店"; no other 愛都 shop was found.

anecdotes.text: Working late in June 2026, a regular stranded for dinner pressed the button for the creamy tonkotsu broth and called the shop a rescue.
A June 2026 diner arriving at 22:00 had ramen, kara-age and two bowls of free rice.
A Doshisha regular between classes in June 2026 liked the free spicy bean sprouts as a palate cleanser.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都ラーメン 麺屋愛都 98号店 (今出川店)、ラーメン、上京区御所八幡町115-13、今出川駅から17m、火〜土 10:30〜23:00、日 10:30〜22:00、月曜休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙、2017年12月13日オープン。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): Karasuma 通沿い、券売機、自家製の中太ストレート麺、クリーミーな豚骨と魚介のスープ、愛都ラーメン850円、愛都味玉ラーメン970円、チャーシュー麺1,150円、清湯のラーメン、ラーメンとご飯と唐揚げ2個のセット1,250円、ご飯おかわり自由、無料の辛いもやし、カウンター6席とテーブル、駐車場なし、Doshisha 大学の学生が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kissa_mahayana_teramachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: toast-based morning sets and cinnamon toast (2023 reviews).
kyoto_kissa_mahayana_teramachi.vegan_detail: Ask: siphon coffee and fresh fruit juices are plant-based; milk drinks and toast are not (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kissa_mahayana_teramachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: 8:30–18:00; closed Wednesday. No reservations. About 10 seats around a U-shaped counter (May and August 2025). Smoking allowed at every seat — cigarettes and e-cigarettes, but no cigars, pipes or kretek (August 2025; April 2026). No cards (Tabelog). On Teramachi just south of Shijo, by a Takashimaya entrance (2016 review).
kyoto_kissa_mahayana_teramachi.notes: [Kissa · Teramachi-Shijo, siphon coffee among the regulars] A white-tiled, glass-fronted coffee counter just south of Shijo on Teramachi, around for about 40 years: siphon coffee, fresh banana or mixed juice, thick cinnamon toast and morning sets, with regulars greeted by name. Smoking allowed at every seat (no cigars or pipes). Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2016 to 2026 describe a small café with a white tiled front and black-framed glass windows, a U-shaped counter of about ten seats, the same regulars every morning, a skilled, friendly owner who chats with guests — in English with visitors (May 2025) — and a nostalgic feel; a May 2026 reviewer puts its age at about 40 years.

anecdotes.text: May 2016: "Every morning, the same customers greet each other at the same time and place the same order to start their day."
April 2026: "Smoking is allowed, but I noticed a sign stating, 'No cigars, pipes, or Garam!'"
May 2025: the owner "was actively engaging with customers in English… the regulars were greeted with 'Take care' as they left."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: マハヤーナ (MAHAYANA)、喫茶店、下京区寺町通四条下ル貞安前之町619、京都河原町駅から170m、8:30〜18:00、水曜休み、予約不可、喫煙可、カード不可。口コミ (2006年2月〜2026年5月、英語): 白いタイルの外観と黒い木枠のガラス窓、寺町の高島屋の入口の角、U字のカウンター約10席、全席喫煙可 (葉巻・パイプ・ガラムは不可)、サイフォンのブレンド、アイスカフェラテ550円、バナナジュース600円、マスターのミックスジュース、厚切りのシナモントースト、モーニング、毎朝同じ常連、英語でも話す店主、約40年続く店。

cultural_comfort.note: Owner chats in English; smoking at every seat.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_rahoban_maratan_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a peanut-cream mala broth with wheat dumplings, buns, fried dough and noodles; the free corn noodles are a separate choice (2026 reviews).
kyoto_rahoban_maratan_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Ask: you pick your own vegetables, tofu and noodles, but the broth is not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_rahoban_maratan_kawaramachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–21:30, open through New Year. No reservations — call to ask how busy it is; queues of up to 30 minutes in the evening (May 2026), benches downstairs. Pick ingredients from a self-service display and pay by weight; corn noodles free on orders over ¥1,000; aprons and one free ice cream (2026 reviews). Spice levels from 0.5 to 4, non-spicy soups for children, a dry mala xiang guo option, a sauce bar. Non-smoking; children welcome. Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money, QR (incl. Alipay). Basement of the Ishizumi Building. Opened 12 December 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_rahoban_maratan_kawaramachi.notes: [Malatang · Kawaramachi, Korean-style mala by weight] A bright basement malatang shop near Kawaramachi, opened December 2025: fill a bowl from the self-service display, pay by weight, and pick a heat from 0.5 to 4 in a mild peanut-cream broth, with free corn noodles over ¥1,000 and cute panda buns. Two reviewers say it is popular with women (May, July 2026). Queues at dinner; some found the broth sweet and peanutty (April 2026).

chef_bio.background: Opened 12 December 2025 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a Korean-influenced, clean and spacious room with friendly staff, a sauce bar, and a sister shop in Osaka that one diner had tried first (May 2026). The operator and full number of shops were not found.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "the soup had a strong peanut flavor, and the sweetness was quite pronounced."
May 2026: "I had to go out of my way to get a ladle since they didn't provide one, though! Haha."
May 2026: "I arrived around 7 PM and had to wait about 30 minutes in line."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラホンバン マーラータン 京都河原町店、中華料理、中京区下大阪町349-6 イシズミビル B1F、京都河原町駅から177m、毎日 11:00〜21:30、年末年始も営業、予約不可 (混雑は電話で)、禁煙、子供可 (辛くないスープあり)、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2025年12月12日オープン。口コミ (2026年4〜7月、英語): 韓国風のマーラータン、具材を自分で選び重さで会計、1,000円以上でとうもろこし麺が無料、エプロン、アイス1つ無料、辛さ0.5〜4、ピーナッツのクリーミーなスープ、汁なしの麻辣香鍋、パンダや豚の形の饅頭や餅、カスタードやあんこの揚げ饅頭、ラム肉、炒飯、唐揚げ、タレのバー、大阪にも店、夜は30分待ち、女性客が多いという声が2件、ピーナッツが強く甘いという声、お玉がなかったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-service by weight; choose a spice level.

kyoto_tonkatsu_kinton_pontocho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breaded tonkatsu, minced cutlets and fried shrimp (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tonkatsu_kinton_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork cutlets and fried shrimp (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tonkatsu_kinton_pontocho.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–21:00; closed Tuesday and some Wednesdays (open when a holiday falls on a closing day); open at New Year (January 2026). Reservations taken. 20 seats (three tables for 4, four for 2). Non-smoking. Menus in English, Chinese and Korean, with photos; children, babies and strollers welcome. Cards (incl. UnionPay), transit IC and e-money, QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay). Just inside Pontocho, 2 min from Kawaramachi and Gion-Shijo. Opened 29 August 2025 (Tabelog), in the former premises of a tonkatsu shop (January 2026 review).
kyoto_tonkatsu_kinton_pontocho.notes: [Tonkatsu · Pontocho, a Kobe top-100 shop's Kyoto branch] The Kyoto branch, opened August 2025 at the south end of Pontocho, of a Kobe tonkatsu shop on Tabelog's top-100 list: pink-centred loin and Chateaubriand cutlets with rock salt or Nagasaki soy, minced cutlets, big fried shrimp, refillable rice and miso, and katsu chazuke to finish. Some found prices a bit high (January 2026) and the chazuke broth light (February 2026). Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 29 August 2025 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2025–2026 say the main shop is in Sannomiya, Kobe, and is listed among Tabelog's top 100 tonkatsu restaurants; a Kobe Sannomiya とんかつ きんとん is also listed online. A January 2026 reviewer notes it took over and renovated the premises of a former tonkatsu shop.

anecdotes.text: January 2026: "The prices are a bit high, but the meat was delicious, and the rice and miso soup, which you can refill, were also very tasty."
February 2026: "The tea-flavored broth for the ochazuke might be a bit on the lighter side."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: とんかつ きんとん 京都店、中京区柏屋町169-4、阪急京都河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩2分、11:30〜14:30・17:30〜21:00、火曜休み (水曜は不定)、祝日は営業、予約可、20席、禁煙、英語・中国語・韓国語の写真付きメニュー、子供・赤ちゃん・ベビーカー可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2025年8月29日オープン。神戸三宮のとんかつ きんとん (ネットの掲載)。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 本店は三宮で食べログのとんかつ百名店、シャトーブリアン2,800円、手ごね メンチカツ定食1,200円、上ロースカツ定食2,000円、定食2,100円ほど、ヒレ・大海老フライ・野菜メンチの贅沢三種、ゴールデンセット、ご飯・味噌汁・キャベツ・サラダはおかわり自由、岩塩・わさび・長崎の甘い醤油・ソース、締めのかつ茶漬け、先斗町の入口、以前のとんかつ店の跡を改装、値段が少し高いという声、茶漬けの出汁が薄いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in English, Chinese and Korean with photos.

kyoto_sosaku_ryori_soju_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pizza, oyster tempura, mapo tofu, shrimp mayonnaise and soy-based dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sosaku_ryori_soju_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, chicken liver, wagyu and seafood dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sosaku_ryori_soju_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Thu 18:00–24:00; Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays 18:00–1:00 (last food order 24:00); Wednesday open only if booked by 17:00 that day; days off on the online booking calendar. Lunch by reservation only (since April 2025). Dinner is hard to book (April 2025) and fills at opening (May 2025). 22 seats: counter, tatami and tables; private room up to 20. Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards, transit IC and e-money, QR. 1F of the Iyasaka Building on Kiyamachi north of Shijo. Opened 1 April 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sosaku_ryori_soju_kiyamachi.notes: [Creative izakaya · Kiyamachi, a hard-to-book local favourite] A dim, relaxed creative izakaya on Kiyamachi that fills at opening: sashimi and carpaccio, yuzu-pepper mapo tofu, oyster tempura, wagyu steak, pizza and an unexpected kamaboko-and-caramel ice cream, with a reservation-only lunch. One diner found it ordinary and the service very slow (February 2026). Smoking allowed. Open till midnight or 1:00.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 April 2020 (Tabelog). Reviewers from 2024 to 2026 describe a calm, dimly lit room on lively Kiyamachi with counter, tatami and table seats, attentive staff, a menu that changes with each visit, and dinner that is hard to book; lunch by reservation began in April 2025.

anecdotes.text: February 2026: "No plans to return. The food was at an izakaya level… the sashimi was on the smaller side. Above all, the service was way too slow."
December 2024: "I tried the freshly made kamaboko (steam-cooked fish cake) caramel ice cream for the first time."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 創作料理 壮樹、創作料理・居酒屋・海鮮、中京区四条木屋町上ル鍋屋町217 弥栄ビル 1F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩5分、月〜木 18:00〜24:00・金日祝 18:00〜翌1:00・土 18:00〜翌1:00 (料理 L.O. 24:00)、昼は予約のみ、水曜は17時までに予約がなければ休み、休みはネット予約のカレンダーで、22席、個室 (20名まで)、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2020年4月1日オープン。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年5月、英語): 刺身の盛り合わせ (本鮪、鯛)、鮮魚のカルパッチョ、たこのおろしポン酢、鶏レバー刺し、鶏のたたき、柚子胡椒の麻婆豆腐、大海老のマヨネーズ、牡蠣の天ぷら、黒毛和牛のステーキ、ピザ、シーザーサラダ、できたてかまぼことキャラメルアイス、チーズケーキ、予約制のランチ (特製海鮮丼、黒毛和牛ステーキ、2025年4月から)、夜は予約が取りにくい、居酒屋レベルで提供が遅いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; smoking allowed.

kyoto_shokudo_marushin.gf_detail: Ask. Three set meals — young-chicken kara-age, ginger pork and sweet-savoury beef belly — with sides, miso soup and rice; no gluten information is published (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shokudo_marushin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every main is chicken, pork or beef (reviews).
kyoto_shokudo_marushin.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00, dinner 18:00–20:00, Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). The same three sets at dinner (October 2026). Bookings accepted (Tabelog); fills up soon after 11:30 and dishes are cooked to order, so it can be slow when busy (February and July 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats: a 5-seat counter and three tables; wooden interior; non-smoking (Tabelog; January 2026). On Higashi-oji just north of Higashiyama-Marutamachi, near Kyoto University Hospital and Kumano Shrine; 579 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; June 2026).
kyoto_shokudo_marushin.notes: [Set-meal diner · Higashiyama-Marutamachi by Kyoto University Hospital] A small, wooden, privately run diner with just three choices — crisp young-chicken kara-age, ginger pork, or sweet-savoury beef belly with onions — each with two homemade sides, miso soup and piping-hot rice for about ¥1,200–1,300. Everything is cooked to order, so come early: it fills soon after 11:30. Same menu at night. Cash only; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 6 February 2019 (Tabelog). A small, privately owned diner, unrelated to the well-known マルシン飯店 (April 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 pair waited five minutes outside, and the staff moved a counter seat so the two could sit together.
A July 2026 regular came back for the beef-belly set and blew on the piping-hot rice.
A February 2026 visitor at 11:30 sharp watched the place fill before the food arrived.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂マルシン、食堂、左京区聖護院山王町11-1、京阪神宮丸太町駅4番出口から徒歩9分 (579m)、月〜土 11:30〜14:00・18:00〜20:00、日曜定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、15席 (カウンター5、4人掛け2、2人掛け1)、禁煙、2019年2月6日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 若鶏の唐揚げ、豚の生姜焼き、牛バラ焼きの3種の定食、小鉢2品 (大根の煮物、白胡麻豆腐のサラダ、ポテトサラダ、キャベツのサラダ)、味噌汁、ご飯、昼1,200円、唐揚げ大盛り1,350円、夜の生姜焼き定食1,300円、ご飯大盛り+50円、おかわり50〜150円、注文後に調理、11時半すぎに満席、木の内装、京大病院と熊野神社の近く、有名なマルシン飯店とは無関係。

cultural_comfort.note: Three set meals; cash only.

kyoto_jijibaba_dos.gf_detail: Ask. Small plates — prosciutto, mapo tofu, tacos, Napolitan spaghetti, fried gizzards, beef-tripe stew — with no gluten information published (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_jijibaba_dos.vegan_detail: Not vegan: ham, meat and fish plates (reviews).
kyoto_jijibaba_dos.hours_raw: 18:30–1:00 Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings by phone. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Otoshi ¥500 (June 2024). 8 counter seats only (Tabelog; reviews mention about ten); smoking allowed (Tabelog). In the Rido dining alley (リド飲食街) off Shichijo-Karasuma, two doors from the original じじばば, 438 m from Kyoto Station (Tabelog; May 2024).
kyoto_jijibaba_dos.notes: [Counter bar · Rido dining alley by Kyoto Station, じじばば's second shop] A tiny, smoky eight-seat counter in the retro Rido alley, two doors from the original じじばば and often where its overflow lands. Eclectic small plates — serrano ham, mapo tofu, tacos, Napolitan — with good sake and wine, about ¥3,000–5,000. Opens 18:30 till 1:00. Cash only; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner not named; じじばば group
chef_bio.background: The second shop of the izakaya じじばば, two doors from the original in the Rido dining alley (January and May 2024 reviews). Group shops in data: kyoto_sakenoateya_jijibaba, kyoto_jijibaba_mokubatei, kyoto_jijibaba_daisan_sakaba.
chef_bio.specialty: Small plates with sake and wine.

anecdotes.text: A May 2024 guest turned away from a full じじばば walked two doors down and found it was じじばば too.
A July 2024 visitor found the owner’s Kuraki Mai playing and ordered tacos with a Sapporo Sorachi.
A March 2025 diner watched the ¥1,000 Napolitan vanish between drinks.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: じじばばDOS、ダイニングバー・バル・ワインバー、下京区東境町180、京都駅から徒歩10分 (438m)、月〜土 18:30〜翌1:00、日祝定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、カウンター8席、喫煙可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): リド飲食街、じじばばの2号店、本店の2軒隣、お通し500円、生ハム (ハモンセラーノ) 1,000円、麻婆豆腐780円、たこぶつ650円、ナポリタン1,000円、タコス、アホアリエロ、キウイのカプレーゼ、豚バラの味噌漬け焼き、鯛の昆布締め、砂肝の唐揚げ、もつ煮、鯉の唐揚げ、ブルーチーズのポテトサラダ、伊根満開、神亀、サッポロ ソラチ。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny smoking counter; cash only.

kyoto_restaurant_kiev.gf_detail: Ask. Pirozhki, borscht, beef stroganoff, cabbage rolls, mushroom stews, pilaf and bakes; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_restaurant_kiev.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat-based borscht, stroganoff, cabbage rolls and cream stews (reviews).
kyoto_restaurant_kiev.hours_raw: Weekdays 12:00–15:30 (last food order 14:30) and 17:00–21:00 (last food order 20:00); weekends and holidays 12:00–21:00; closures on a calendar; year-end closure 30 December–2 January (Tabelog). Rooftop beer garden 14 May–30 September, its terrace the only smoking area (Tabelog). Bookings online; 9 or more by phone; ask for a window table (Tabelog; August 2026). No service charge (Tabelog original text: なし). Cards, transport IC and PayPay (Tabelog). 80 seats, private rooms for 6–20, live stage; English menu and English-speaking staff; wheelchair accessible; children welcome with a kids’ menu (Tabelog). On the 6th floor of the Kamoto Building on Nawate just north of Shijo, overlooking the Kamo, 1 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_restaurant_kiev.notes: [Ukrainian–Russian · Gion-Shijo above the Kamo, since 1972] A long-loved sixth-floor dining room at Gion-Shijo with big windows over the Kamo River and Kyoto Tower, serving borscht, crisp pirozhki, cabbage rolls and beef stroganoff. Weekday lunch sets run about ¥1,650–1,900; in summer the rooftop becomes a beer garden. Book and ask for a window table.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s introduction: open since 1972, serving traditional Ukrainian, Georgian and Russian dishes with views of Kyoto through large windows; private rooms and a live stage. The official site describes it as loved in Gion-Shijo for over 50 years. An October 2026 reviewer understood it to be linked to Sungari, a Russian restaurant with two branches in Shinjuku, Tokyo.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 couple shared lunches A and B — borscht, freshly fried pirozhki, cabbage rolls and a mushroom cream stew — and advised asking for a window table.
An October 2026 solo diner before a Danjuro show was given a table turned towards the river.
A September 2026 visitor had a second helping of pirozhki while thinking of far-off Russia and Ukraine.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都・祇園四条で50年以上愛される、ロシア・ウクライナ・ジョージア料理のレストラン。食べログ: ロシア料理・洋食・ビアガーデン、東山区廿一軒町236 縄手通四条上ル 鴨東ビル6F、祇園四条駅7・8番出口から徒歩1分、平日12:00〜15:30・17:00〜21:00、土日祝12:00〜21:00、休業日はカレンダー、年末年始12月30日〜1月2日、9名以上は電話予約、サービス料なし、カード・交通系IC・PayPay可、80席、個室 (6〜12名、12〜20名)、ライブステージ、禁煙 (ビアガーデンのテラスは喫煙可)、英語メニュー・英語を話すスタッフ、車椅子可、子どもメニュー、1972年創業、大きな窓から京都の景色、屋上ビアガーデン (5月14日〜9月30日)、オンラインショップ。口コミ (2026年、英語): 平日のAランチ1,650円、Bランチ (ロールキャベツ) 1,880円、ピロシキ、ボルシチ、キャベツのサラダ、ロシアンティー、休日のコース3,000〜4,000円、きのこ料理 (griby)、ビーフストロガノフ、ピラフ、窓際の席、鴨川と京都タワーの眺め、ビアガーデンの飲み放題にクラフトビール、新宿の Sungari と系列という口コミ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing with online booking; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_obuya_kyoto_station.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi chazuke — rice with bonito-and-kombu dashi — topped with seafood, some dishes soy- or butter-soy-seasoned, with arare crackers among the condiments; Tabelog notes allergy information is available (official site; Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_obuya_kyoto_station.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bonito-and-kombu dashi and bonito, tuna and mackerel flakes on every bowl (official site).
kyoto_obuya_kyoto_station.hours_raw: 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:15); closing days irregular, following JR Kyoto Isetan (official site; Tabelog). No reservations — take a numbered ticket and pay first; waits of 20–50 minutes at peak are common, the wait can be tracked by QR code (2026 reviews). Cards, ICOCA, WeChat Pay and Alipay; no QR codes (Tabelog). 27 seats at counters and tables; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). In Eat Paradise in front of the JR west exit gate, JR Kyoto Isetan restaurant floor, 60 m from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; official site).
kyoto_obuya_kyoto_station.notes: [Dashi chazuke · Kyoto Station west gate] A calm counter steps from the JR west gate pouring house bonito-and-kombu dashi over kombu-cooked rice and fishmonger-chosen toppings — sea bream with sesame, salmon four ways, a nine-seafood luxury bowl with urchin (¥880–1,990). Eat it plain, then with condiments and the house bonito flakes. Expect a queue at mealtimes; ticket first, pay first. Open 11:00–22:00.

roles: Operator not named; toppings chosen by a fishmonger founded over 90 years ago (official site)
chef_bio.background: Opened 31 August 2022 (Tabelog), described as Japanese fast food with a calm air (Tabelog introduction). Per the official site: rice from a Kyoto rice wholesaler of nearly 100 years, cooked with kombu as "obu-zuke mai"; a light homemade bonito-and-kombu dashi; a house blend of thinly shaved bonito, tuna and mackerel flakes; a second shop at Shijo-Karasuma opened and then closed on 15 March 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: enjoy the dashi and toppings plain first, then add condiments, then the house flakes for a richer bowl.
chef_bio.specialty: Sea bream with sesame sauce chazuke.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner came after a gyoza festival for something light and found about 20 groups already waiting.
An October 2026 visitor waited about 50 minutes at lunch but could track the queue by QR code.
A September 2026 guest with an upset stomach chose the saikyo-grilled fish and takana chazuke.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-obuya.jp): 京だし茶漬け専門店「京都おぶや」、すべてのだし茶漬けに「おぶや特製 けずり節」と「漬物」付き、おぶやの贅沢茶漬け1,990円 (9種の海の幸と雲丹)、昆布と梅880円、帆立と明太子のバター醤油1,300円、鮭尽くし1,300円、漬鮪と葱とろろ1,200円、鯛と胡麻だれ1,400円、京都牛と九条ネギ1,800円 (亀岡牛)、西京焼き茶漬け1,800円、京都で100年近い米問屋の国産米を昆布と炊いた「おぶ漬け米」、鰹と昆布の自家製だし、鰹節・鮪節・さば節の特製けずり節、創業90余年の魚屋が選んだ具材、京都駅店は11:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:15)、不定休、席の予約不可、四条烏丸店は2026年3月15日で営業終了、冬季限定「カップdeおだし」。食べログ: お茶漬け・日本料理、ジェイアール京都伊勢丹 レストラン街 JR西口改札前イートパラダイス、京都駅から60m、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、27席、禁煙、アレルギー表示あり、2022年8月31日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 発券機で番号札、先払い、20〜50分待ち、QRで待ち状況、ご飯は小・中・大、あられ・胡麻・わさびの薬味。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine and pay-first counter; queue at mealtimes.

existence.note: Official site with 2026 notices; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_card_pasta_nishikiyamachi.gf_detail: Not GF: a spaghetti house; sets come with bread (2026 reviews).
kyoto_card_pasta_nishikiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream, carbonara, seafood and bacon sauces dominate; a tomato sauce and a mushroom special exist but no ingredient information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_card_pasta_nishikiyamachi.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday–Sunday 11:00–15:00 (lunch service until 14:00) and 18:00–21:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No table reservations; parties can be booked (Tabelog). One order per person (March 2026). Cash only — no cards (Tabelog). No charge (Tabelog original なし). 25 seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Queues at weekday and weekend lunch (March and June 2026). Dim, retro interior; the toilet at the back looks onto the river (July 2026). Down a narrow alley off Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Shijo, east of Hankyu; 2 min walk from Shijo Kawaramachi (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_card_pasta_nishikiyamachi.notes: [Pasta · Nishi-Kiyamachi, a retro alley spaghetti house] A dim, antique-filled pasta house down a narrow alley by the Takase River, serving a huge menu of spaghetti — the scallop, bacon and spinach cream is the signature — with value lunch and dinner sets. Expect a queue at lunch. One August 2026 guest found the pasta ordinary and the service unfriendly. Cash only; smoking allowed; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a pasta and dining bar of 25 seats taking party bookings. A March 2026 reviewer gives 1988 as its founding year; reviewers describe freshly boiled pasta, an extensive menu and a retro, dim interior.
chef_bio.specialty: Scallop, bacon and spinach cream spaghetti.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor added cut baguette to scoop up the plentiful white sauce of the scallop and spinach cream.
An August 2026 diner whose Genovese was sold out read the menu five times, then ordered the first item on the first page — tomato spaghetti.
An August 2026 guest found the oil and carbonara pastas ordinary, the room too dark and an older staff member off-putting.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パスタ・ダイニングバー、下京区西木屋町通四条下ル阪急百貨店東入ル、四条河原町から徒歩2分、月火木〜日 11:00〜15:00 (サービスランチは14:00まで)、18:00〜21:00、水曜休み、予約不可 (宴会は予約可)、カード不可、チャージなし、25席、喫煙可。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 1988年創業、路地の奥、レトロで薄暗い店内、奥のトイレから川が見える、1人1オーダー、昼は行列、ソースとトッピングを選ぶ、ホタテとほうれん草のクリーム1,450円、エビのトマト1,250円、モッツァレラ300円、カルボナーラ、あさりとベーコンとほうれん草のクリーム、明太子納豆、たらことイカ、ジェノベーゼ、きのこ、サラダ・パン・ドリンク付きのセット、普通・暗い・店員の態度がよくないとの声 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; one order each; smoking allowed; many dishes are named only by ingredients.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_ginza_music_bar_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists gluten-free options; the menu also has brioche burgers, lasagna, tacos and fugu fish and chips (Tabelog; February 2026).
kyoto_ginza_music_bar_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options; most signature dishes are wagyu, eel or fish (Tabelog; February 2026).
kyoto_ginza_music_bar_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Monday 17:00–1:00; Tuesday–Sunday and holidays 12:00–1:00; last orders food 24:00, drinks 0:30 (Tabelog). Pia (August 2025 opening) gave 12:00–24:00 with Monday closed — Tabelog is newer. Reservations accepted; the 6-seat THE OMAKASE sushi counter is reservation-only (Tabelog; Pia). No charge (Tabelog original チャージ料なし). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 45 seats: 11 at the counter, 34 at tables; up to 50 standing; non-smoking (Tabelog). 2F of the Murakamiju building on Nishi-Kiyamachi south of Shijo — cross the little bridge, go through the cafe and take the lift (Tabelog; February 2026). Loud music, especially at the counter and at night (March and May 2026).
kyoto_ginza_music_bar_kiyamachi.notes: [Music bar · Nishi-Kiyamachi, records and cocktails] The Kyoto sister of Ginza's listening bar: vintage turntables and custom speakers loud enough to make the music the main event, with cocktails, wagyu tacos and a brioche wagyu burger — and, behind it, a six-seat omakase sushi counter by reservation. Quieter by day. Several reviewers note many overseas guests and find it pricey for the portions. Till 1 a.m.

roles: Sushi chef of THE OMAKASE (unnamed; trained at a Michelin three-star restaurant, per Pia)
chef_bio.background: Per Pia: GINZA MUSIC BAR was born in Ginza in 2014, created by Shinichi Osawa and the producer of the brand COFFEE; its first official second shop, GINZA MUSIC BAR KYOTO, opened at Shijo-Kiyamachi in August 2025, with original speakers of its own acoustic design, vintage turntables and amplifiers, and a reservation-only 6-seat sushi counter, THE OMAKASE, run by a craftsman trained at a Michelin three-star restaurant (ミシュラン三つ星店で修行した職人).
chef_bio.philosophy: Food, drink and music for all five senses (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu tacos; THE OMAKASE sushi counter.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 father and daughter found the fish and chips made with fugu, and the room turned to Sonny Clark's "Cool Struttin'" once a large table left.
A March 2026 counter guest could barely hold a conversation over the volume, and the gin and tonic arrived watery and flat.
Several reviewers note that many of the guests are from overseas (February–May 2026).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー、下京区西木屋町四条下ル船頭町194 村上重ビル 2F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、京都河原町駅から徒歩2〜3分、月 17:00〜翌1:00、火〜日・祝 12:00〜翌1:00 (L.O.フード24:00、ドリンク0:30)、予約可、チャージ料なし、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、45席 (カウンター11、テーブル34)、立食50名、禁煙、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリーの選択肢あり、おすすめは鰻サンド、和牛タコス、但馬牛のラザニア。ぴあ: 2014年に大沢伸一と「COFFEE」プロデューサー・鳥羽伸博が銀座に開いた GINZA MUSIC BAR の初のオフィシャル2号店として2025年8月に四条木屋町にオープン、オリジナルスピーカーとヴィンテージのターンテーブルとアンプ、ミシュラン三つ星店で修行した職人の完全予約制6席の寿司カウンター「THE OMAKASE」。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月、英語): 入口がわかりにくい、小さな橋を渡りカフェからエレベーター、音量が大きく会話しにくい、量のわりに高い、和牛バーガー、ツナとアボカドのタコス、和牛ステーキ、ふぐのフィッシュアンドチップス、バスクチーズケーキ、Monkey 47、昼は静か、Toriba Coffee のポップアップ (2026年10月)、外国人客が多いとの声が複数。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests (several 2026 reviews); loud music at night; no cover charge; cards and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and Pia opening article; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_soul_food_mookie.gf_detail: Not GF: sandwiches, tacos, fried chicken, onion rings, nachos and fries (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_soul_food_mookie.vegan_detail: Ask. Avocado tacos and an acai bowl are on the menu, but no ingredient information; most dishes are chicken, pork or cheese (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_soul_food_mookie.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday and the day before a holiday 17:30–3:00 (last order 2:00); Sunday 17:30–1:00 (last order 24:00); holidays 17:30–3:00; open all year (Tabelog). Reviews from 2023–2024 describe lunch service too. Reservations accepted; private hire for 10 or more (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 20 table seats, up to 40 standing; smoking allowed except at lunch (Tabelog). Order at the counter first (September 2023). Events and parties held often (October 2026). 1F of the Shikisai Kawaramachi building by the Takase River; 3 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_soul_food_mookie.notes: [American diner · Kawaramachi by the Takase River, till 3 a.m.] A laid-back American diner-bar with original art and films on screen: chicken over rice, pulled pork, tacos by the piece, cheesy onion rings and banana splits, plus plenty of beer — a late second or third stop. Several reviewers note many overseas guests. Some found the service muddled. Smoking allowed at night.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an American-culture restaurant near the Takase River serving soul-food classics such as pulled pork sandwiches and chicken over rice, with acai bowls and banana splits, open for private bookings. Reviewers in 2023–2026 describe original art, foreign films on screen, events and a stall at outside events.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic American flavours, careful preparation of the meat (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 pair received one shared portion of fries without explanation, and a machine coffee arrived instead of the drip coffee ordered.
A regular of four visits recommends it as a late second or third stop and enjoys the events and parties (October 2026).
Several reviewers note many overseas guests (February 2024–April 2025).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・ハンバーガー・アメリカ料理、下京区稲荷町330-3 しきさい河原町ビル 1F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、月〜土・祝前日 17:30〜翌3:00 (L.O.2:00)、日 17:30〜翌1:00 (L.O.24:00)、祝日 17:30〜翌3:00、年中無休、予約可、10名以上で貸切可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、テーブル20席、立食40名、喫煙可 (ランチのみ禁煙)、アメリカ文化の店、プルドポークのサンド、チキンオーバーライス、アサイーボウル、バナナスプリット。口コミ (2023年9月〜2026年11月、英語): 先にカウンターで注文、オリジナルアート、洋画の上映、チキンとポークのコンボとポテト1,280円、タコライス、ステーキサンド、フライドチキン、マカロニチーズ、タコス (チキン、ポーク、アボカド)、チーズのオニオンリング、ナチョス、ピクルス、ビールが豊富、イベントやパーティー、外国人客が多いとの声が複数、店員の対応がまごついたとの声 (2024年3月、2026年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests (several reviews); order at the counter; smoking allowed at night; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through November 2026.

kyoto_maruman_sushi_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. Nigiri with soy sauce and sweet eel sauce, kizushi, red miso soup; no gluten information (2020–2026 reviews).
kyoto_maruman_sushi_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi counter (2020–2026 reviews).
kyoto_maruman_sushi_shijo.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00; enter by about 23:00; open all year; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — queues at busy times (Tabelog; January 2025). Cash only: no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). On Shijo-dori west of Kobashi, near Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; June 2023).
kyoto_maruman_sushi_shijo.notes: [Sushi · Shijo-Kiyamachi, a couple's counter] A cosy evening sushi counter run by an older couple near Kawaramachi, known for generous, thick-cut toppings — fatty toro, hamachi and soft anago — and reasonable prices. Several reviewers note the counter is now mostly overseas guests; book ahead. One 2022 guest found the sushi ordinary but fair for the price. Cash only; till midnight.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews (2022–2026): a small sushi shop run by an elderly couple near Shijo Kawaramachi, with large, thick-cut toppings; open evenings to midnight (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A January 2022 bar-hopper found the sushi not extraordinary but was satisfied for the price, and warmed by the couple behind the counter.
A July 2026 regular starts with kizushi and bottled beer, then nigiri with hot sake.
Several reviewers note the counter is now mostly overseas guests and advise booking (January 2025–October 2026).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、下京区四条通小橋上西入、毎日 17:00〜24:00 (23時ごろまでに入店)、年中無休、営業時間は変わることあり、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、20席、禁煙。口コミ (2020年1月〜2026年10月、英語): 年配のご夫婦の店、大きく厚いネタ、手ごろな値段、特上盛り合わせ8貫3,100円 (2020年5月)、とろ、はまち、うなぎ、雲丹、まぐろ、穴子、きずし、じゅんさいの赤だし、外国人客が多いとの声が複数、予約がおすすめ、すしは普通だが値段を考えると満足との声 (2022年1月)、吸い物や味噌汁ができなかったとの声 (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Mostly overseas guests (several reviews); cash only; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_ajimian_yoshida.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon, tempura and kakiage (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_ajimian_yoshida.vegan_detail: Not vegan: udon in dashi broth, shrimp tempura, chicken kara-age (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_ajimian_yoshida.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30; closed Sunday, holidays and the second Wednesday of the month; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; queues at lunchtime in term (Tabelog; October 2023, February 2024). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 18 seats: tables for 2 and 4 plus a raised tatami table at the back (Tabelog; May 2023). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On the diagonal Shiga-goe road by the Kyoto University medical campus, about 9 min from Jingu-Marutamachi (Tabelog; November 2023). Opened 2 December 2012 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ajimian_yoshida.notes: [Udon · Yoshida, a student-priced Sanuki udon shop] A small udon shop in a converted house by the Kyoto University medical campus, making its own Sanuki-style noodles: one or two servings for the same price, set meals named after Kyoto places, curry udon and a gentle, sweet-soy dashi. Under ¥1,000 for most sets. Cash only; lunch Monday to Saturday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an udon shop with homemade noodles, opened in December 2012. A May 2023 review describes a friendly older man boiling the noodles; reviews from 2023 to 2026 describe a lunchtime crowd of Kyoto University students and staff.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 regular on a sixth visit found it quiet during the Kyoto University entrance exams and tried the tempura with grated daikon in the hot broth.
An October 2024 couple returning after eight years found prices a little higher but still good value.
A December 2024 diner finished the Saga no curry udon by pouring the leftover curry over the rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: うどん、左京区吉田橘町33-14、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩約9分、月〜土11:30〜14:30、日祝と第2水曜休み、予約不可、現金のみ、18席 (テーブルと奥の座敷)、禁煙、2012年12月2日オープン、自家製麺。口コミ (2023年4月〜2026年2月、英語): 讃岐風、1玉・1.5玉・2玉同じ値段、京都の地名のセット (Shimizu 970円、Oohara 830円、Kibune 850円、Gion 890円、Saga no 980円)、釜揚げ580円、おろしぶっかけ510円、カレーうどん830円、すりごまと天かす、京大の学生や教職員で混む、値上げ対策のキャンペーン (2026年1月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Photo menu on the table (November 2023); say hot or cold and the size — big portions cost the same. Cash only. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through February 2026.

kyoto_goma_umekoji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat ramen and mazesoba noodles in a soy-based tare (2026 reviews).
kyoto_goma_umekoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood (mackerel) shoyu broth, chashu, egg, katsuobushi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_goma_umekoji.hours_raw: Daily: morning ramen 7:00–11:15 (last order 11:00), mazesoba lunch 11:30–14:30; closes early when noodles run out; irregular closures posted on Instagram (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「支払いは現金のみ」). Order on a slip at the seat (March and June 2026). 26 seats: two rows of counter on the earthen floor, plus a tatami room with a counter and tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Mibugawa-dori, 7 min from Umekoji-Kyotonishi; a short walk from Kyoto Aquarium (Tabelog; February and August 2026). Opened 21 November 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_goma_umekoji.notes: [Ramen · Umekoji, morning ramen in an old townhouse] A new ramen shop in a renovated townhouse near Kyoto Aquarium, opening at 7:00 with a light mackerel-based shoyu ramen for ¥540 — pick mackerel, chicken or chili oil — then switching to a rich sesame mazesoba at lunch. Cash only; order on a slip; closes when the noodles run out.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a ramen shop opened in November 2025 serving morning ramen and lunchtime mazesoba, in a renovated townhouse with a tatami room. Reviews in March and May 2026 describe one person running it; an August 2026 review mentions more staff.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 early riser found it newly opened with an introductory discount and has been back several times for a large bowl with egg and chashu.
A February 2026 visitor to Kyoto Aquarium discovered mazesoba here and finished it with rice, as the shop recommends.
A May 2026 diner read a book while the single cook worked through orders, and found the ¥540 bowl a full, authentic shoyu ramen.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラーメン・油そば・まぜそば、下京区西酢屋町3、梅小路京都西駅から徒歩7分、毎日、朝ラーメン7:00〜11:15 (L.O. 11:00)、まぜそば11:30〜14:30、麺がなくなり次第終了、不定休はインスタグラムで、支払いは現金のみ、26席 (土間のカウンターと座敷)、禁煙、2025年11月21日オープン。口コミ (2026年2月〜8月、英語): 古民家、魚介の琥珀醤油ラーメン540円、鯖の油・鶏油・自家製ラー油から選ぶ、半熟卵100円、チャーシューや Kujo のねぎの増量、おかか丼 (小) 300円、ごまのまぜそばに締めのご飯、注文は伝票に書く。

cultural_comfort.note: Menu on the walls; write the order on the slip and hand it over; cash only. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_kinse_ryokan_cafe.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bagel-sandwich café (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_kinse_ryokan_cafe.vegan_detail: Ask. A June 2025 review says vegan options are available and soy milk can be chosen for café au lait; other bagels use bacon or cream cheese (2024–25 reviews).
kyoto_kinse_ryokan_cafe.hours_raw: Mon–Wed, Fri and Sat 7:00–13:00; closed Thursday and Sunday; changes and temporary closures posted on Instagram (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 18 seats: sofas, a large shared table and a counter of 5 (Tabelog). Non-smoking inside (Tabelog). Through the old Shimabara gate, under 10 min from JR Tanbaguchi (Tabelog; official site). The upstairs guest suite takes one group at a time (official site).
kyoto_kinse_ryokan_cafe.notes: [Café · Shimabara, breakfast in a former ageya] A morning café on the ground floor of a building that served as an ageya — a house where geisha entertained at banquets — and then as a ryokan until the early 1990s, with Taisho-era stained glass, high ceilings and a patchwork floor. Crisp warm bagel sandwiches and café au lait from 7:00. Closed Thursday and Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the building was first an ageya where geisha entertained at dinner parties and banquets, then a ryokan until the early 1990s; it reopened in 2012 with Cafe AUSGANG on the main floor and a private guest suite upstairs, and also hosts ikebana workshops and live music. Tabelog lists 20 December 2009 as the opening day.

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 visitor said "wow" three times on walking in under the stained glass and high ceiling.
A May 2024 visitor recognised the room from a favourite photo book and met the house cats.
An October 2025 early visitor waited a little because one person was working alone, and found the room hushed around the big shared table.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (英語): 島原の大門の先、揚屋として芸妓が宴席でもてなした建物、その後1990年代初めまで旅館、2012年にカフェ (Cafe AUSGANG) と2階の一組限定の客室で再開、生け花のワークショップやライブも。食べログ: カフェ・バー・ケーキ、下京区西新屋敷太夫町80、JR丹波口駅から徒歩10分以内、月火水金土7:00〜13:00、木日休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、18席、店内禁煙、オープン日2009年12月20日。口コミ (2024年2月〜2026年9月、英語): 大正ロマンのステンドグラス、高い天井、ベーグルサンド1,200円、カフェオレ700円、Kujo のねぎのクリームチーズとマリネのきのこのベーグル800円、豆乳のカフェオレ、猫、映画のロケ地。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site is in English and invites English enquiries; keep voices low at the shared table.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_lisei_demachiyanagi.gf_detail: Ask. Korean cold noodles, kimbap, rice-cake soup, soy-milk noodles and rice cakes (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_lisei_demachiyanagi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the café serves traditional teas and a mugwort rice cake (March 2026); the cold noodles come with chashu and egg (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_lisei_demachiyanagi.hours_raw: Wed–Sat 11:00–16:00 (last order 15:30); closed Sunday to Tuesday and over summer, winter and New Year breaks (Tabelog). Tabelog says no reservations, but a June 2026 visitor booked through Instagram. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; February 2026). 15 seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking; a note on each table asks for quiet voices (Tabelog; February 2026). Two parking spaces (Tabelog). In the residential streets near Demachiyanagi (official site). Concerts and a gallery, Gallery Sumomo (official site).
kyoto_lisei_demachiyanagi.notes: [Korean tearoom · Demachiyanagi, Joseon antiques and cold noodles] A quiet 15-seat tearoom filled with Korean antique furniture and crafts, serving traditional teas, a jujube latte and rice cakes, plus a much-praised bowl of Korean cold noodles and a Friday-only kimbap lunch. Featured on TV by the actor 松重豊 (June 2026 review). Cash only; Wednesday to Saturday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 李朝喫茶 李青, a small tearoom in a residential street near Demachiyanagi, showing Korean furniture and crafts and hoping guests will experience the culture of a neighbour with deep ties to Kyoto; it also runs a gallery and holds concerts. A June 2026 review says the actor 松重豊 introduced it on television the previous winter.
chef_bio.philosophy: To let guests taste, with all five senses, the culture of a neighbouring country closely tied to Kyoto (official site).

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 visitor waited for warm weather to try the cold noodles seen on TV, booked through Instagram, and rated these the best cold noodles ever.
A February 2026 visitor found a note on each table asking for quiet voices, and other guests reading books.
A November 2025 visitor chose the Korean rice-cake soup on a cold day and found it gentle and full of ingredients.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 李朝喫茶 李青 (リセイ)、出町柳近くの住宅地の小さな喫茶店、韓国・朝鮮の家具や工芸品、オリジナルブレンド珈琲、伝統茶、デザート、軽食、ギャラリーすもも、イベント (2026年11月29日に箏とフルートの二重奏)。食べログ: カフェ、上京区梶井町448-16、水〜土11:00〜16:00 (L.O. 15:30)、日月火と夏冬の休み、予約不可、現金のみ、15席、禁煙、韓国冷麺、トック (秋冬)、豆乳麺 (春夏)、金曜限定のキンパのセット。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年8月、英語): 冷麺1,400円、韓国の雑煮1,400円、なつめ茶800円、豆乳ラテ900円、よもぎと小豆の餅600円、カルビサラダ、テレビで松重豊が紹介。

cultural_comfort.note: A quiet room: keep voices low; cash only; come Friday for kimbap. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Official site (event notice dated 6 October 2026) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_sanga_ono_jokyoji.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese set meals — sashimi, tempura, grilled fish, unaju, tai chazuke, chirashi — with soy-based seasoning; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sanga_ono_jokyoji.vegan_detail: Ask. A “Jokyoji veggie burger” with chickpea tomato sauce is one lunch main (December 2025, February 2026), and there is a salad buffet, but the miso soup is made with sake lees and dashi is not described.
kyoto_sanga_ono_jokyoji.hours_raw: Breakfast 6:30–11:00 (L.O. 10:30); lunch 11:30–15:30 (L.O. 14:30); dinner 17:00–21:30 (L.O. 20:30); open year-round (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private rooms (Tabelog; April 2026). Cards, iD and QUICPay (Tabelog). 70 seats (Tabelog; Mitsui Fudosan release). On the 2nd floor of Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Kawaramachi Jokyoji, built together with Jokyoji temple; a minute from exit 10 of Hankyu Kyoto-Kawaramachi Station (Tabelog). Opened 28 September 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sanga_ono_jokyoji.notes: [Japanese · Mitsui Garden Hotel Jokyoji, half-buffet lunch] A calm, roomy restaurant on the second floor of the temple hotel off Teramachi: a generous lunch of two to five mains — sashimi, tempura, grilled fish — with a buffet of hagama rice, chirashi and salad from ¥2,800, unaju and tai chazuke, and kaiseki with private rooms at night. Open from breakfast.

chef_bio.background: A Mitsui Fudosan release (2020) says the restaurant was opened by ONO GROUP, which runs several food businesses in Fukuoka, as the second shop of the Michelin-listed 僧伽小野 一秀庵 in Itoshima and its first outside Fukuoka. Tabelog’s name search also lists a Kyoto Shinmachi Bettei.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 visitor returns every January for lunch, and this time chose three mains — one too many.
An April 2026 diner booked a business kaiseki and was glad the staff plated each course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 三井不動産のリリース (2020年): 三井ガーデンホテル京都河原町浄教寺の2階、福岡県内で飲食事業を展開するONO GROUPの僧伽小野 一秀庵の2号店で県外初出店、日本料理、70席。食べログ: 日本料理、下京区寺町通四条下る貞安前之町620、阪急京都河原町駅10番出口から徒歩1分、朝食6:30〜11:00、昼11:30〜15:30、夜17:00〜21:30、年中無休、予約可、カード可、70席、2020年9月28日オープン、鯛茶漬け御膳2,780円、鰻重3,980円。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 20種ほどから主菜を2〜5品選ぶ昼のハーフビュッフェ (羽釜ご飯、ばらちらし、サラダ、酒粕の味噌汁、コーヒー)、主菜2品で2,800円、刺身8種、浄教寺ベジバーガー、サーモン、穴子の卵とじ、個室での会席。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; easy to get in at lunch.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_garage19_sausage.gf_detail: Ask. Homemade sausages and meat dishes with craft beer; no gluten information (Tabelog).
kyoto_garage19_sausage.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sausage and meat bar (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_garage19_sausage.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday and holidays 18:00–2:00 (L.O. food 1:00, drinks 1:30); closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Otoshi charge ¥330 including tax (Tabelog, original お突き出し料として330円(税込み)). Cards, IC cards and e-money (Tabelog). 15 seats: 7 at the counter, 8 at tables (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (September 2026). On the 2nd floor of the Kawaramachi Apex Building 2, about 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Station (Tabelog). Opened 6 September 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_garage19_sausage.notes: [Sausage bar · Kawaramachi 2F, craft beer late] A small garage-style bar a few minutes from Hankyu Kawaramachi, making its own sausages with Miyama ingredients and pouring craft beer and craft shochu until 2:00. ¥330 otoshi; smoking allowed; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes homemade sausages and dishes using ingredients rooted in Miyama, Kyoto, in a room modelled on an old country garage. A September 2026 reviewer says the same people run a craft-beer shop in Pontocho.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 reviewer praised the shochu range and the occasional fish dish alongside the sausages.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ソーセージ酒場 Garage19、ビアバー・肉料理、下京区市之町240-1 河原町アペックスビル2 2F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩5分、火〜日・祝 18:00〜翌2:00 (L.O.料理1:00、ドリンク1:30)、月曜定休、予約可、お突き出し料330円 (税込)、カード・電子マネー可、15席 (カウンター7、テーブル8)、2024年9月6日オープン、自家製ソーセージ、クラフトビールとクラフト焼酎、京都の Miyama にゆかりの食材、古い田舎のガレージ風の店内。口コミ (2026年9月、英語): 焼酎の種類が多い、先斗町でクラフトビールの店も営む、ときどき魚料理、喫煙可。

cultural_comfort.note: Small late-night bar; ¥330 otoshi; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; one review, September 2026.

kyoto_chiritori_nabe_isono.gf_detail: Ask. Chiritori hot pot of Wagyu offal and vegetables in a sweet-spicy sauce, finished with noodles or rice; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_chiritori_nabe_isono.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Wagyu-offal hot pot restaurant (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_chiritori_nabe_isono.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); Sunday and holidays 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Monday (Tabelog; September 2026). Reservations accepted; a table booking may be moved to the counter when busy (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original なし — the English translation is wrong). Cards including UnionPay; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 27 seats: a U-shaped counter of 19 around an open kitchen and two tables (Tabelog; 2026). No takeaway (September 2026). Two minutes from Hankyu Kyoto-Kawaramachi Station, on the Jukkencho-bashi street just west of the Takase River (Tabelog; 2026). Opened 20 June 2025 (September 2026 review).
kyoto_chiritori_nabe_isono.notes: [Chiritori hot pot · Kawaramachi by the Takase River, Wagyu offal] A lively counter around an open kitchen two minutes from Hankyu Kawaramachi, where staff cook Osaka-style chiritori hot pots of Wagyu offal and vegetables in a sweet-spicy sauce (¥2,780 a person), finished with noodles. Open since June 2025; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T3130001055762 is registered to 株式会社８８, Kyoto (NTA register). A September 2026 reviewer lists two sister shops in Kawaramachi, Taishu Sakaba Momiji and Marufuku. Reviewers note the manager grilling the steak at the counter (October 2026).

anecdotes.text: A first-time pair in September 2026 skipped the meat version and found the offal-only hot pot plenty, then added ramen.
An October 2026 regular came back a year after a first chiritori nabe here, hooked on the broth.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ちりとり鍋 いその、焼肉・ホルモン・鍋、中京区紙屋町369-1、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩2分、火〜土 17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、日・祝 17:00〜23:00、月曜定休、予約可、サービス料なし、カード可、27席 (カウンター19、テーブル2)、全国から選んだ和牛ホルモンのちりとり鍋、適格請求書 T3130001055762 (株式会社８８)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 2025年6月20日オープン、上ホルモン鍋1人2,780円 (2人前から)、締めの麺やラーメン、焼き飯、期間限定で熊本のA5サーロインのステーキ付き、和牛ロースの炙りユッケ、刺身、クリームチーズキムチ、チーズリゾット、店員が鍋を作ってくれる、姉妹店は Taishu Sakaba Momiji と Marufuku。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter hot pot; staff cook for you.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_sumibi_kotepan.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal yakitori with a house tare, chicken wings, fried drumsticks and karaage; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sumibi_kotepan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori restaurant (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_sumibi_kotepan.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; a 2-hour limit may apply (Tabelog; July 2025). Cards (Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). 32 seats over two floors, counter and tables; groups up to 18 (Tabelog; 2025–2026). Self-ordering from your seat (Tabelog). Down a back alley, two minutes from Hankyu Kyoto-Kawaramachi Station (Tabelog; June 2026). Opened 3 March 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sumibi_kotepan.notes: [Yakitori · Kawaramachi back alley, charcoal and Fushimi chicken] A two-storey townhouse yakitori bar down an alley by Hankyu Kawaramachi, grilling Fushimi chicken over charcoal with a house tare — wings and fried drumsticks are favourites — with a long drink list and self-ordering. Open every evening until midnight.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes chicken from Fushimi, Kyoto, grilled over high-quality charcoal with a homemade sauce, in a Kyoto townhouse. A December 2025 reviewer calls it the second branch of a main shop.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 group of eight with children found a same-day table upstairs, with karaage and fries for the kids.
A September 2026 wing enthusiast came back for the charcoal tebasaki and fried drumsticks.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 炭火焼 こてっぱん、焼き鳥・居酒屋・鶏料理、中京区河原町通四条上ル紙屋町367-1、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩2分、毎日17:00〜24:00、予約可、カード・QR決済可、32席、18名まで、セルフオーダー、2024年3月3日オープン、京都伏見の鶏を備長炭で焼き自家製の秘伝のたれ、京町家。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): もも、つくね、にんにく、ししとう、揚げなすのたれ、手羽先、手羽元の唐揚げ、唐揚げ、フライドポテト、ポテトサラダ、親子丼、日本酒、2時間制、2階席、本店の2号店 (2025年12月の口コミ)。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-ordering; 2-hour limit when busy.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_sumi_no_shougeki_daichan.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in a soy-based broth (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sumi_no_shougeki_daichan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken broth and charcoal-grilled pork chashu (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sumi_no_shougeki_daichan.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:00; closing days may vary (Tabelog). No bookings; ticket machine (Tabelog; May 2025 review). Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「無し」 (none). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 7 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Students get a free extra serving of noodles with ID (March 2025 review). 3 min from Imadegawa Stn and the Kamigyo-ku Sogochosha-mae bus stop (Tabelog).
kyoto_sumi_no_shougeki_daichan.notes: [Charcoal chashu ramen · Imadegawa] A seven-seat lunch-only counter serving sweet-leaning chicken soy ramen on flat noodles in a square bowl, crowned with petals of smoky charcoal-grilled chashu (¥1,100), plus mazesoba and torched butter rice. Ticket machine; cash only; 11:30–15:00.

chef_bio.background: Opened 14 September 2020 (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner put the charcoal chashu ramen in a personal top five and paired it with the grilled butter rice.
A March 2026 diner had long passed the shop over because of its quirky name, then found the sweet soy broth and charcoal aroma delicious.
A July 2026 first-timer thought the regular ramen too sweet at first, then found it addictive.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 炭の衝撃 麺屋 大ちゃん、ラーメン、上京区築山南半町234、今出川駅から徒歩約3分、Kamigyo-ku Sogochosha-mae バス停から徒歩約3分、毎日 11:30〜15:00、不定休、予約不可、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター7席、禁煙、2020年9月14日オープン。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年7月、英語): 券売機、四角い器、花びらのように並ぶ炭火焼きのレアチャーシュー、鶏の醤油スープは甘め、平打ち麺、炭火焼きチャーシュー麺1,100円、替え玉100円、つけ麺、鶏油のまぜそば、バーナーで炙るバターライス、チャーシュー丼、学生証で麺の大盛り無料。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticket machine; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_tosei_an_nishijin.gf_detail: Ask. Tofu and yuba dishes, but with red miso soup, soy-based broths, fried tofu and optional tempura (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_tosei_an_nishijin.vegan_detail: Ask. Tofu-centred sets include sashimi, and the dashi is not described (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_tosei_an_nishijin.hours_raw: Tue, Wed and Fri–Sun lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and dinner 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:00); closed Monday and Thursday, holidays included (official site; Tabelog). Bookings taken and advised — about 10 counter seats only (Tabelog; November 2024 review). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Rice refills free (July 2026 review). Coin parking to the north (July 2026 review). About 2 min from the Omiya-Nakadachiuri bus stop and 3 min from Ichijo-Modoribashi/Seimei-jinja-mae, about 10 min on foot from Seimei Shrine (Tabelog; January 2026 review).
kyoto_tosei_an_nishijin.notes: [Tofu & yuba · Nishijin] A small counter of tofu and yuba near Seimei Shrine, family-run with a warm welcome: the ¥1,600 Take gozen of yudofu or cold tofu with tofu salad, kinuage and yuba stew, fresh yuba at dinner, and the owner's homemade fruit liqueurs. Book ahead; no cards (QR yes). Closed Monday and Thursday.

roles: Owner, a head chef and a young chef (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: A family-run tofu restaurant (May 2024 review); a July 2026 diner was welcomed by the head chef and a young chef. The official site says each guest is served individually, hence counter seats only, and offered a yuba-scooping experience for groups of two or more by booking (ended 1 November).
chef_bio.philosophy: Tofu and yuba made for the natural sweetness of living soybeans (official site).

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 regular chose summer-orange liqueur and two kinds of umeshu — white-liquor and brandy — from the owner's homemade fruit liqueurs.
After visiting Seimei Shrine in January 2026, a diner walked about 10 minutes for the nearest tofu lunch and watched the thick fried tofu finished at the counter.
A July 2026 diner was lucky to find the yuba rice bowl newly available as a ¥700 upgrade.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 豆生庵 (とうせいあん)、西陣の豆腐料理・湯葉料理専門店、生きた大豆の自然な甘み、一人ひとりに出すためカウンターのみ、昼 11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)、夜 17:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:00)、月・木曜休み (祝日も)、勝手豆腐、生湯葉、豆腐よう、湯葉すくい体験 (2名から要予約、11月1日で終了)。食べログ: 上京区大宮通一条下ル下石橋南半町50、市バス Omiya-Nakadachiuri から徒歩2分、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、カウンター10席、禁煙。口コミ (2024年5月〜2026年10月、英語): 家族経営、Take 御膳1,600円 (湯豆腐か冷奴、豆腐サラダ、刺身、絹揚げ、湯葉の煮物、赤だし、ご飯、漬物)、Matsu・Ume 御膳、湯葉丼 +700円、目の前で仕上げる厚揚げ、昼だけの豆腐アイス100円、夜は3,600円の献立と生湯葉、店主の自家製果実酒と梅酒、ご飯のおかわり無料。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; staff help choose a set.

kyoto_beer_pasta_scherzo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fresh wheat pasta is the house specialty (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_beer_pasta_scherzo.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and an egg-free pasta is offered, but most sauces have cream, cheese, meat or seafood (Tabelog; January 2026 review).
kyoto_beer_pasta_scherzo.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:00–22:00; Sun and holidays 11:00–15:00 (course dinners after 17:00 by booking — see the official calendar); open year-round (Tabelog). Bookings taken; since April 2026 dinner bookings by phone only (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「チャージ料なし」 (no charge). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 23 seats (counter 3, tables 20), a private room for 4, hire for 15–26; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Busy with Doshisha University students at lunch, especially right after second period (12:15) (May 2025, January 2026 reviews). On Karasuma-dori, 3 min north of Imadegawa Stn exit 1 (Tabelog; April 2025 review).
kyoto_beer_pasta_scherzo.notes: [Fresh pasta & craft beer · Imadegawa] An independent pasta shop north of Doshisha, packed with students at lunch: pick from about 20 sauces and six chewy fresh pastas, with lunch sets from ¥1,000 and evening plates around ¥1,300–1,400 alongside good draft beer. No cover charge.

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 October 2017 (Tabelog). The shop describes itself on Tabelog as an independent store, not a franchise, able to arrange plans on request.
chef_bio.philosophy: Craft beer and chewy fresh pasta (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular tried the Sicilian white beans with tuna and a Neapolitan chicken and chickpea stew, and called the stuffed-pasta carbonara a rare find.
A January 2026 diner chose the egg-free pasta with tomato sauce, then decided the draft beer was even better than the pasta.
An August 2026 traveller at a late Obon lunch tasted shrimp tomato cream, Bolognese and carbonara and vowed to return.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): Beer&Pasta スケルツォ、パスタ、上京区相国寺門前町643-1、今出川駅1番出口から北へ徒歩3分、月〜土 11:00〜22:00、日祝 11:00〜15:00 (17時以降は予約のコースのみ)、無休、予約可 (2026年4月から夜は電話のみ)、チャージ料なし、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、23席 (カウンター3、テーブル20)、4名の個室、貸切15〜26名、禁煙、車椅子可、Wi-Fi、ベジタリアンメニュー、2017年10月10日オープン、クラフトビールともちもちの生パスタ、19種のソースと6種の麺、フランチャイズではない個人店。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年11月、英語): ランチセット1,000円から、B セット1,200円、パスタの追加600円、タコとアンチョビのオイル1,400円、海老のトマトクリーム1,300円、生ハムのイタリアンサラダ900円、カルボナーラ、ボロネーゼ、アラビアータ、柚子クリーム、わさびクリーム、ホタルイカとブロッコリー、インゲンと海老のジェノベーゼ、詰め物のパスタ、キタッラ、卵を使わない麺、シチリア風白いんげんとツナ、ナポリ風の鶏とひよこ豆の煮込み、唐揚げ、生ビール、昼は同志社の学生で混む。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose a sauce and a pasta shape.

kyoto_senbon_curry_imadegawa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thick roux curry with breaded cutlets and fried toppings (2026 reviews).
kyoto_senbon_curry_imadegawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat-based curry sauce, cutlets, chicken nanban and beef tendon (2026 reviews).
kyoto_senbon_curry_imadegawa.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Fri 11:00–14:00 and 18:00–21:00; closed Tuesday, Saturday and Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). No bookings (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 15 counter seats; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; bicycle parking (Tabelog). Rice from small to large — the M size is about two portions (March and July 2026 reviews). Fukujinzuke and shibazuke on the counter (September 2026 review). Popular with students from the university next door, several 2026 reviewers note. On Shinmachi-Kamidachiuri, 5 min from Imadegawa Stn (Tabelog; April 2026 review).
kyoto_senbon_curry_imadegawa.notes: [Student curry counter · Imadegawa] A weekday curry counter by the university with thick, dark, homestyle curry and cutlets fried to order — pork cutlet, roast cutlet, chicken nanban — for about ¥850–1,000, with big rice portions. Open Mon and Wed–Fri only.

chef_bio.background: Opened 5 January 2010 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken nanban curry; pork cutlet curry.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 regular finally tried the limited grilled beef rice, stir-fried in the back kitchen, and sent compliments to the owner.
A March 2026 diner had chicken nanban curry with beef tendon and rated it above certain chain shops.
On 22 April 2026 a lunch diner got thick, black chicken katsu curry within five minutes and was reminded of Kanazawa curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: センボンカリー、カレー・食堂、上京区裏風呂町369、今出川駅から徒歩5分、月・水〜金 11:00〜14:00・18:00〜21:00、火・土・日休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、カウンター15席、禁煙、子ども可、駐輪場、2010年1月5日オープン。口コミ (2026年3〜9月、英語): Shinmachi-Kamidachiuri、木の皿にキャベツの千切り、濃く黒いカレー (Kanazawa カレーのよう)、豚カツカレー850円、ロースカツカレー950円、チキン南蛮カレー、チキンカツ、辛口カツカレー約1,000円、ビーフカレー、野菜カレー、牛すじのトッピング、限定の焼肉ライス、注文ごとに揚げるカツ、M サイズはご飯2杯分、福神漬と柴漬け、学生が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter; choose rice size and spice level.

kyoto_balmil_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tacos made with a soy-sauce-based sauce (Tabelog; September 2026); tortilla type not stated.
kyoto_balmil_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Mexican set menus and tacos with meat (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_balmil_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–23:00 (last food order 22:00). Reservations taken. No service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「なし」 (the English page says 10% is added). 18 seats: a 10-seat counter and two barrel tables for 4. Non-smoking until 21:00, smoking allowed after (Tabelog). English picture menu; the master speaks fluent English (June 2026). Cards and QR (PayPay and others); no e-money. 2F of the Yoshiki Building on Kiyamachi north of Shijo. Opened 23 March 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_balmil_kiyamachi.notes: [Mexican bar · Kiyamachi, tacos and 300 cocktails] A small second-floor Mexican bar off Kiyamachi with barrel tables and a long counter: soy-sauce-tinged tacos and a set menu, and a calm, English-speaking master who mixes from over 300 cocktails, including rarities. Friendly to solo diners. Smoking only after 21:00. Open nightly.

roles: Master, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Opened 23 March 2023 (Tabelog). Per its Tabelog text, the aim is to share Mexican food with tacos adapted to Japanese tastes, with an adult bar counter and barrel tables evoking a pirate tavern. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a calm, reassuring master who speaks fluent English, friendly staff, and a guest seen off from the second floor and met again at the ground floor (October 2025).

anecdotes.text: October 2025: "I was surprised to be seen off at the second floor elevator, only to find someone waiting for me on the first floor! Haha."
September 2026: "I was thrilled to find a liqueur from Godiva that's already discontinued!"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: BALMIL、メキシコ料理・タコス・バル、中京区木屋町通四条上る鍋屋町214 ヨシキビル 2F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、毎日 17:00〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:00)、予約可、原文でサービス料「なし」、18席 (カウンター10、4名のテーブル2)、21時までは禁煙・以降は喫煙可、英語の写真メニュー、カード・QR可、電子マネー不可、2023年3月23日オープン、醤油ベースの日本人向けのタコス、おすすめをまとめたセット、ノンアルを含む300種以上のカクテル、樽のテーブルで海賊の酒場の雰囲気。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年9月、英語): 料理とショットバーを一度に、日本人好みの料理と新鮮な野菜、好みに合わせたカクテル、BALMILセットとビール、2階と1階で見送り、英語が堪能で落ち着いたマスター、終売のゴディバのリキュール、醤油ベースのタコス。

cultural_comfort.note: English picture menu; the master speaks fluent English.

kyoto_hoheto_sukiyaki_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Kansai-style sukiyaki with zarame sugar and a soy-based dipping sauce (2026 reviews).
kyoto_hoheto_sukiyaki_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: black-wagyu sukiyaki with egg (2026 reviews).
kyoto_hoheto_sukiyaki_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–22:00 (last entry 20:00, last order 21:30); reservation only. 70 seats in private rooms for 2 to 30; groups over 50. Tabelog lists smoking as allowed. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX), e-money and QR. No sign outside — hard to find (July 2026); 4F of the Sakizo Building, 1 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi exit 1A. Opened 10 March 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_hoheto_sukiyaki_kiyamachi.notes: [Sukiyaki · Kawaramachi, all-you-can-eat black wagyu] A hidden fourth-floor sukiyaki room by Hankyu Kawaramachi offering all-you-can-eat black wagyu, Kansai style with zarame sugar, with unlimited Koshihikari rice and vegetables, on a long-running ¥5,500 promotion (list ¥7,700). Private rooms; reservation only. One diner could hear the staff chatting loudly and found no sign outside (July 2026).

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 March 2025 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a calm, traditional-style room behind an unmarked entrance, staff who cook the first slice at the table, and a wagyu-heavy course that one diner found slowing as the fat built up (April 2026).

anecdotes.text: July 2026: "the restaurant was hard to find as there were no signs. The staff was polite… but I could hear their loud conversations."
April 2026: "the richness of the fat can slow you down as you go along."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ほへと、すき焼き、中京区鍋屋町215 サキゾービル 4F、京都河原町駅1A出口から徒歩1分、毎日 11:00〜22:00 (最終入店20:00、L.O. 21:30)、完全予約制、70席、個室 (2〜30名)、50名以上可、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2025年3月10日オープン。口コミ (2026年4〜10月、英語): 黒毛和牛すき焼き食べ放題コース7,700円が期間限定5,500円 (和牛、木桶の炊きたてコシヒカリ、野菜の盛り合わせ、本日のデザート)、関西風にザラメで最初の一枚を店員が焼く、看板がなく見つけにくいという声、店員の私語が大きいという声、脂で後半はペースが落ちるという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; private rooms; no sign outside.

kyoto_yakiniku_rin_gokomachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: marinated yakiniku and soy-based tare; meat sushi (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_rin_gokomachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a black-wagyu yakiniku and offal house (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_rin_gokomachi.hours_raw: Tabelog and Gurunavi: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 17:00–23:30; Sat and Sun 16:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed Wednesday. Reservations taken; book early for the one private room for 6 upstairs (Gurunavi). 42 seats: tables, a 4-seat counter, tatami tables and the private room. Non-smoking until 21:00, then a designated smoking area. English menu and English-speaking staff; children and strollers welcome; birthday plates. Cards, transit IC, QR. In a townhouse on Gokomachi just north of Shijo, by Nishiki Market. Opened 20 December 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiniku_rin_gokomachi.notes: [Yakiniku · Gokomachi near Nishiki, whole-cow black wagyu] A calm townhouse yakiniku a block from Nishiki Market buying black wagyu by the whole cow: tongue, skirt, offal and meat sushi, with tatami tables and a private room. Reviews swing: one found the meat sweet and fresh (May 2026), another found four-slice portions poor value and the self-ordering cold (July 2023). Smoking after 21:00. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 20 December 2019 (Tabelog). Reviewers from 2023 to 2026 describe a clean townhouse with a mix of locals and international guests, attentive staff, tablet self-ordering, whole-cow purchasing of black wagyu (May 2026) and prices not inflated for tourists (February 2025).

anecdotes.text: July 2023: "each portion only comes with 4 cuts. The cost-performance is very poor… It's a self-ordering system with no customer service."
February 2025: "this place offers reasonable prices that are not inflated for tourists… I think they could be a bit more business-minded."
May 2026: "They buy the entire cow of carefully selected Kuroge Wagyu."
