kyoto_pontocho_nabe_ishiya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: sukiyaki with a yakiniku sauce, sugar and dipping sauce (March 2026).
kyoto_pontocho_nabe_ishiya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu, pork and duck sukiyaki and shabu-shabu (March 2026).
kyoto_pontocho_nabe_ishiya.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu 17:00–22:30; Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays also 11:30–14:30 at lunch (last orders 14:00 and 22:00); closed Wednesday. Reservations taken. 16 seats at the counter and tables; private room up to 20. Non-smoking. English picture menu; children, babies and strollers welcome; BYO allowed. Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money, QR. Up a back alley off Pontocho (the 24th alley), 2F, in the same alley as 先斗町 鮨いし屋. Opened 5 February 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_pontocho_nabe_ishiya.notes: [Sukiyaki · Pontocho alley, a new いし屋 counter] A small second-floor counter down a Pontocho back alley, opened February 2026 by the group behind Gion いし屋 and the neighbouring 鮨いし屋: Kyoto beef, Kyotanba pork, Kobe beef or Kyoto duck as sukiyaki or shabu-shabu, with a ¥1,980 limited lunch set at weekends. Friendly to solo diners. Only two reviews so far (March, April 2026). Closed Wednesday.

roles: Not named in a source; part of the いし屋 group (March 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 5 February 2026 (Tabelog). A March 2026 reviewer calls it the newest shop of the Ishiya group, known for Gion Ishiya, Sushi Ishiya and Yakiniku Ishiya in Kyoto; 先斗町 鮨いし屋 is already in this app (kyoto_pontocho_sushi_ishiya, same alley). An April 2026 solo diner found the master and staff very friendly.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "I visited on a Saturday by myself, craving Kansai-style sukiyaki with zarame sugar… The master and staff were very friendly, making it easy for me to enjoy my meal alone."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 先斗町 鍋いし屋、鍋・すき焼き・居酒屋、中京区鍋屋町210 先斗町24番街路地奥 2F、祇園四条駅・阪急河原町駅から徒歩5分、月火木 17:00〜22:30・金土日祝 11:30〜14:30・17:00〜22:30 (L.O. 14:00・22:00)、水曜休み、予約可、16席 (カウンター、テーブル)、20名までの個室、禁煙、英語の写真メニュー、子供・赤ちゃん・ベビーカー可、持ち込み可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2026年2月5日オープン。口コミ (2026年3・4月、英語): 祇園いし屋、鮨いし屋、焼肉いし屋などのいし屋グループの新店、和牛すき焼きとしゃぶしゃぶ、京の肉 (リブロース、赤身、サーロイン)、京丹波ポーク、神戸牛、京鴨、昼は数量限定の京の肉の肩ブリスケのすき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ定食1,980円、最初の一枚は焼肉いし屋のたれ、ザラメの関西風、マスターとスタッフが親切。

cultural_comfort.note: English picture menu; new shop with few reviews.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened February 2026) with reviews from March and April 2026.

kyoto_kyoha_spice.gf_detail: Ask. Spice curries over rice that change weekly and monthly — keema, vindaloo, a squid-ink curry, a beef-tendon "European" curry — plus kara-age and steak; no gluten information is published (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyoha_spice.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the curries reviewed are chicken, pork, beef, bonito and squid (reviews).
kyoto_kyoha_spice.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–15:00 Wednesday–Monday; dinner 17:00–21:00 Wednesday–Saturday; closed Tuesday; days change — check the calendar on Instagram (Tabelog). Bookings by Instagram DM. No service charge; one drink per person at dinner (Tabelog). Cards, transport IC, iD, QUICPay and most QR codes (Tabelog). 12 seats: 8 at the counter, 4 at a table; heated tobacco only, outside; English menu (Tabelog). Run by one person, so food can be slow at peak (October 2025; April 2026). Down a narrow passage in the BASE KYOTO OMIYA building west of Omiya-Takatsuji, 5 min walk south of Hankyu Omiya Stn (Tabelog; April and July 2026).
kyoto_kyoha_spice.notes: [Spice curry · Omiya-Takatsuji, a one-person curry counter] Tucked down a passage off Omiya, a clean, stylish counter run single-handed by the owner of the former X.CURRY in Yodo. The curries change by the week and month — soki vindaloo, Pakistani chicken, beef-tendon European, a squid-ink black curry — and most diners take a two-curry plate (about ¥1,300). Be patient at peak; dinner adds drinks. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner-chef not named; runs the shop alone (October 2025; April 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 11 November 2024 (Tabelog). Per an April 2026 reviewer, the owner previously ran X.CURRY in Yodo; reviewers describe a friendly owner who works alone and changes the curries monthly, with weekly specials.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner was told to start with the milder squid-dashi black curry, as the chicken used twice the spices.
An April 2026 visitor walked into the café next door by mistake before finding the passage.
An October 2026 regular finally got the long-awaited Chiba coriander with a Pakistani chicken and beef-tendon pair.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: キョウハスパイス、カレー、下京区五坊大宮町87-3 岡染 BASE KYOTO OMIYA、阪急大宮駅・嵐電四条大宮駅から大宮通を南へ徒歩5分、四条大宮から332m、月日祝 11:00〜15:00、水〜土 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜21:00、火曜定休、最新の営業日はInstagramのカレンダー、予約はInstagramのDM、サービス料・チャージなし、ディナーは1人1ドリンク制、カード・電子マネー・QR可、12席 (カウンター8、テーブル4)、加熱式たばこのみ店外の喫煙所、英語メニュー、2024年11月11日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 店主がひとりで営業、淀のX.CURRYの店主、月替わりと週替わりのカレー、2種あいがけ1,300円、パキスタン風チキン、牛すじの欧風カレー、ソーキのビンダルー、実山椒のキーマ、レモンチキン、トマトチキン、豚骨グリーンカレー、チキンキーマ、生鰹のキーマ、イカ出汁の漆黒カレー、周年のビリヤニ、スパイス卵、ホルモン、千葉のパクチー、唐揚げ、ステーキ、デザート、路地の奥。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; book by Instagram DM (Tabelog).

kyoto_shizen_shusai_ichishun.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto vegetables and fish — obanzai, tempura, saikyo-grilled fish, lava-stone grills, rice bowls — with no gluten information published; Tabelog lists vegetarian options (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_shizen_shusai_ichishun.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and many vegetable dishes from contract farms, but dashi and fish are used throughout (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_shizen_shusai_ichishun.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 daily; dinner 17:00–23:00 (Friday and Saturday to 23:30) (Tabelog). Bookings accepted. Otoshi ¥300 (Tabelog). Cards, transport IC, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 74 seats on three floors (lift): an 8-seat counter, tables and party floors for 20–50; non-smoking, with smoking on each floor’s balcony; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). English-speaking staff (December 2025). On Shichijo-dori west of Karasuma, 472 m from Kyoto Station, after a move (Tabelog; April 2025).
kyoto_shizen_shusai_ichishun.notes: [Izakaya · Shichijo near Kyoto Station, Kyoto vegetables and fish] A roomy three-floor izakaya on Shichijo built around Yawata farm vegetables and fish from Kameoka: obanzai, Kujo-leek dishes, saikyo-grilled sablefish and a lava-stone grill, with a sake tasting set. Lunch is a bargain ¥1,000 daily set or a big tempura bowl. English-speaking staff. Open daily; ¥300 otoshi at night.

roles: Chef not named; operated by 万州国際株式会社 (invoice register)
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 March 2023 at this address (Tabelog); an April 2025 reviewer’s first visit since a move. The qualified-invoice holder 万州国際株式会社 is registered at the shop’s address (NTA). Tabelog’s introduction: seasonal Kyoto vegetables from contracted farmers in Yawata using reduced-pesticide or organic methods, fish from Kameoka and Yawata, a lava-plate grill, craft beer and Kyoto sake.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 pair ordered the grilled meat miso with Kujo leek twice at a ¥14,000 lunch for two.
An October 2026 visitor passed up tantanmen next door for a nine-dish obanzai lunch and loved the taro tempura.
A December 2025 guest recommended the sake tasting set and wished for more Japanese gin.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 自然酒菜 一瞬、居酒屋・日本料理・魚介料理、下京区西境町154 ドリーミー京都1F、京都駅から472m、七条烏丸のバス停から徒歩2分、月火水木日 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜23:00、金土 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜23:30、予約可、突き出し代300円、カード・電子マネー・QR可、74席 (カウンター8、テーブル、2・3階は貸切、エレベーター)、禁煙 (各階のバルコニーで喫煙可)、車椅子可、Wi-Fi、ベジタリアン対応、2023年3月1日オープン、インボイス T8130001061153 (万州国際株式会社、同住所)。公式紹介: 京都八幡の契約農家の減農薬・有機栽培の京野菜、亀岡と八幡の魚、溶岩焼き、クラフトビールと京都の地酒。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 移転後、日替わり定食1,000円 (鯖の煮付けと大根、ぶり大根とクリームコロッケ、牛すじのどて焼き)、海老の大きな天丼、唐揚げ・天ぷら・海鮮の丼1,500円、おばんざい9種、九条ねぎのサラダ、九条ねぎの肉味噌焼き、岩牡蠣、銀鱈の西京焼き、日本酒8種の飲み比べ、英語を話すスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff (December 2025).

kyoto_tsumu_cafe.gf_detail: Ask. Toasts, granola, cakes, cookies, financiers and gelato; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_tsumu_cafe.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter and egg toasts, cheesecake, dairy gelato and lattes (reviews).
kyoto_tsumu_cafe.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 8:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); Saturday, Sunday and holidays 8:00–19:00 (last order 18:30); closed New Year’s Day (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards, transport IC, iD and QUICPay; no QR codes (Tabelog). 28 seats with sofas, high counters, a terrace (dogs allowed there, non-smoking), power outlets and free Wi-Fi; wheelchair accessible; English menu (Tabelog; September 2026). Several 2026 reviewers note many foreign visitors from opening (July–October 2026). 5 min walk from the Karasuma exit of Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_tsumu_cafe.notes: [Café · Kyoto Station, Karasuma side, breakfast to gelato] A big, airy café five minutes from Kyoto Station (formerly tsumugi cafe), open from 8:00 with sofas, a dog-friendly terrace and outlets at every seat. Come for toast breakfasts, the three-layer matcha-espresso latte, Basque cheesecake or a double gelato (about ¥600–1,000). Busy from morning; no bookings.

roles: Operated by 株式会社レ・コネクション (representative 奥田久雄; press release)
chef_bio.background: Opened 29 August 2020 (Tabelog), formerly named tsumugi cafe (September 2026 review). Per a February 2025 press release: run by 株式会社レ・コネクション of Shimogyo, Kyoto, which deals in real estate and runs lodging and food businesses; the café hosted an art student’s exhibition beside the register and has done collaborations such as a Ninna-ji drink. An October 2026 reviewer notes a hotel above.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 breakfast guest found two groups ahead at 9:00 and the avocado-basil toast tasty but small for the price.
An August 2026 visitor avoids the dangling-leg high counter chairs and was glad to get a sofa.
An October 2026 diner found a soft-boiled egg hidden under the melted cheese on the toast.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: TSUMU CAFE、カフェ、下京区東塩小路町684、京都駅から徒歩約5分、平日 8:00〜18:00 (L.O. 17:30、2025年7月17日から)、土日祝 8:00〜19:00 (L.O. 18:30)、元日休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、28席、電源、テラス (ペットはテラスのみ、禁煙)、Wi-Fi、車椅子可、英語メニュー、2020年8月29日オープン、インボイス T4130001057262 (株式会社レ・コネクション)。公式紹介: 京都駅烏丸口すぐ、2020年夏オープン、看板の「グリーンティーラテプレッソ」(エスプレッソ・ミルク・抹茶の3層)、月替わりのメニュー。プレスリリース (2025年2月): 京都市内で不動産売買や飲食施設の管理運営を行う株式会社レ・コネクション (代表取締役 奥田久雄) の運営する「tsumugi cafe」、宿泊施設の企画・販売・運営・飲食事業、所在地 東塩小路町684番地 1F。口コミ (2026年、英語): 旧名 tsumugi cafe、ハニーバタートースト600円、アボカドとバジルのトースト、バナナトースト、半熟卵入りのチーズトースト、カプレーゼ、グラノーラ、バスクチーズケーキ700円、ジェラートのダブル950円、クッキー、フィナンシェ、カフェラテ650円、高知の柚子茶600円、ベルガモットピーチティー、外国人客が多い (複数の口コミ)、上にホテル。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); many international visitors per several 2026 reviews.

kyoto_saba_kaido_hanaore_shimogamo.gf_detail: Ask. Pressed mackerel sushi — regular, seared, kombu-wrapped — with vinegared rice, tsukudani and clear soup; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_saba_kaido_hanaore_shimogamo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: mackerel, sea bream, eel and conger sushi (official site).
kyoto_saba_kaido_hanaore_shimogamo.hours_raw: 10:00–17:00 Monday–Friday, 10:00–18:00 Saturday and Sunday (Tabelog); the official site says the shop and workshop close every Wednesday and on the 1st and 3rd Tuesday. Eat-in until 15:30 (June 2026). Takeaway and online orders (official site). Bookings accepted. Cards, transport IC, iD, QUICPay and QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: three tables for four and a short counter, with a tatami area; non-smoking (Tabelog). A May 2026 reviewer found no working restroom; a June 2026 reviewer describes one off a courtyard. Near the Shimogamo Shrine entrance, 10 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_saba_kaido_hanaore_shimogamo.notes: [Saba-zushi · Shimogamo Shrine, the end of the Mackerel Road] The shop and dining room of a saba-zushi maker by the gate of Shimogamo Shrine, where the old Mackerel Road from the Japan Sea ends: thick slabs of lightly salted mackerel on mellow vinegared rice. Eat in until 15:30 — the Tomoe-zen of three styles is about ¥2,700 — or take a whole roll home (from about ¥3,650). Closed Wednesday and the 1st and 3rd Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Saba Kaido Hanaore keeps to one-salted mackerel and a handed-down method; the Shimogamo shop and its workshop close on Wednesdays and the 1st and 3rd Tuesday; online sales of saba, guji, eel and conger sushi. Reviewers (2025–2026) note the shop sits near the Shimogamo end of the Saba Kaido.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: care over one-salted mackerel and keeping to the traditional method.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 repeat visitor called it a favourite place in Kyoto for the thick mackerel and melting rice of the Tomoe-zen.
A September 2025 diner from Kyushu learned that Mackerel Road fish once ended its journey in Shimogamo.
An April 2026 book-club guest found the older ladies serving efficient and pleasant.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (hanaore.co.jp): 一汐のサバにこだわり伝承の製法を守りつづける鯖街道 花折、下鴨店・工房とも毎週水曜日のほか第一・第三火曜日が定休、吟撰鯖寿し10,530円、上鯖寿し7,560円、鯖寿し5,670円、龍飛巻鯖寿し5,940円、巴巻5,400円、鯖あぶり寿し3,780円、京鯖寿し3,650円、ぐじ (甘鯛) 寿し8,000円、うなぎ寿し7,500円、炙り穴子寿し2,980円、お歳暮のセット、ネット注文。食べログ: 日本料理・寿司、左京区下鴨宮崎町121、出町柳駅から徒歩10分、新葵橋のバス停、月〜金 10:00〜17:00、土日 10:00〜18:00、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、16席 (4人掛け3卓、カウンター)、座敷、禁煙、テイクアウト。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 巴膳2,700円 (鯖寿し・炙り・昆布巻き各2切れ)、花折膳、炙り鯖寿しのセット、酢の物、佃煮、からすみ、すまし汁、イートインは15時半まで、下鴨神社のそば、鯖街道の終点。

cultural_comfort.note: Small dining room; takeaway counter.

existence.note: Official site with a current closing-day notice and seasonal sets; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_millennium_gopchang.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tare-marinated offal and galbi, cold noodles, fried rice (2026 reviews).
kyoto_millennium_gopchang.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef and pork offal, pork galbi, octopus (2026 reviews).
kyoto_millennium_gopchang.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 16:00–23:00; Sat and Sun 11:30–23:00. Reservations taken — mostly full with bookings even on weekdays (June 2026). Staff grill everything at the table (2026 reviews). Counter seating; smoky from the grills (August 2026); non-smoking (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). About 8–10 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi exit 9.
kyoto_millennium_gopchang.notes: [Korean offal grill · south of Shijo, a Busan gopchang stall] A loud, smoky Korean horumon grill near Teramachi that feels like a Busan street stall: staff grill beef and pork offal, bone-in pork galbi and baby octopus at your table, with perilla wraps, cold noodles and soju. Usually full of bookings. One diner found the kimchi sour and the cold-noodle broth too salty (May 2026). Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a Korean-styled room and staff, a lively full house, smoke from the grills, and staff who do all the grilling; a May 2026 reviewer calls it a restaurant "from the group", and a September 2026 visitor says it faithfully recreates a Busan gopchang spot. The group and its other shops were not identified.
chef_bio.specialty: Beef and pork horumon; bone-in pork galbi.

anecdotes.text: May 2026: "the kimchi was not good. It was sour and salty… The cold noodles… It was salty. More like saltwater than broth."
September 2026: "This restaurant perfectly recreates a gopchang (grilled intestines) spot from Busan."
May 2026: "The staff grills everything for you, which adds to the overall atmosphere."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ミリネヤンコプチャン、韓国料理・焼肉・ホルモン、下京区中之町558、京都河原町駅から徒歩10分、月〜金 16:00〜23:00・土日 11:30〜23:00、予約可、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2026年5〜9月、英語・日本語): 韓国の屋台のような焼肉店、いつも満席で活気、店員がすべて焼く、牛と豚のホルモン (タレ)、骨付き豚肩ロース、牛タン、テナガダコ、エゴマの葉、つけだれいろいろ、冷麺と炒飯、チャミスル、グループの店、釜山のコプチャン屋の再現、キムチが酸っぱくしょっぱく冷麺のスープが塩辛いという声、骨付き肉を生焼けで先に切られて残念という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff grill at the table; cash only; book.

kyoto_hana_oogi_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: mochi dishes with tempura bits, soy-based sauces and zoni soups (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hana_oogi_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, cod-roe mochi, dashi zoni (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hana_oogi_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Wed–Sat and nights around holidays 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); Sun and holidays 17:30–22:00; closed Tuesday (open on Mondays in long holidays). Reservations taken; 30 minutes late without word counts as a cancellation; course bookings cannot be switched to à la carte on arrival. Seat charge ¥700 and 10% service — Tabelog, Japanese original 「席料700円 サービス料10%」. 24 seats: 4 at the counter, 20 at tables; an upstairs tatami room (courses only, room fee) for 10–20. Non-smoking. Menus in English and Chinese; children and strollers welcome; BYO for a fee. Cards, transit IC, QR. In a townhouse by the Takase river on Kiyamachi above Bukkoji.
kyoto_hana_oogi_kiyamachi.notes: [Mochi and Kyoto cooking · Kiyamachi by the Takase, a mochi family's successor] A townhouse on the Takase river run by a grandson of the old mochi restaurant Kitamura, keeping its freshly pounded mochi — cod-roe, natto, and zoni in clear or white-miso soup — alongside sashimi and seasonal plates. A reviewer met a Shimabara tayuu at the table (October 2026). ¥700 seat charge and 10% service. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Not named in a source; run by a grandson of the former Kitamura (August 2024 review)
chef_bio.background: Per an August 2024 reviewer, it is run by the son of the eldest daughter of the former mochi restaurant "Kitamura", carrying on its flavours; an April 2026 diner's family had been regulars there. An October 2026 reviewer, invited by a regular, describes a townhouse by the Takase river where a long-serving Shimabara tayuu, Hanaogi, joined the table to talk about the old customs, and staff who asked about dislikes in advance.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: "When I mentioned that I wasn't fond of cucumbers, they made sure to set aside the cucumbers from the appetizer."
December 2024: "Choosing between clear soup and white miso for the zoni soup at the end was quite difficult, so I ended up trying both."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 花おおぎ、日本料理、下京区木屋町通仏光寺上る天王町157-8、祇園四条・河原町から徒歩10分、月水木金土・祝前日・祝後日 18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)・日祝 17:30〜22:00、火曜休み (連休中の月曜は営業)、予約可、30分連絡なしはキャンセル、コース予約は来店後の変更不可、原文で「席料700円 サービス料10%」、24席 (カウンター4、テーブル20)、2階の座敷 (コースのみ、部屋代別)、禁煙、英語・中国語メニュー、子供・ベビーカー可、持ち込み料あり、カード・電子マネー・QR可。口コミ (2024年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 元の餅料理の店 Kitamura の長女の息子が営む、つきたての餅、たらこ餅、納豆餅と天かす、締めのお雑煮 (すまし・白味噌)、刺身の盛り合わせ (いか、サーモン)、焼き物、あられの茶漬け、飲み物が豊富、高瀬川沿いの町家、島原の Hanaogi 太夫が席で話をしてくれたという声、苦手なものを事前に聞く。

cultural_comfort.note: English and Chinese menus; ¥700 seat charge and 10% service.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_warayaki_mizutaki_aoi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: ponzu and soy-based warayaki, yuba rolls, course dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_warayaki_mizutaki_aoi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken mizutaki, straw-seared fish and beef, duck (2026 reviews).
kyoto_warayaki_mizutaki_aoi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Sun–Thu 17:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); Fri and Sat 17:00–24:00; open all year. Reservations taken; select a kawadoko (summer river-terrace) seat when booking — 1 May to 30 September, ¥1,000 extra a seat, moved indoors if it rains. Appetiser charge ¥500 (plus a ¥500 seat charge 28 December–3 January) — Tabelog, Japanese original 「お通し代 500円 ※(年末年始12/28~1/3は席料+500円)」. 64 seats; private rooms for 2–8; a floor for up to 20. Non-smoking. Cards and e-money; no QR. On Pontocho with a view of the Kamo River. Opened 5 October 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_warayaki_mizutaki_aoi.notes: [Warayaki and mizutaki · Pontocho, river views and a summer kawadoko] A Pontocho izakaya with Kamo River views and a summer river terrace: straw-seared fish and beef, chicken mizutaki and Kyoto obanzai, in reasonably priced courses for the area. Reviewers split on the mizutaki (rich, May and June 2026; no umami, April 2026); portions run small and the terrace can be buggy or rained off. ¥500 appetiser charge; ¥1,000 extra for a kawadoko seat.

chef_bio.background: Opened 5 October 2020 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a calm, Kyoto-feeling restaurant with window seats and a private room on the Kamo River, a summer kawadoko, smooth moves indoors when it rains, and modest portions at prices reasonable for Pontocho.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "Everything was delicious except for the Mizutaki… I couldn't taste the umami at all."
August 2026: "I originally booked a seat by the river, but it was infested with bugs, so I switched to an indoor table… the service was a bit disappointing."
September 2026: "I recommend choosing a la carte drinks over the all-you-can-drink option, as there are many varieties available."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 藁焼きと水炊き 葵、居酒屋・日本料理・郷土料理、中京区河原町通四条上る松本町166、祇園四条駅・阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、日〜木 17:00〜23:00・金土 17:00〜24:00、年中無休、予約可、納涼床は予約時に選択 (5月1日〜9月30日、席料1,000円、雨天は店内)、原文で「お通し代 500円 ※(年末年始12/28~1/3は席料+500円)」、64席、個室 (2〜8名)、20名までのフロア貸切、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、2020年10月5日オープン。口コミ (2026年2〜10月、英語): 藁焼きの3種盛り、牛の炙り刺し、卓で炙る牛のお通し、ねぎとろの湯葉巻き、鶏の水炊き、おばんざい、鴨、冷奴、葵コース7,500円、飲み放題付きのコース、鴨川の見える席と個室、納涼床、水炊きにうまみがないという声、床は虫が多く接客が残念という声、量は少なめ、先斗町にしては手頃。

cultural_comfort.note: River views; kawadoko seats ¥1,000 extra in summer; ¥500 appetiser charge.

kyoto_gion_fujitora.gf_detail: Ask: seiro-steamed vegetables, Kyoto pork and rice are wheat-free in themselves, but seven condiments, steamed buns and sweets come with them (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_fujitora.vegan_detail: Not vegan: steamed sets include Kyoto pork, salmon or other meat (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_fujitora.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–16:30 and 17:00–22:00; Tue and Thu 11:00–17:30; closed Wednesday (open if a holiday). Lunch from 11:00, tea from 14:00, dinner from 17:00. Book through TableCheck (Instagram or Google Maps links) or by phone — often full (July 2026). 25 seats on tatami, with private rooms and a courtyard. Non-smoking. Children welcome — kids' menu, children's utensils, stroller storage. Cards (incl. UnionPay), transit IC and e-money; no QR. In a renovated 100-year-old townhouse on Kawabata-dori, 1–2 min from Gion-Shijo Stn. Opened 7 July 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_fujitora.notes: [Seiro steaming · Gion-Shijo, a townhouse by the Kamo] A renovated century-old townhouse on Kawabata-dori, a minute from Gion-Shijo Station: bamboo-steamed seasonal vegetables and Kyoto pork with seven condiments at lunch and dinner, then tiger-themed parfaits and monaka at tea time, in tatami rooms around a courtyard. Book — often full. One diner felt rushed as steamers were cleared mid-meal (July 2026). Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 July 2022 (Tabelog); per its Tabelog text, a renovated 100-year-old townhouse serving seiro-mushi courses of high-quality seasonal vegetables and Kyoto pork, with tatami seats, private rooms and a courtyard. Reviewers in 2026 say it began as a lunch spot and later added dinner, with hand-drawn menus and family-friendly service.

anecdotes.text: July 2026: "they cleared the steamer while I was still eating. While the cost performance isn't great, I think this place is more about enjoying the atmosphere."
July 2026: "When I mentioned that I liked the drawing on the back that wishes for happiness, they told me that each one is handwritten."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ふじ寅 (Gion Fujitora)、カフェ・甘味処・日本料理、東山区宮川筋1-231-1、京阪祇園四条駅から川端通を徒歩1〜2分、月金土日祝 11:00〜16:30・17:00〜22:00・火木 11:00〜17:30、水曜休み (祝日は営業)、ランチ11時〜・甘味14時〜・ディナー17時〜、TableCheck か電話で予約、25席、座敷、個室、禁煙、子供可 (子供メニュー・食器・ベビーカー置き場)、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、2022年7月7日オープン、築100年の京町家で季節の野菜と京都ポークのせいろ蒸しのコース、地酒とクラフトビール、抹茶の甘味と蒸しまんじゅう。口コミ (2026年6〜11月、英語): 季節野菜のせいろ蒸しランチ2,750円 (肉・野菜・ご飯、薬味7種)、夜の塩麹の鮭、手描きのメニュー、とらパフェ、とら最中、柚子と抹茶のムース、中庭、満席が多い、蒸籠を食べている途中で下げられたという声、割安ではないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book via TableCheck; tatami rooms; family-friendly.

kyoto_the_green_teramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a homemade-sausage café — sausage plates, hot dogs, English breakfast (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_the_green_teramachi.hours_raw: Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun: breakfast 8:30–11:00, lunch and café 12:00–17:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change, and opening days are posted on Instagram (Tabelog; March 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 18 seats: a counter of 2 and tables (Tabelog). Smoking is allowed at the counter only (Tabelog). On Teramachi-dori south of Imadegawa, on the east side of the street to the Imperial Palace (Tabelog; November 2023).
kyoto_the_green_teramachi.notes: [Café · Teramachi Imadegawa, homemade sausages and English breakfast] A small café by the Imperial Palace with a punk-and-art London feel, known for juicy homemade sausages with a mound of mashed potato, chili or salsa hot dogs with chips, and a big English breakfast from 8:30. Cash only; closed Wednesday — check Instagram for opening days.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café and European restaurant near the Imperial Palace. An August 2024 review describes a 1970s–80s London punk and art atmosphere and a pub brunch.

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 visitor came for the English breakfast and warned that the portion is big.
A March 2026 walker by the Imperial Palace had the chili con carne hot dog and recommends checking Instagram before going.
A May 2025 diner expected a fatty sausage and found it was not, and called the mashed potatoes irresistible.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・ヨーロッパ料理、上京区寺町今出川下ル扇町281-1 パレスハイツ 1F、月火木金土日8:30〜11:00と12:00〜17:00、水曜休み、予約可、現金のみ、18席 (カウンター2、テーブル)、カウンターのみ喫煙可。口コミ (2020年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 自家製ソーセージとマッシュポテト、サラダ、パン1,400円、バジルのソーセージ、バゲットサンド、チリコンカンやサルサのホットドッグとポテト、イングリッシュブレックファスト、ロンドンのパンクとアートの雰囲気、営業日はインスタグラムで。

cultural_comfort.note: Bring cash; check Instagram for opening days; smoking only at the counter. No English evidence found.

kyoto_cafe_kozora_imadegawa.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta and pizza lead the menu, with carpaccio, salads and risotto too (2024–25 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_cafe_kozora_imadegawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood and meat pasta, carpaccio, seafood salad (2024–25 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_kozora_imadegawa.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30), dinner 18:00–23:30 (last order 22:30); closed irregularly — a calendar by the entrance shows the open days (Tabelog; December 2024). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats: two tables for four, a sofa seat and a counter (Tabelog; May 2023). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Imadegawa-dori, 4 min west of Imadegawa Stn, opposite the Kamigyo ward office (Tabelog; May 2023).
kyoto_cafe_kozora_imadegawa.notes: [Italian café · Imadegawa-dori, a couple-run neighbourhood favourite] A cosy 16-seat café-trattoria on Imadegawa-dori run by a couple, with sofa seats behind a glass front: a long list of pasta — monthly specials with Kyoto ingredients, a summer chilled Genovese — pizza, carpaccio and risotto, and coffee and sweets in between. Cash only; check the door calendar for open days.

chef_bio.background: A May 2023 review describes an Italian café run by a couple, then nearly twelve years in business. Reviews from 2024 and 2026 also describe it as couple-run.

anecdotes.text: A May 2023 diner came for dinner with family of four and came back alone four days later.
A September 2025 regular on about a fifth visit ordered the chilled Genovese pasta three times that summer.
A May 2026 first-timer wanted to try everything on the menu and warmed to both owners.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・パスタ・ピザ、上京区今出川通室町西入堀出シ町279、地下鉄今出川駅から西へ徒歩4分、11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)、18:00〜23:30 (L.O. 22:30)、不定休、予約可、現金のみ、16席、禁煙。口コミ (2021年12月〜2026年5月、英語): 夫婦で営む、2023年7月で12年、入口の横に営業日のカレンダー、ワタリガニのトマトクリームパスタ、月替わりのパスタ (アラビアータ、ミートソース、Kujo のねぎと牡蠣のペペロンチーノ)、夏の冷製ジェノベーゼ、海鮮サラダ、タコのカルパッチョ、リゾット、ピザ、コーヒーと甘いもの。

kyoto_ryuen_karasuma.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: ramen, cold noodles and fried chicken sets (2022–26 reviews).
kyoto_ryuen_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork miso soup, chashu ramen, crab omelette, fried chicken (2022–26 reviews).
kyoto_ryuen_karasuma.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–20:30; closed Sunday and holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Noodles can sell out by 13:00 (November 2023). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Shared tables (January 2022). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Karasuma-dori north of Kamidachiuri, next to Doshisha University and near Shokokuji, about 4 min from Imadegawa Stn (Tabelog; 2017–23 reviews).
kyoto_ryuen_karasuma.notes: [Chinese set meals · Karasuma Imadegawa, the Doshisha canteen] A long-running, remodelled Chinese-style diner beside Doshisha University, full at lunch with students, staff and office workers: ramen with fried rice, a big bowl of pork miso soup with rice, fried chicken, mapo tofu and summer cold noodles, mostly under ¥1,000. Staff say no chemical seasonings are used. Cash only; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: A January 2022 review recalls eating here some 30 years earlier and notes the shop has since been remodelled. A June 2025 visitor heard the staff tell a customer that the kitchen uses natural flavours and no chemical seasonings.
chef_bio.philosophy: Natural flavours, no chemical seasonings (staff, as heard in June 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Fried-rice and ramen sets; pork miso soup set.

anecdotes.text: A January 2022 visitor returning after 30 years ordered the old fried-rice set — about ¥650 then, ¥900 now.
A January 2026 office worker was surprised the large pork miso soup came in a rice bowl.
A July 2026 regular came back for the cold noodles in the heat and was served within ten minutes despite a full room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂・ラーメン、上京区烏丸通上立売上ル柳図子町334、今出川駅から約260m、月〜土11:30〜14:00と17:00〜20:30、日祝休み、現金のみ、禁煙。口コミ (2017年12月〜2026年7月、英語): 同志社大学の隣、中華の定食、炒飯セット (醤油ラーメンと小さな炒飯) 900〜950円、豚汁定食の大盛りと卵880円、唐揚げ定食820円、麻婆豆腐の定食、カレー炒飯、かに玉の定食、夏の冷麺、昼は学生や教職員で満席、改装済み、化学調味料を使わないと店の人が話していた。

cultural_comfort.note: Share a table at lunch; noodles can sell out by 13:00; cash only. No English evidence found.

kyoto_mei_ron_enmachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: shrimp and pork dim sum, char siu buns, chicken congee (2024–26 reviews).

PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog). 13 seats: a counter of 5 and tables for 8 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Restroom in the building, not in the shop (October 2024). Nijo Plaza 1F, 5 min from JR Enmachi, 7 min from Nishioji-Oike (Tabelog).
kyoto_mei_ron_enmachi.notes: [Cantonese dim sum · Enmachi, a one-chef local] A 13-seat Chinese restaurant in a small building near Enmachi where the owner-chef cooks alone at the wok: lunch sets of a main dish with three dim sum from about ¥1,000, a ¥1,200 dim sum set with congee, and at night Cantonese buns, shumai and courses with Shaoxing wine. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviews from May 2024 to April 2026 describe the owner-chef running the restaurant alone, sometimes joined by one more staff member, cooking dim sum and wok dishes in view of the counter.

anecdotes.text: A May 2024 diner listened to the clang of wok and ladle as the head chef worked alone, and found the appetisers worthy of a high-end Chinese restaurant.
An August 2026 regular makes it the usual second stop after drinks in Enmachi; the yakisoba was a little oily but the shrimp shumai outstanding.
A May 2026 lunch visitor found the dinner menu promising Cantonese buns on a fermented dough and vowed to come back at night.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 飲茶・点心、中京区西ノ京北壺井町88-1 二条プラザ 1F、JR円町駅から徒歩5分、西大路御池駅から徒歩7分、11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)、17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、火曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、13席 (カウンター5、テーブル8)、禁煙。口コミ (2024年4月〜2026年10月、英語): 店主が一人で調理、点心3種とスープとご飯の定食 (牛肉のオイスターソース950円、酢豚1,000円)、点心セット1,200円 (蒸し点心4種、日替わり、ピータンと鶏の粥、デザート2種)、担々麺のセット、炒飯に変更+250円、海老とニラの餃子、Ham Sui Gok、大根餅、春巻、海老焼売、夜は "Lao Mian" の生地の広東式の包子、コースと紹興酒の飲み比べ。

cultural_comfort.note: Sit at the counter to watch the wok; lunch sets are the easy order; book courses ahead. No English evidence found.

kyoto_washoku_makotaro.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese courses seasoned with soy-sauce koji, salt koji and miso, plus tempura and spring rolls; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_washoku_makotaro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every course opens with a kombu-and-bonito dashi, and the dishes are fish and Wagyu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_washoku_makotaro.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations for courses only (Tabelog). Cards including UnionPay, IC cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 28 seats: 8 at a single-slab counter and 20 at tables; private rooms (Tabelog; January and June 2026). No sign — a small nameplate by the door, in an alley west of the Takase River, 2 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi (Tabelog; January 2026). Opened 23 October 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_washoku_makotaro.notes: [Japanese courses · alley off the Takase River, dashi and fermentation] A sign-less restaurant down a quiet alley near Hankyu Kawaramachi, opened in October 2025: a young chef’s monthly courses built on a golden first dashi and koji and miso seasonings, served at a handsome single-slab counter, with sake pairings and clay-pot rice to finish. Courses only; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes healthy Japanese courses that cherish Kyoto tradition, rare sake in limited quantities and pairings by a sommelier. A June 2026 reviewer mentions a young chef at the counter; an August 2026 reviewer heard the restaurant has sister shops of other kinds.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 guest during the Gion Matsuri had the counter alone on a stormy night and took leftover rice home as onigiri.
An August 2026 diner found it while looking for a wife’s birthday dinner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和食 まこたろう、日本料理・海鮮・天ぷら、中京区紙屋町364、阪急河原町駅から徒歩2分、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.料理22:00、ドリンク22:30)、水曜定休、予約はコースのみ、カード・電子マネー・QR決済可、28席 (カウンター8、テーブル20)、個室あり、2025年10月23日オープン、炭火と出汁の創作和食、ソムリエの日本酒とワインのペアリング。口コミ (2026年、英語): 看板のない店、一枚板のカウンター、北海道の昆布と焼津や静岡の鰹の一番出汁、醤油麹・塩麹・胡麻味噌・ねぎ味噌、8,000〜8,800円ほどのコース、八寸、湯葉、桜えびと筍の春巻き、和牛、金目鯛の空豆ソース、ヤングコーンの炭火焼き、鮎、鱧、鯖のなめろう、佐渡のコシヒカリの土鍋ご飯、残りはおにぎりに、若い料理人、姉妹店があるとのこと。

cultural_comfort.note: Courses only; no sign outside; book ahead.

kyoto_kassai_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese courses — sashimi, hamo shabu-shabu, grilled fish, soups and fried dishes, seasonal rice; no gluten information. A March 2025 guest’s food preferences were met with substitutes when stated at booking.
kyoto_kassai_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led Japanese courses with soups, hamo and house-marinated ikura (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_kassai_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 17:00–24:00; Saturday and Sunday 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–24:00 (Tabelog). Appetizer fee ¥800 (Tabelog remarks). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). 46 seats: a counter downstairs and private rooms upstairs for 8 or 20–30; a riverside kawadoko deck in season (Tabelog; 2024–2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; September 2026). About 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi, on Kiyamachi (Tabelog).
kyoto_kassai_kiyamachi.notes: [Japanese · Kiyamachi on the Kamo, summer kawadoko] A Japanese restaurant in a modern machiya on Kiyamachi with a riverside deck in season: courses of Seto Inland Sea fish, the owner’s own marinated ikura, and in summer a full hamo course boned at the counter, with a good sake list. Counter downstairs, private rooms upstairs; ¥800 appetizer fee; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text says the owner personally takes the roe from Hokkaido salmon for the house-marinated ikura, and that the kitchen chooses Seto Inland Sea fish and Kamijo satoimo from Fukui. Reviewers watched the chef bone hamo at the counter (July and September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Bringing out the umami of seasonal ingredients (Tabelog; May 2024 review).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 traveller chose the counter over the hot riverside deck and was made welcome among the locals.
A March 2025 guest mentioned food dislikes when booking and found substitutes ready.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 月彩、日本料理、下京区天王町144、阪急河原町駅から徒歩5分、月〜金 17:00〜24:00、土日 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜24:00、お通し代800円 (備考)、カード・電子マネー可、46席、個室 (8名、20〜30名)、喫煙可、京町家の和モダンな店、瀬戸内の魚と福井の Kamijo の里芋、店主が北海道の鮭から自らほぐす自家製のいくら醤油漬け。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 夏の川床、鱧のフルコース (鱧しゃぶ、焼き鱧、カウンターで骨切り)、刺身、西京焼き、月替わりのご飯、日本酒が豊富、予約時に苦手なものを伝えると替えてくれる。

cultural_comfort.note: Kawadoko in season; ¥800 appetizer fee; smoking allowed.

kyoto_pepper_okinawa.gf_detail: Ask. Okinawan dishes — champuru, rafute, umibudo, mozuku, jimami tofu, Okinawa soba, taco rice — plus risotto and pasta; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_pepper_okinawa.vegan_detail: Ask. Umibudo, mozuku in vinegar, island shallots and jimami tofu appear, but sauces and dashi are not described, and most champuru include pork or egg (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_pepper_okinawa.hours_raw: 18:00–3:00 (L.O. 2:00); days off not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; for 4 or more, an 8-dish course with 120 minutes of free-flow drinks for ¥5,000, booked a day ahead (Tabelog). Otoshi and seat charge ¥350 (Tabelog, original お通し・お席料350円). Cards (Visa, Master, AMEX) (Tabelog). 24 seats: 12 at the counter, 12 at tables (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (December 2024). Third floor of the Matsuya Building, stairs only (March 2026). About 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi (Tabelog). Opened 13 April 2000 (Tabelog).
kyoto_pepper_okinawa.notes: [Okinawan · Nishikiyamachi 3F, open to 3:00] A long-running Okinawan dining bar up three flights of stairs off Kiyamachi: fresh Miyako umibudo from a tank, goya and somen champuru, rafute, mozuku and Okinawa soba with Orion draft and awamori — and, from a chef with Italian training, risotto and pasta. ¥350 seat charge; smoking allowed; open until 3:00.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes an Okinawan dining bar with Orion beer, umibudo shipped from Miyako Island and kept in a temperature-controlled tank, and Ishigaki beef. A December 2024 reviewer was served by the couple who run it; a July 2025 reviewer says the chef has worked as an Italian chef.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular asked for a pork-and-egg dish not on the menu, and the kitchen made it.
An August 2026 visitor found some ingredients short after a typhoon but filled up on jimami tofu, mozuku and Okinawa soba.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ペッパー、沖縄料理・居酒屋・おでん、中京区西木屋町四条上る紙屋町364 マツヤビル3F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、18:00〜翌3:00 (L.O.2:00)、不定休、予約可、お通し・お席料350円、カード可、24席 (カウンター12、テーブル12)、2000年4月13日オープン、オリオンの生ビール、宮古島直送の生海ぶどうを水槽で、石垣牛、契約農家の島野菜、8品と120分飲み放題のコース5,000円 (4名以上、前日まで)。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 海ぶどう900円、ゴーヤチャンプルー850円、そうめんチャンプルー、ラフテー、ミミガーのポン酢、もずく酢ともずくの天ぷら、ジーマーミ豆腐、島豆腐とろろ、沖縄そば、タコライス、紅芋とクリームチーズのポテサラ、泡盛、夫婦で営む (2024年12月)、料理人はイタリアンの経験あり、喫煙可、階段のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Stairs only to the 3rd floor; ¥350 seat charge; smoking allowed.

kyoto_ippin_ko_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto-style Chinese small plates — mapo tofu, shrimp chili, dim sum, ankake noodles, fried rice; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ippin_ko_pontocho.vegan_detail: Ask. Stir-fried greens with Kyoto yuba and local Chinese vegetables are on the menu (Tabelog; April 2024), but sauces and stocks are not described.
kyoto_ippin_ko_pontocho.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Sunday 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:10) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:10; last entry about 20:50); closed Tuesday; lunch may be closed about four days a month (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (Visa, Master) (Tabelog). 32 seats, 16 on each floor; parties up to 20 upstairs (Tabelog; January 2026). On Pontocho, about 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi; moved here from an alley off Pontocho (Tabelog).
kyoto_ippin_ko_pontocho.notes: [Chinese · Pontocho, light Kyoto-style small plates] A two-floor Chinese restaurant on Pontocho with gentle, Kyoto-style cooking at fair prices: a ¥1,100 lunch set of three small dishes plus mapo tofu or shrimp chili, a ¥2,980 dim sum course, greens with Kyoto yuba, and party courses with Shaoxing wine upstairs. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes light flavours typical of Kyoto cooking, classic dishes made with Kyoto yuba and local vegetables, and some creative twists; the restaurant moved to its present site from an alley off Pontocho.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 group of four expected Pontocho prices and were surprised by a ¥2,980 ten-dish dim sum course.
An October 2025 lunch guest could not stop eating the three cold cuts with garlic sauce before the main arrived.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 一品香、中華料理、中京区先斗町通四条上ル鍋屋町220-5、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、昼12:00〜14:00 (L.O.13:10)、夜17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:10)、火曜定休、昼は月に4日ほど休みあり、予約可、カード可、32席 (1階16、2階16)、先斗町の路地から移転、京都らしいあっさりした味、京湯葉と季節の野菜や京都産の中国野菜。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 小皿3品とご飯に主菜を選ぶAランチ1,100円、麻婆豆腐、エビチリ、あんかけ焼きそば、点心コース10品2,980円、紹興酒も飲み放題の宴会コース5,000円、豚・鶏・牛の前菜のにんにくソース、渡り蟹と九条ねぎの豆豉炒め、エビマヨ、杏仁豆腐。

cultural_comfort.note: Casual Chinese in Pontocho; book for groups upstairs.

kyoto_terakoya_umekoji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fried chicken and cutlet sets, tempura, udon and soba (2026 reviews).
kyoto_terakoya_umekoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken, pork cutlet and oyakodon; dashi-based curry and noodles (2026 reviews).
kyoto_terakoya_umekoji.hours_raw: Wed–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–19:30; Sat and Sun 11:00–19:30; closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog). A long temporary closure ended by September 2026 (September and October 2026 reviews). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cash only, paid after eating (Tabelog; October 2026 review). 20 seats — tables and a 4-seat counter; non-smoking; 4 parking spaces (Tabelog). 5 min from JR Nishioji Stn and from Umekoji Park / the Kyoto Railway Museum; use the address, not the phone number, in car navigation (Tabelog).
kyoto_terakoya_umekoji.notes: [Showa shokudo · near Umekoji Park] A long-running neighbourhood diner west of Umekoji Park, back after a long break: a big crispy-fried chicken set with salad for ¥1,150, a spicy dashi katsu-curry bowl, oyakodon and soba or udon with good dashi. Cash only; closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: A family-run shokudo. Reviewers describe an elderly couple — the woman cooking, the man at the register (July and October 2026); after the shop reopened in September 2026, a regular saw the owner at the register and, it seemed, the owner’s son cooking.

anecdotes.text: A regular who feared the closure was permanent, given the owner's age, returned in September 2026 to find the shop busy and prices slightly up.
In July 2026, with the jumbo chicken and tempura udon sold out, the staff suggested a bite-size cutlet set and kizami kitsune udon instead.
An October 2026 diner, still hungry after a tonkatsu set, ordered and finished a crispy-fried chicken set too.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寺子屋、食堂・丼・麺類、下京区梅小路西中町107番地、JR西大路駅から徒歩約5分、梅小路公園・京都鉄道博物館から徒歩約5分、水〜金 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜19:30、土日 11:00〜19:30、月火休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、20席 (テーブルとカウンター4席)、禁煙、駐車場4台、カーナビは住所で設定。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): 長い休業の後に再開、高齢の夫婦 (女性が調理、男性がレジ)、再開後は息子さんが調理のよう、一番人気の鶏の揚げ物の定食1,150円、さっぱりした揚げ物の定食1,150円、とんかつ定食、Korokoro カツの定食、ジャンボチキン定食、だしのカツカレー丼 (片栗粉のとろみ、辛口)、天丼、親子丼、そば・うどん、きざみきつねうどん、天ぷらうどん、だしがおいしい、現金の後払い。

cultural_comfort.note: Wall menu in Japanese; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reopened after a long closure, reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_sweet_fountain_mototanaka.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tarts, crumbles, brownies and cookies (Tabelog reviews).
kyoto_sweet_fountain_mototanaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cheesecake, cream cakes and butter pastries (Tabelog reviews).
kyoto_sweet_fountain_mototanaka.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:00–20:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Whole birthday cakes need booking at least two days ahead (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). Two counter seats for eating in; coffee, tea and jasmine tea ¥200 each; takeaway; non-smoking (Tabelog). Right by Eiden Mototanaka Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_sweet_fountain_mototanaka.notes: [Cake shop · Mototanaka Stn] A tiny, cheap neighbourhood cake shop by Eiden Mototanaka Station with two seats: simple homemade slices around ¥300 — lemon tart, baked cheesecake, clafoutis — and whole cakes to order. Cash only; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: A small neighbourhood cake shop; reviewers since 2018 describe its homemade feel. Recent detail is thin: two 2026 visits (January and March).
chef_bio.philosophy: Snacks for every day, with moderate butter and sugar and few additives (October 2024 review).

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 visitor found the eat-in space would be cramped with more customers, so took a lemon tart outside and called it easy to finish.
An October 2024 customer bought a whole lemon tart.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: スイートファウンテン ケーキショップ、ケーキ、左京区田中大久保町22、叡電元田中駅のすぐ近く、火〜日 11:00〜20:00、月曜休み、予約可、誕生日ケーキは2日前までに予約、カード・電子マネー不可、カウンター2席、コーヒー・紅茶・ジャスミン茶各200円、テイクアウト、禁煙。口コミ (2026年1月、英語): 一切れ300円台、なめらかなクリームのレモンタルト。それ以前の口コミ (2018〜2024年): ベイクドチーズケーキ、バナナのコーヒークリームケーキ、いちごやバナナのクラフティ、アップルクランブル180円、ピーナッツバターブルーベリー150円、ブラウニー、クッキー、予約のホールケーキ2,280円、バターと砂糖は控えめで添加物をなるべく使わない。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the showcase; cash only.

kyoto_tenryu_nishioji_hachijo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles, gyoza, shumai and fried chicken (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_tenryu_nishioji_hachijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone soy broth, chashu and kara-age (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_tenryu_nishioji_hachijo.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri and Sat 11:30–13:45 and 17:30–22:30 (last order 22:00); holidays 17:30–24:00; closed Thursday and Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cash only, paid after eating (Tabelog; October 2026 review). 22 seats — a counter of 10 and three tables for 4; smoking allowed (Tabelog; October 2026 review). Three parking spaces to the south, in a factory-like spot (Tabelog). On the east side of Nishioji just south of Hachijo, 3 min north of JR Nishioji Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_tenryu_nishioji_hachijo.notes: [Showa ramen & kara-age · Nishioji-Hachijo] A long-running ramen shop under a yellow "kara-age" sign, run by an elderly couple: nostalgic soy pork-bone ramen from ¥800, a ¥1,000 set with kara-age and rice, and juicy thigh kara-age with beer. Cash only; smoking allowed; closed Thursday and Sunday.

chef_bio.background: A Showa-era ramen shop, "run by an elderly couple" (August 2025) and described as family-run and long popular (July 2025). Signed cards from celebrities, including Hiroshi Tamaki and Yokohama BayStars players, hang inside (November 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 diner who had wondered for 20 years whether this shop is related to a Tenryu at Kitaoji found it full and the owner friendly.
A January 2026 diner rated the ¥750 thigh kara-age the perfect partner for beer.
Regulars drink beer or sake with the kara-age, an October 2026 diner noticed, and the chef's warm hospitality stood out.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 天龍、ラーメン、下京区西大路八条下東側、JR西大路駅から北へ徒歩約3分、市バス西大路八条 (東側)、月・火・水・金・土 11:30〜13:45・17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)、祝日 17:30〜24:00、木・日休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、22席 (カウンター10、4名テーブル3)、喫煙可、駐車場3台。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 昭和からの老舗、高齢の夫婦が営む、家族経営、黄色い「からあげ」の看板、醤油豚骨ラーメン800円 (細いストレート麺、チャーシュー、もやし、ねぎ、メンマ)、博多風ラーメン、特製醤油ラーメン、チャーシュー麺、唐揚げ2個・漬物・ご飯のラーメンセット1,000円、昼の唐揚げセット +200円、もも唐揚げ750円、手羽先、餃子、焼売、有名人のサイン、現金の後払い。

cultural_comfort.note: Old local shop; smoking allowed; cash only.

kyoto_afuhi_shimogamo.gf_detail: Ask. The soba is juwari — 100% buckwheat (October 2026 review) — but the dipping sauce and tempura usually contain wheat; not confirmed.
kyoto_afuhi_shimogamo.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; yuba and wild-vegetable soba are offered, but the broth is not described (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_afuhi_shimogamo.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–16:00 or until sold out; irregular closures (Tabelog). An October 2026 visitor found a handwritten sign moving opening to 12:30. No bookings; people queue before 12:00, and tables are mostly for two (Tabelog; May 2026 review). Order by QR code; self-service water (May and August 2026 reviews). Soba can take a long time — up to about 40 minutes, two 2026 reviewers note. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR payment (Tabelog). 30 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English menu; free Wi-Fi; dogs on the two terrace tables only (Tabelog; October 2026 review). 1 min from the Shimogamo-jinja-mae bus stop (Tabelog).
kyoto_afuhi_shimogamo.notes: [Juwari soba · Shimogamo Shrine] A modern, café-like soba house a minute from Shimogamo Shrine, with a dog-friendly terrace: thin juwari soba under fluffy whipped tororo, cold yuba soba, and tempura or tuna-bonito rice sets around ¥1,600. Expect a queue at 12:00 and a slow kitchen. Cash only; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Opened 27 August 2018 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Homemade 100% buckwheat soba from domestic ingredients (October 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: After the Mitarashi pond ritual at Shimogamo Shrine in July 2026, a diner was asked by a Fuji TV crew filming there for permission to photograph the soba.
A March 2026 family on a drive to Shimogamo Shrine were the first customers, with wild-vegetable soba and yuba soba with mini tempura.
In August 2026 the tempura came so quickly, and the soba so slowly, that it was gone before the noodles arrived.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: あふひ、そば・天ぷら・丼、左京区下鴨松ノ木町52-1、Shimogamo-jinja-mae バス停から徒歩1分、毎日 12:00〜16:00 (売り切れ次第終了)、不定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、30席、禁煙、車椅子可、英語メニュー、Wi-Fi、ペット可、ベジタリアンメニュー、2018年8月27日オープン。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): 国産の自家製十割そば、細くてこしのある麺、ふわふわのとろろそばと卵黄、冷やし湯葉のぶっかけそば、山菜おろしそば、湯葉そば、ざるそば、そばとミニ天ぷらかまぐろ節ご飯のセット1,600円、天ぷら約5品、親子丼、そば湯、QR コードで注文、水はセルフ、12時前から行列、テーブルは主に2名、テラスの2卓は犬可、そばが出るまで時間がかかる (約40分という声も)、手書きの貼り紙で12時半開店の日も。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; QR-code ordering.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_daishokaku_shijo.gf_detail: Not GF: house yangnyeom and miso sauces, marinated meats, bean-sprout soup (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_daishokaku_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku restaurant with raw beef dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_daishokaku_shijo.hours_raw: Wednesday–Monday 17:00–1:00 (last order 0:40); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, online too, and usually needed — often full, nearly full at 19:00 on a Saturday (Tabelog; December 2025 and September 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 40 seats: 10 at the counter, tables for 4 and 6; non-smoking (Tabelog). Grill-it-yourself roasters with water underneath and flames at the sides (August 2026). Off a narrow alley in Nishi-Kiyamachi north of Shijo, next to a horse-meat restaurant; 3 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; July and October 2026).
kyoto_daishokaku_shijo.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishi-Kiyamachi, open till 1 a.m.] A lively, good-value yakiniku off a Kiyamachi alley, grilled yourself over water-tray roasters that keep flames low and grease down: tongue, harami and loin with the house yangnyeom, plus omasum and tongue sashimi and yukhoe. One 48-year regular follows it from the Senbon main shop. One Tokyo visitor found the taste average but the price very low. Book ahead; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per a December 2025 review: the reviewer first went to the main branch at Senbon-Nakadachiuri 48 years earlier and moved to the Shijo branch after the Sanjo branch closed; every branch is described as clean, with young, energetic staff. Tabelog lists the Shijo shop as a 40-seat yakiniku open late.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 reviewer has eaten at Daisho Kaku for 48 years, starting at the Senbon main shop, and finishes with bean-sprout soup spiked with yangnyeom.
A February 2026 Tokyo visitor found the taste average, but two large beers and four cuts for about ¥3,000 remarkably cheap.
An August 2026 group of six liked how the water-tray roaster keeps flames low and the meat from turning greasy.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉、中京区西木屋町通四条上る紙屋町368-1 西木屋町ビル 1F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、水〜月 17:00〜翌1:00 (L.O.0:40)、火曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、40席 (カウンター10、テーブル30)、禁煙。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): Senbon-Nakadachiuri の本店に48年通う客 (三条店は閉店)、若く元気な店員、水を張ったロースター、タン、特上ロース、ハラミ、カルビ、ほほ肉、レバー、自家製ヤンニョム、おすすめの味噌だれ、センマイ刺し、タン刺し1,530円、ユッケ1,530円、刺身の盛り合わせ、山盛りのサラダ、もやしのスープ、いつも満席で予約がおすすめ、味は普通だが安いとの声 (2026年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Grill yourself; book ahead; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_kashiwa_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not GF: red marinade sauce, garlic yakiniku-style sauce, soy and ponzu; chicken-skin crackers (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kashiwa_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken and pork grill (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kashiwa_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); 17:30 start on the day before a holiday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; courses must be ordered for the whole party; 2-hour limit at weekends and busy times; bookings released after 15 minutes without notice (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥200 per person (Tabelog original お通し代：お一人様200円(税込)). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 24 seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Seating that one reviewer found hard on the legs and back (September 2025). 1 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn exit 5 (Tabelog). Opened 23 November 2011 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kashiwa_kiyamachi.notes: [Chicken grill · Kiyamachi by Pontocho] A small, smoky shop where you grill your own skewers of named-farm chicken and pork — neck, thigh, sekin, horumon in red sauce — after a plate of chicken tataki or sashimi. Garlic powder and house salt on the side. Some found the service slow or muddled, with a wrong order and a 15-minute wait despite empty tables. Smoking allowed; till midnight.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yakitori and chicken shop opened 23 November 2011 at Kiyamachi; Gurunavi lists it as 鶏豚専門店 かしわ 木屋町店 offering Kyoto-original toriyaki. A November 2025 visitor arrived on its 15th-anniversary special. A May 2026 reviewer praised the owner's service and the many rare cuts, as if a whole bird were butchered in the shop.
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken tataki; grill-it-yourself neck and sekin.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 walk-in ordered heart and harami, received gizzard instead (given free for the mix-up), and the thigh never arrived.
A January 2026 party waited about 15 minutes to be seated though tables were empty, and a couple ahead gave up and left.
A November 2025 visitor happened in on the 15th-anniversary special prices.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼鳥・鶏料理、中京区鍋屋町220-1 1F、阪急京都河原町駅5番出口から徒歩1分、毎日 17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:30)、祝前日 17:30〜、予約可、コースは人数分、週末と混雑時は2時間制、無連絡で15分過ぎると予約取り消し、お通し代1人200円 (税込)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、24席、喫煙可、2011年11月23日開店。ぐるなび: 鶏豚専門店 かしわ 木屋町店、京都元祖の「とりやき」。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年5月、英語): 自分で焼く、鶏のたたき (Satsuma Chiran1,980円)、鶏刺し、せせり、Daisen・Omi black・Amakusa Daisuke・Mukashi の鶏のもも、ハツ、砂肝、レバー、せきん、ハラミ600円、赤たれの肉とホルモンの盛り合わせ1,600円、鶏のソーセージ400円、キムチサラダ680円、鶏皮せんべい、ご飯300円、Sapporo Lager Akaboshi 680円、Kaku のハイボール620円、ガーリックパウダー、15周年、注文違いや出てこない料理があったとの声 (2025年10月)、空席があるのに15分待ったとの声 (2026年1月)、席が足腰につらいとの声 (2025年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Grill yourself; smoking allowed; ¥200 appetizer charge; cards only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through May 2026.

kyoto_teppan_dojo_takasegawa.gf_detail: Not GF: okonomiyaki, tonpei-yaki and yakisoba with sweet sauce, fried chicken (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_dojo_takasegawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, seafood and egg teppan dishes; grilled shiitake and shishito are the vegetable plates seen (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_dojo_takasegawa.hours_raw: Tabelog lists 18:00–11:00 — overnight into the next morning — on Monday–Wednesday and Friday–Sunday; closed Thursday and the third Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reviewers describe it as open until morning (March 2025 and October 2026); one went in at 7:30 a.m. (March 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). Counter and tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog; September 2026). Packed by 18:30 on a Saturday (March 2026). On the Takase River in Nishi-Kiyamachi (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_dojo_takasegawa.notes: [Teppan izakaya · Takase River, all night] A long-standing Kiyamachi teppan bar by the Takase River, where the night ends — or never does: okonomiyaki, tonpei-yaki, squid yakisoba and oyster steak sizzle on the griddle until the next morning, with the river murmuring outside. One February 2026 pair found the drinks a little pricey. Smoking allowed; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews (2025–2026): a teppan izakaya that has long stood in Nishi-Kiyamachi on the Takase River, open until morning and a favourite last stop after a night out. Tabelog lists overnight hours of 18:00–11:00.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner who heard it stayed open until 11 a.m. went in at 7:30 a.m. for chicken-breast sashimi and a large-oyster steak.
A March 2026 pair stayed almost four hours on a Saturday for under ¥5,000 each, the room full within 30 minutes of an 18:00 arrival.
A February 2026 second-stop pair spent ¥7,200 on snacks and drinks and thought the ¥750 highball a little pricey.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お好み焼き・居酒屋、中京区紙屋町674-4、月〜水・金〜日 18:00〜翌11:00、木曜と第3水曜休み、営業時間は変わることあり、予約可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)・QR 可、電子マネー不可、喫煙可。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年10月、英語): 高瀬川沿い、西木屋町の老舗、朝まで営業、朝7時半に入った客も、豚玉、からし付きのとん平焼き、豚キムチ焼きそば1,020円、いか焼きそば830円、牡蠣のステーキ、牛タンステーキ、チーズエッグ、pon-kara、鶏むねの刺身、焼きしいたけ、ししとう、ハイボール750円、焼酎ソーダ500円、芋焼酎、レモンサワー、カウンターとテーブル、土曜18時半には満席、2人で7,200円はやや高いとの声 (2026年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Late-night local bar; smoking allowed; cards and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_ochazuke_bar_eiraku.gf_detail: Ask. Ochazuke with dashi over rice — ume, nozawana, salmon, uni, unagi — plus curry udon and karaage; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ochazuke_bar_eiraku.vegan_detail: Ask. Ume and nozawana ochazuke look plant-based but are served with dashi of unknown make (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ochazuke_bar_eiraku.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 20:00–5:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). In 2024 the 2F ran as a cafe, cafe chi-raku, 15:00–20:00 (September 2024). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). Counter downstairs; 8 seats upstairs, two at the window over the Takase River; smoking allowed (Tabelog; 2024–2025 reviews). Run by one person, so orders can take time (September 2024). Cross a small bridge over the Takase River, north of Shijo (Tabelog; February 2025).
kyoto_ochazuke_bar_eiraku.notes: [Ochazuke bar · Takase River, till 5 a.m.] A tiny bar over a bridge on the Takase River where the night ends with a soothing bowl of ochazuke — ume, nozawana, salmon and uni — or curry udon, served by a friendly owner in samue. A heron that the owner feeds often drops by at the window. One-person service, so be patient. Smoking allowed; cash or QR only; closed Monday.

roles: Owner, who runs the bar alone (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews (2023–2026): an ochazuke bar on the Takase River run by one person, a friendly owner in samue; in 2024 the upstairs also ran as a daytime cafe. A September 2024 reviewer writes that an Ochazuke Bar Eiraku opened in Sendai's Kokubuncho, whose owner the Kyoto owner messaged during the visit.

anecdotes.text: In August 2024 the owner explained that a heron which visits the window is a regular, fed fresh fish, and that several herons come one at a time.
A September 2024 visitor who had first found the Sendai Kokubuncho shop came to see the original, and the owner messaged the Sendai owner about the visit.
A May 2026 diner was unsure the salmon and uni ochazuke was outstanding, but was comforted by the riverside view and the friendly owner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・バー・居酒屋、中京区高瀬川筋四条上る紙屋町674-22、火〜日 20:00〜翌5:00、月曜休み、営業時間は変わることあり、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、喫煙可。口コミ (2023年11月〜2026年5月、英語): 高瀬川沿い、小さな橋を渡る、昼はカフェ (2024年、2階で15:00〜20:00)、1人で営業、作務衣の店主、梅、野沢菜、鮭と雲丹、うなぎのお茶漬け、いくらと鮭の親子丼 (だし) 900円、カレーうどん、唐揚げ、漬物の盛り合わせ、ハイボール、クリームのカフェオレ650円、2階8席・窓際2席、店主が魚をあげる常連の鷺、Sendai Kokubuncho にも店ができたとの声 (2024年9月)、たばこの煙が気になったとの声 (2025年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: One-person bar; smoking allowed; cash or QR only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through May 2026.

kyoto_sundubu_taiko.gf_detail: Ask. Sundubu jjigae on a beef-bone broth, stone-pot bibimbap, chijimi and jeon, japchae and cold noodles; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_sundubu_taiko.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the sundubu broth is beef-bone with seafood (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_sundubu_taiko.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 weekdays (last order 13:15), 11:30–14:30 at weekends and holidays; dinner 17:30–21:00 weekdays (last order 20:15), 17:30–21:30 at weekends and holidays; irregular closures (Tabelog). Bookings until 20:00, by phone for seat requests (Tabelog). ¥600 per person per 15 minutes for seats used past closing (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 19 seats: a 5-seat counter and five tables; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English menu; paper aprons provided (Tabelog; September 2024). 7 min walk from Kyoto Station and Keihan Shichijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_sundubu_taiko.notes: [Korean · east of Kyoto Station, bubbling sundubu] A cosy sundubu shop a short walk east of Kyoto Station, run by a friendly young owner: soft tofu bubbling in a rich beef-bone and seafood broth, spice to your level, with rice and kimchi for about ¥1,000 at lunch. Stone-pot bibimbap, crisp chijimi and japchae round it out; paper aprons supplied. Closing is early (21:00).

roles: Owner not named; a young owner (September 2026); sometimes the manager runs the room alone (May 2026)
chef_bio.background: Opened 29 January 2020 (Tabelog). Tabelog’s introduction: a casual sundubu specialist for solo diners, homemade sundubu jjigae with a rich beef-bone broth simmered with selected chillies, toppings to build your own bowl, paper aprons, lagers and craft beer, and courses with all-you-can-drink.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor’s online booking failed; the young owner explained the booking site was no longer in use and found a table anyway.
An October 2024 diner was not asked for a spice level, got the standard, and started sweating.
A February 2026 office worker found the sundubu less fiery than it looked, with a tangy edge.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 純豆腐太閤、韓国料理・冷麺・居酒屋、下京区上之町14-2 崇仁市営住宅61棟103、京都駅と京阪七条駅から徒歩7分、平日 11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:15)・17:30〜21:00 (L.O. 20:15)、土日祝 11:30〜14:30・17:30〜21:30、不定休、予約は20時まで、営業時間外の席の利用は15分ごとに1名600円、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、19席 (カウンター5、テーブル)、禁煙、車椅子可、英語メニュー、2020年1月29日オープン。公式紹介: おひとりさまにも、牛骨スープとこだわりの唐辛子の自家製スンドゥブチゲ、トッピング、紙エプロン、ラガーとクラフトビール、飲み放題付きコース、チャミスル、おまかせコース (2〜6名、60分飲み放題+1,200円)。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): スンドゥブ定食980〜1,080円 (ご飯と小皿3品)、石焼ビビンバ1,150円、辛さ10段階、トッポギのトッピング、チヂミ、ニラとチーズのチヂミ、チャプチェ、ナムル、冷麺、ハーフ&ハーフ、若い店主、店長がひとりの日も。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_seppourai_kyoto_tower.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto-vegetable dishes with nama-fu (wheat gluten), yuba, tofu, tempura and cutlets; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_seppourai_kyoto_tower.vegan_detail: Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options, and an October 2026 diner with a vegetarian colleague found vegetarian, vegan and English menus; dashi and cross-contact are not described (Tabelog; October 2026).
kyoto_seppourai_kyoto_tower.hours_raw: Dinner only: 17:00–23:30 (last order 22:45), Sunday to 23:00 (last order 22:15); open every day; lunch only at the Kyoto Station Building shop (Tabelog). Bookings accepted — not for overseas guests via Tabelog; after 19:00 a 5–10 minute wait is possible; no-shows after 30 minutes are cancelled (Tabelog). Cards, transport IC, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 114 seats with a counter, sunken seats and semi-private rooms; non-smoking with a smoking room (Tabelog). Entrance from outside on Karasuma-dori, between Starbucks and Matsumoto Kiyoshi, not from inside Kyoto Tower; 2F of the Kyoto Tower building, 3 min walk from Kyoto Station (Tabelog; several 2026 reviews).
kyoto_seppourai_kyoto_tower.notes: [Izakaya · Kyoto Tower building, Kyoto vegetables] A calm, roomy izakaya on the 2nd floor of the Kyoto Tower building (enter from the street, between Starbucks and Matsumoto Kiyoshi) serving Kyoto vegetables, yuba and nama-fu: an obanzai basket, yuba rolls, vegetable tempura and seasonal courses from about ¥4,300. Vegetarian and vegan menus. Semi-private rooms; open till 23:30 daily.

roles: Chefs not named; operated by 株式会社黛 (invoice register)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s introduction: creative Kyoto cuisine by skilled chefs using seasonal Kyoto vegetables, nama-fu and yuba, with a seasonal obanzai basket; a sister shop in the Kyoto Station Building serves lunch. The qualified-invoice holder is 株式会社黛 of Nakagyo, Kyoto (NTA).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner with a vegetarian colleague found everything but the tsukune vegetable-based, with vegetarian, vegan and English menus.
An August 2026 business guest got lost at the Kyoto Tower doors before finding the street entrance by Starbucks.
A July 2026 traveller found the Station Building shop full and came here, noting another guest had gone to the wrong branch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 接方来 京都タワー店、居酒屋・野菜料理・豆腐料理、下京区烏丸通七条下ル東塩小路町721-1 京都タワービル2F、京都駅から徒歩3分、京都タワービルの中からは入れない、烏丸通のスターバックスとマツモトキヨシの間の入口、月〜土・祝前日 17:00〜23:30 (L.O. 22:45)、日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:15)、無休、ランチは京都駅ビル店のみ、海外の方の食べログ予約は不可、19時以降は5〜10分待つことも、30分遅れで連絡がなければキャンセル、カード・電子マネー・QR可、114席、半個室、掘りごたつ、禁煙 (喫煙室あり)、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン対応、インボイス T8130001022725 (株式会社黛)。公式紹介: 季節の京野菜、生麩、湯葉の創作京料理、「旬のおばんざい籠盛り」、SNS映えのオリジナルドリンク。口コミ (2026年、英語): 京水菜と海老の湯葉巻き、黒毛和牛の冷しゃぶサラダ、おぼろ豆腐、野菜の天ぷら、ねぎ入りのとんかつ、夏のジュレ、秋の京野菜コース4,300円、貴船コース、京都限定の抹茶ビール、ノンアルコールカクテル、半個室、ベジタリアン・ヴィーガン・英語のメニュー。

cultural_comfort.note: English, vegetarian and vegan menus (October 2026 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing with online booking; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_dining_masayoshi.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu sukiyaki in a sweet soy broth with nama-fu, steaks with several sauces, shabu-shabu and roast-beef bento; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_dining_masayoshi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu sukiyaki and steak house (official site).
kyoto_dining_masayoshi.hours_raw: 11:00–22:00 daily (last food order 21:30) (official site; Tabelog). Bookings by phone or online; no lunch bookings for the weekday steak set (September 2026). No service charge (Tabelog original text: なし). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 44 seats: an 8-seat counter and tables on the ground floor, semi-private and private rooms upstairs for 2–20; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). In a renovated 150-year-old townhouse on Ryoma-dori, one street south of Sanjo, behind Rokuyosha; 5 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn (official site; August 2026).
kyoto_dining_masayoshi.notes: [Wagyu sukiyaki and steak · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, a 150-year-old townhouse] A stylishly renovated machiya with a little garden on Ryoma-dori behind Rokuyosha: steaks on the teppan downstairs, sukiyaki in private rooms upstairs. Whole-carcass kuroge wagyu; the sukiyaki comes with grated yam as well as egg (courses about ¥5,800, Matsusaka higher). A weekday steak lunch for about ¥1,200 fills by 11:30. Open daily 11:00–22:00.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2016 (Tabelog). Per the official site: a Kyoto dining room on Ryoma-dori in a renovated 150-year-old townhouse mixing Japanese and Western antiques; kuroge wagyu chosen by craftsmen and bought as whole animals, served in private rooms.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: whole-animal purchasing for fine marbling and the meat’s true depth of flavour, served the way each guest likes it.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 lunch guest returning after years found every seat taken at 11:30 for the ¥1,200 steak.
A September 2026 diner dipped sukiyaki in grated yam for the first time and might prefer it to egg.
An October 2026 lunch guest in the food trade was served ten minutes after later arrivals.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (dining-masayoshi.com): 京都ダイニング 正義、京都河原町より徒歩圏内、三条通より1本南の竜馬通、築150年の京町家をリノベート、和とアンティーク、一頭買い黒毛和牛と築150年京町家、個室で味わう極上の刻、職人が厳選した黒毛和牛を一頭買い、中京区河原町三条下ル大黒町45、11:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)。食べログ: ステーキ・日本料理・すき焼き、京阪三条駅・市役所前駅から徒歩5分、毎日 11:00〜22:00、サービス料なし、カード・PayPay可、44席 (カウンター8、テーブル16、半個室20)、個室2〜20名、禁煙、子ども可、2016年5月1日オープン。公式紹介: 黒毛和牛のすき焼きコース (3種の肉から)、松阪牛と国産豚の京風しゃぶしゃぶ、個室限定の和牛錦弁当 (すき焼きとイチボのローストビーフ、酢飯)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 六曜社の裏、小さな庭、平日のステーキランチ1,200円 (150g、ご飯、サラダ、小鉢、ソース6種ほど)、ハラミステーキのランチ、黒毛和牛のすき焼きコース5,800円、松阪牛のコース、とろろで食べるすき焼き、1階は鉄板焼き、2階の個室。

cultural_comfort.note: Private rooms upstairs; online booking.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_yakiniku_enen_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Yakiniku with sauces, yukhoe, wagyu temari sushi, cheese bibimbap and rice bowls; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_enen_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku house (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiniku_enen_pontocho.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30) daily; lunch 11:00–14:00 on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays; closed 1 January (Tabelog; July 2026). Bookings recommended — few seats (October 2026); birthday cakes by phone only (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 36 seats over two floors, with counter and sofa seats; non-smoking with a smoking area outside; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog; August 2026). On Pontocho, 2 min walk from Kawaramachi and Gion-Shijo Stns (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiniku_enen_pontocho.notes: [Yakiniku · Pontocho, A5 wagyu with flair] A stylish two-floor yakiniku house on Pontocho serving A5 kuroge wagyu at fair prices with a French-leaning touch — wagyu temari sushi, yukhoe, thick tongue and skirt. Weekend lunch brings yukhoe and steak rice-bowl tasting sets (about ¥2,000). Dinner about ¥5,000–10,000. Book ahead; closed only on New Year's Day.

roles: Chef not named; 株式会社ｅｎｅｎ (invoice register)
chef_bio.background: Opened 8 March 2020 (Tabelog). Tabelog’s introduction: A5 kuroge wagyu with a French twist, popular with women, two shops in Kyoto city; signature kuroge wagyu temari sushi; lunch tasting series of yukhoe-don, steak-don and sukiyaki. The qualified-invoice holder is 株式会社ｅｎｅｎ of Shimogyo, Kyoto (NTA); our crawl also lists 京都餃子enen 祇園本店.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog’s introduction: to lower the threshold of Pontocho with quality beef at reasonable prices.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner took the salad’s white topping for cheese; it was white wasabi, very hot.
A May 2026 first-timer was shown how to eat each cut but wished the staff would grill the best meat.
A repeat October 2026 guest on a date always orders the tongue, yukhoe and meat sushi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都焼肉 enen 先斗町本店、焼肉・ホルモン・韓国料理、中京区鍋屋町209-13、阪急京都河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩2分、平日 17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、土日祝 11:00〜14:00・17:00〜22:00、元日休み、誕生日ケーキの予約は電話のみ、チャージ料なし、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、36席、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、車椅子可、Wi-Fi、2020年3月8日オープン、インボイス T1120901030677 (株式会社ｅｎｅｎ)。公式紹介: 女性に人気、フレンチの要素を取り入れたA5黒毛和牛の焼肉、京都市内に2店舗、名物の黒毛和牛手まり寿司、ユッケ丼・ステーキ丼・すき焼きの食べ比べのランチ、先斗町の敷居を下げる。口コミ (2026年、英語): 追いネギタン1,408円、厚切りハラミ1,408円、特選和牛ハラミ2,068円、和牛切り落とし盛り1,700円、白菜キムチ650円、生ビール750円、九州レモンサワー650円、6種盛り、ユッケ、タタキ、チーズビビンバ、コース3種、ユッケ丼・ステーキ丼の食べ比べ1,980円、大盛り+100円、2階席、席数は少なめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; staff explain the cuts.

kyoto_kyo_no_jidoriya_aki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kara-age, tare yakitori, oyakodon and oden (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_no_jidoriya_aki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: jidori chicken and duck throughout (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_no_jidoriya_aki.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 12:00–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed one Thursday a month. Reservations taken; 30 minutes late counts as a cancellation. Charge ¥450 — Tabelog, Japanese original 「450円」. 25 seats: 7 at the counter and 4 at tables downstairs, 14 at tables upstairs up a steep staircase (April 2026). Non-smoking. School-age children welcome; call ahead for younger ones. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay; no e-money. Beside Nishiki Market on Gokomachi.
kyoto_kyo_no_jidoriya_aki.notes: [Jidori chicken · Nishiki Market, yakitori and a hot-plate lunch] A small two-floor chicken izakaya right by Nishiki Market: charcoal yakitori, duck, tender kara-age and oden at night, and a sizzling chicken-and-Kujo-leek set or oyakodon at lunch — a real meal amid the market snacks. Two diners noticed an odour in some skewers (April 2026); the stairs are steep. ¥450 charge.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a cosy two-floor room with a young, attentive staff, many international guests, signed celebrity photos on the walls (August 2026), and grilling over charcoal in front of guests. One August 2026 reviewer calls it the "Nishiki branch", but no other branch was identified.

anecdotes.text: April 2026, a grill cook from Fukuoka: the negima "used chicken neck, but I was disappointed to find a strong odor from the first bite… the 'Duck Breast' and 'Duck Shoulder' were rich in flavor and very delicious."
March 2026: "Since Nishiki Market tends to have overpriced light snacks, I recommend this place if you want a proper meal."
April 2026: "the stairs were quite steep, so be careful with your footing… Some pieces of meat had a slight odor, but the duck yakitori was delicious!"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京のじどり屋 晃、居酒屋・焼鳥・串焼き、中京区御幸町通錦小路上ル船屋町398、四条河原町から徒歩すぐ、毎日 12:00〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)・17:00〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:00、ドリンク L.O. 22:30)、月1回木曜休み、予約可、30分過ぎでキャンセル、原文で「450円」、25席 (1階カウンター7・テーブル4、2階テーブル14)、禁煙、小学生以上可、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): 錦市場のそば、昼は鶏ハラミと九条ねぎの焼肉定食1,600円・親子丼1,400円・ご飯は大中小、夜は炭火の焼鳥 (ハラミ、ねぎま、山椒のつくね、皮)、鴨胸と鴨肩、れんこん、名物の唐揚げ、燻製とポテトサラダ、おでん、おにぎり、お通しのキャベツと鶏味噌、若いスタッフ、海外の客、有名人のサイン、階段が急、ねぎまに臭みという声が2件。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests; ¥450 charge; steep stairs.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_ippei_chaya_miyagawacho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kabura-mushi with a thickened dashi sauce, nama-fu, tempura and soy-seasoned dishes (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ippei_chaya_miyagawacho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi throughout; sashimi, shrimp, eel and fish in the kabura-mushi (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ippei_chaya_miyagawacho.hours_raw: Tabelog: 12:00–21:00 straight through; closed Thursday. Reservations taken; the premium kabura-mushi set must be booked the day before (February 2026). 10% service charge in the second-floor tatami room only — Tabelog, Japanese original 「サービス料2階席のみ10％」. 25 seats: two tables for 4 and two tatami seats for 2 downstairs, 15 upstairs. Non-smoking. Children and strollers welcome. Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; March 2026). On Kawabata-dori just south of Minamiza, 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn.
kyoto_ippei_chaya_miyagawacho.notes: [Kyoto cooking · Gion-Shijo, kabura-mushi since 1928] A wood-lined old house on Kawabata-dori by Minamiza, serving Kyoto home-style kaiseki since 1928, best known for kabura-mushi — fluffy grated turnip over fish in thick dashi — in a ¥5,500 set with sashimi and hassun, open straight through from noon. Portions suit lighter eaters (March 2026). Cash only; 10% service upstairs. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per its Tabelog text, a long-established restaurant on Kawabata-dori serving seasonal Kyoto cuisine at this spot since 1928, in a wood-warm interior. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a Showa-era house, an elegant owner and head waitress (October 2026), private rooms upstairs for families, and dishes made with care.

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "The portion size was just right for women, but men might find it a bit lacking. Please note that payment is cash only!"
October 2026: "Many traditional restaurants can feel a bit intimidating… but this place was different. The owner, the head waitress, and the staff were all elegant and wonderful people."
February 2026: "I always order the 'Jou Kabura Mushi Set Meal' (JPY 7700, reservation required one day in advance)."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 一平茶屋、日本料理・天ぷら・魚介料理、東山区宮川筋1丁目219、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、12:00〜21:00、木曜休み、予約可、原文で「サービス料2階席のみ10％」、25席 (1階テーブル4名×2・座敷2名×2、2階15名)、禁煙、子供・ベビーカー可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、川端通で1928年からこの地で営む京料理の老舗、夏は鱧と賀茂なす、冬は海老芋と聖護院かぶ、湯葉と生麩。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年11月、英語): かぶら蒸し定食5,500円 (先付、八寸、お造り、ご飯、香の物)、上かぶら蒸し定食7,700円 (前日までに予約)、おまかせ11,000円、だし巻、天ぷら、鯖寿司、たこの煮物、南座の南、昭和の家、上品な店主と仲居頭、2階の個室、量は女性向けという声、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; 10% service upstairs; book the premium set a day ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_steak_misono_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Ask: steaks are grilled with natural Ako salt on the teppan, but garlic chips, sauces, salads and set sides share the plate (official site; 2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_steak_misono_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu and Kobe beef steak, lobster and abalone (official site; reviews).
kyoto_steak_misono_kawaramachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:30–14:30 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00; arrive for dinner by 21:00); closed at New Year. Reservations a must (February 2025). Dinner only: 10% service and ¥700 table charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「ディナータイムのみサービス料10％、テーブルチャージ700円」. Cancellation fees without notice: 30% of the meal plus tax if the menu was set, otherwise ¥3,300 a person. 35 seats, every one at a teppan; window seats over Kawaramachi. Designated smoking area. Children welcome. Tabelog lists halal options (no certification claim seen). Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR. 5F of the Aoyama Kawaramachi Building. Menu fully renewed from May 2026 (official site).
kyoto_steak_misono_kawaramachi.notes: [Teppanyaki steak · Kawaramachi, the Kobe originators' Kyoto branch] The Kyoto branch, five floors above Kawaramachi, of Kobe's Misono (1945), which claims the first teppanyaki steak: Kobe beef and A5 wagyu seared in front of you with garlic chips, lobster and abalone, and a good-value ¥2,500 steak lunch. A regular notes prices have risen (February 2026); one diner found the manager too talkative (August 2023). Dinner adds 10% service and ¥700 table charge.

roles: Not named in a source; Kyoto branch of みその (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, みその was born in Kobe in 1945 and says it was the first in the world to serve teppanyaki steak; it now has its Kobe main shop, this Kyoto shop and a Shinjuku shop, grades its own A4 and A5 wagyu, and puts flavour ahead of performance. Reviewers from 2023 to 2026 describe chefs cooking at every seat, a retro, calm room with a city view, and long-time regulars.
chef_bio.philosophy: From the site: "パフォーマンスよりも、美味しさを最優先" (flavour first, before performance).
chef_bio.specialty: Kobe beef and wagyu teppanyaki steak.

anecdotes.text: August 2023: "The manager's performance was outstanding... I couldn't stop talking... but I realized that it's better for the staff to be good listeners rather than just good talkers."
February 2026, a regular: "I must admit that prices have increased compared to the past, which is understandable."
September 2025: "With a salad and a drink included, I think a JPY 2500 lunch in this location is quite a bargain."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 元祖 鉄板焼ステーキ みその、1945 (昭和20) 年から、鉄板焼ステーキを世界で初めて提供した老舗、神戸本店・京都店・新宿店、最高級の神戸ビーフと全国の黒毛和牛を独自に格付け (A4・A5)、パフォーマンスより美味しさを優先、神戸の酒蔵「福寿」の純米酒、京都店のメニューを2026年5月から全面リニューアル。食べログ: ステーキ みその 京都店、ステーキ・鉄板焼き、中京区河原町通蛸薬師下る奈良屋町300 青山河原町ビル 5F、毎日 11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 13:30)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、年末年始休み、原文で「ディナータイムのみサービス料10％、テーブルチャージ700円」、無断キャンセルの料金、35席、全席に鉄板、喫煙所、ハラール対応の表示、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、2cmの鉄板、赤穂の天然塩、活伊勢海老と鮑。口コミ (2023年3月〜2026年2月、英語): ステーキランチ (サラダ・ご飯・味噌汁)、2,500円の「No」と4,000円の「So」のコース、みそのコース、1万円のランチコース、夜は1万2千円ほどのコース、伊勢海老と神戸牛、ガーリックチップ、窓から河原町の眺め、店長の話が多いという声、値上がりしたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests; dinner adds 10% service and ¥700 table charge.

existence.note: Official site (Kyoto menu renewed May 2026); Tabelog reviews through February 2026.
