kyoto_sakedokoro_monka_pontocho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: shumai, avocado fries, whole-wheat crackers, macaroni salad and soy-based dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakedokoro_monka_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: grilled pork, chicken tofu, liver, sashimi, prairie-oyster egg (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakedokoro_monka_pontocho.hours_raw: Tabelog: 14:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Wednesday and irregular days — check Instagram. Reservations taken. 30 seats: a 10-person U-shaped standing counter downstairs and tables for 20 upstairs. Designated smoking area — e-cigarettes allowed, regular cigarettes not (March 2026). Cards and e-money; no QR. Down the 17th alley off Pontocho (south side), no sign on the street. Opened 31 March 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sakedokoro_monka_pontocho.notes: [Standing bar · Pontocho alley, afternoon sake and shumai] A hidden two-floor tavern down a Pontocho alley, opened in 2025 and themed on taverns in literature: a U-shaped standing counter for cheap afternoon sake, homemade shumai and retro snacks like a prairie oyster, and a mid-century dining room upstairs overlooking Pontocho. Diners note a cool welcome (March 2026), a short drinks list (October 2026) and dishes selling out late. Opens 14:00; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 31 March 2025 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a townhouse-style space with no street sign, a standing counter run by a single person at a quiet time (March 2026), stylish mid-century tables and lighting upstairs, and a crowd of locals, women in small groups and couples.

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "There was no greeting… the staff seemed a bit indifferent… The shumai, kitsune-yaki, Showa-style macaroni salad, and green pepper with tororo kombu were all delicious."
March 2026: two servings of sake, two bottles of beer, tuna sashimi, grilled kitsune and chicken tofu came to "just over JPY 2000 per person."
October 2026: "While the selection of drinks wasn't extensive, the food was delicious, and the Kanpachi (amberjack) was incredibly rich."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒処 文架、居酒屋、中京区先斗町通四条上ル下樵木町204-9 17番路地南側、14:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、水曜と不定休 (Instagram で)、予約可、30席 (1階立ち飲みカウンター10、2階テーブル20)、喫煙所 (加熱式は可、紙巻きは不可)、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、2025年3月31日オープン。口コミ (2026年2〜10月、英語): 文学の中の酒場がテーマ、看板のない路地奥、自家製しゅうまい660円、アボカドフライ990円、焼き豚の盛り合わせ1,320円、いちじくバターと全粒粉のクラッカー660円、プレーリーオイスター330円、昭和のマカロニサラダ550円、鶏豆腐、きつね焼き、レバー、漬物、鯛とレタスのぬた、春菊のナムル、カンパチ、日本酒と熱燗、サッポロラガー、U字の立ち飲みカウンター、2階のミッドセンチュリーの席、挨拶がなく素っ気ないという声、酒の種類は多くないという声、遅い時間は品切れ。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing counter downstairs; no street sign.

kyoto_kyo_no_izakaya_ponto.gf_detail: Ask. Izakaya plates — nama-fu (wheat gluten) tempura and grilled nama-fu, yakitori and tsukune with sauce, karaage, croquettes, somen; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_no_izakaya_ponto.vegan_detail: Ask. Tofu salad and grilled nama-fu appear, but sauces and dashi are not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_no_izakaya_ponto.hours_raw: 16:00–22:00 daily; hours may change (Tabelog). Charge ¥400 (Tabelog remarks). On the summer river deck (noryo-yuka), courses only, and lunch there is ¥2,500 with one drink (Tabelog remarks); the deck needs a reservation with a mini course and has a time limit (July and August 2026). QR payments only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 32 seats (Tabelog). At the south entrance of Pontocho, 2 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo or Hankyu Kawaramachi (Tabelog; July 2026).
kyoto_kyo_no_izakaya_ponto.notes: [Izakaya · Pontocho, an affordable river deck] A lively izakaya at the south end of Pontocho run by young staff, with one of the cheaper summer decks over the Kamo: nama-fu tempura, teppan yakitori, tofu salad and karaage, and a mini course on the deck. Several reviewers found the food ordinary but the riverside seat worth it. ¥400 charge; QR payment only.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe young, friendly staff (July and September 2026) and a wall of celebrity autographs (July 2026). Several 2025–2026 reviewers say most of the customers were overseas visitors (July 2025, July, September and October 2026). Two July and October 2026 reviewers found the food ordinary for the price, while others enjoyed the nama-fu and fried dishes.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 pair dropped in on a busy holiday on a whim and still got a table outside.
An August 2026 diner liked it enough to recommend it to visitors from abroad on the way out.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京の居酒屋 ぽんと、居酒屋、中京区先斗町四条上ル鍋屋町232-13、京阪祇園四条駅・阪急河原町駅から徒歩2分、16:00〜22:00、チャージ400円 (備考)、納涼床はコースのみ、床の昼は1ドリンク付き2,500円、QR決済のみ、32席。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 先斗町の入口、鴨川の床が手頃、生麩の天ぷらと焼き生麩、鉄板で焼く焼き鳥とつくね、豆腐サラダ、牛キムチそうめん、唐揚げ、かぼちゃのコロッケ、刺身はない、若い店員、海外からの客が多い、料理は値段なりという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Popular with overseas visitors (2025–2026 reviews); QR payment only; ¥400 charge.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_daitoryo_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Yuba kaiseki — hassun, clear soup, yuba hot pot, sashimi, grilled eel with yuba, fried yuba, eggplant dengaku; no gluten information (reviews).
kyoto_daitoryo_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the yuba courses are built on dashi and include eel and fish (reviews).
kyoto_daitoryo_pontocho.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 (L.O. food 20:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Service charge 10%, 13% from May to September (Tabelog, original サービス料10％（5月～9月は13％）). Cards (Tabelog). 30 seats over two floors; private rooms for 6, 8 and 10–20; a summer deck over the Kamo (Tabelog; reviews). Children under 9: give ages and numbers when booking, and the restaurant may not always be able to accept children; from 9, adult meals; no diaper-changing facilities (Tabelog). On Pontocho, about 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi or Keihan Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_daitoryo_pontocho.notes: [Yuba kaiseki · Pontocho over the Kamo] A Pontocho house serving yuba and tofu kaiseki — clear soups, a yuba hot pot in white dashi, grilled eel with yuba — in rooms and, in summer, on a deck above the Kamo. 10% service (13% May–September); children under 9 by arrangement; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a long-standing Pontocho restaurant for yuba kaiseki with river views and private rooms; only one review falls in 2025–2026 (April 2026).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 guest called the river-view seat and the yuba course a cherished memory.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 大當両、日本料理・豆腐料理・鍋、中京区先斗町通四条上ル鍋屋町232-8、阪急河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、17:00〜22:00 (L.O.料理20:30)、水曜定休、サービス料10% (5〜9月は13%)、カード可、30席 (1階2人席4、2階2〜4人席5)、個室あり、9歳未満の子どもは予約時に人数と年齢を、9歳以上は大人の料理。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 湯葉の会席、八寸、お吸い物、湯葉鍋、鰻と湯葉の焼き物、酢の物、豆乳鍋、鮎の塩焼き、賀茂なすの田楽、湯葉のコース8,000円ほど (2024年9月)、夏の床、鱧のコースは前日までに予約。

cultural_comfort.note: Service charge 10–13%; children under 9 by arrangement.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; latest review April 2026.

kyoto_toriton_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Chicken and pork izakaya dishes — chicken tataki, rare chicken-breast katsu, karaage, tsukune, white dashimaki, obanzai, TKG; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_toriton_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Kyoto Akadori chicken and Kyoto pork izakaya; the dashimaki is made with dashi (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_toriton_pontocho.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); days off vary (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Tsukidashi ¥500 including tax (Tabelog, original 付きだし500円(税込)頂戴しております。). Happy hour until 19:00 with all drinks ¥400 (June 2026). Cards (Tabelog). 22 seats — counter, tables and a fully private room for up to 10, all with sunken kotatsu seating; shoes off (Tabelog; February 2026). Bring your own cake for celebrations; the restaurant will keep it chilled (Tabelog). Down Pontocho alley no. 21, 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi (Tabelog).
kyoto_toriton_pontocho.notes: [Chicken izakaya · Pontocho back alley, white dashimaki] A cosy townhouse izakaya down a narrow Pontocho alley, all sunken-kotatsu seats: Kyoto Akadori chicken as tataki, rare katsu and tsukune, a fluffy white dashimaki, obanzai and TKG, with ¥400 drinks until 19:00. ¥500 tsukidashi; shoes off.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes Kyoto pork and Kyo Akadori chicken, a course with white-dashi tamagoyaki of pearl eggs, and vegetables from partner farms. An August 2026 reviewer quotes the owner’s thank-you note on the wall to guests who chose Toriton among Kyoto’s many restaurants.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 visitor slipped off shoes for the kotatsu counter and found a consommé cabbage roll as the tsukidashi.
A June 2026 guest made the most of happy hour, when every drink was ¥400 until 19:00.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: とりとん、居酒屋、中京区鍋屋町209-5 先斗町通り21番路地、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩3分、17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、不定休、付きだし500円 (税込)、カード可、22席 (カウンター、テーブル、完全個室、全席掘りごたつ)、個室は10名まで、京都ポークと京赤地どり、パールエッグの白だし玉子焼き、契約農家の野菜、ケーキの持ち込み可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): むね・ももの半々のたたき、レアのむねカツ、鶏刺し、ユッケ、卵黄ご飯、唐揚げ、つくね、手羽先、豚しゃぶサラダ、おばんざい、卵かけご飯、肉じゃが、19時までのハッピーアワーはドリンク400円、店主の感謝のことば。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off; sunken kotatsu seats; ¥500 tsukidashi.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_fushimigura_minamian.gf_detail: Ask. Duck dishes in Japanese, Western and Chinese styles — duck hot pot, dobin-mushi, menchi, yukhoe, spring rolls, mini tantanmen — plus tempura and fish; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_fushimigura_minamian.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a duck-and-fish restaurant (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_fushimigura_minamian.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30); dinner 16:30–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); open daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted — for à la carte, book seats only rather than a course (Tabelog). Service charge 10% included in prices (Tabelog, original サービス料10％込み). Cards, Edy, iD and QR payments (Tabelog). 52 seats: a counter downstairs and private rooms upstairs (Tabelog; February 2026). On Pontocho, about 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi; lanterns mark the house (Tabelog; February 2026). Opened 20 March 2015 (Tabelog).
kyoto_fushimigura_minamian.notes: [Duck and sake · Pontocho, Fushimi sake] A lantern-lit Pontocho house with a counter downstairs and private rooms above, cooking duck every which way — hot pot, dobin-mushi, menchi, yukhoe — with seasonal fish and a long list of Fushimi sake, including free-flow course plans from ¥6,600. Lunch from ¥2,420; service included.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T7130002023987 is registered to 有限会社シーアンドディー, Kyoto (NTA register); how many restaurants it runs could not be established. Reviewers mention pleasant staff in the dining room (October 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto duck hot pot; Fushimi sake.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 group warmed up on a chilly night with the duck hot pot and worked through the free-flow sake list.
An October 2025 party celebrated an old student-days senior’s retirement here.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京都伏見蔵 先斗町 南庵、居酒屋・日本料理・日本酒バー、中京区鍋屋町212-2、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、昼12:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、夜16:30〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、予約可 (アラカルトは席のみ予約)、サービス料10%込み、カード・電子マネー・QR決済可、52席、個室あり、2015年3月20日オープン、和洋中の鴨料理と旬の魚と伏見の地酒、伏見米ヒノヒカリの銀シャリ御膳2,420円から、京鴨鍋の飲み放題コース7,260円、京鴨と鮮魚のコース7品6,600円、適格請求書 T7130002023987 (有限会社シーアンドディー)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 鴨の土瓶蒸し、京鴨と九条ねぎ、鴨メンチ、湯葉チーズ巻き、鴨ユッケ、ミニ担々麺、鴨と夏野菜の春巻き、とうもろこしの天ぷら、伏見の酒の飲み放題、1階はカウンター、2階は個室。

cultural_comfort.note: Service included; private rooms upstairs.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_horumon_tonkin.gf_detail: Ask. Grill-your-own pork offal with salt or sauce, half and half on request (2023–25 reviews); the sauce is likely soy-based; no gluten information.
kyoto_horumon_tonkin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a pork and chicken offal yakiniku shop (2019–26 reviews).
kyoto_horumon_tonkin.hours_raw: Mon, Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays 18:00–23:00; closed Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, by phone from 14:00 on open days; two-hour limit (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「なし」 — the English page mistranslates this as a charge being added). 16 seats: a counter of 5 and three tables (Tabelog). Heated tobacco only; no under-20s (Tabelog). 4 min from Eiden Mototanaka (Tabelog).
kyoto_horumon_tonkin.notes: [Pork-offal yakiniku · Mototanaka, a one-man grill counter] A 16-seat specialist near Eiden Mototanaka grilling pork — and some chicken — offal you rarely see elsewhere: an eight-cut mix in salt or sauce, simmered offal to start, fresh chicken sashimi. Light, clean-tasting and cheap. Cash only; dinner Friday to Monday; book by phone.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a pork-offal restaurant near Mototanaka. A May 2022 review says the owner runs everything alone; an August 2025 regular of several years describes a gruff-looking but friendly chef.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 regular says no meal here starts without the ¥500 simmered offal, and warns that it is closed midweek.
A June 2024 diner walked from Kyoto Tower on a 35.9 °C day and drank four bottles of beer with the heart and skirt.
A February 2024 first-timer was surprised how light pork offal is compared with beef.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ホルモン、左京区田中西大久保町14-5、叡電元田中駅から徒歩4分、月金土日祝18:00〜23:00、火水木休み、予約可 (営業日の14時以降)、2時間制、現金のみ、サービス料なし、16席 (カウンター5、テーブル3)、加熱式たばこのみ可で20歳未満は入店不可。口コミ (2019年11月〜2026年7月、英語): 豚ホルモンの専門店、店主が一人で営む、豚の煮込み500円、ホルモン8種盛り2,000〜2,400円 (塩、たれ、半々)、珍しい部位、臭みがない、鶏ホルモンと鶏刺し、バジルオイルの野菜。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone after 14:00; order the mix and choose salt or sauce; cash only; no under-20s. No English evidence found.

kyoto_bar_n_yanagikoji.gf_detail: Ask. About ten obanzai on the counter — simmered vegetables, vinegared octopus, stir-fries (2023–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_bar_n_yanagikoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: obanzai include nikujaga, octopus and salmon dishes, and are dashi-based (2023–25 reviews).
kyoto_bar_n_yanagikoji.hours_raw: Tabelog lists no hours. Reviews describe daytime obanzai and an evening bar; a July 2025 visitor reported Wednesday to Sunday 13:00–21:00, and a January 2026 visitor reported weekday opening from 16:00 — check before going. Closes early (October 2023). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). A counter downstairs and tables upstairs in a restored old building with glass walls (October 2023; April 2025; August 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). At the entrance of Yanagi-koji, 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (Tabelog).
kyoto_bar_n_yanagikoji.notes: [Sake and obanzai · Yanagi-koji, Kawaramachi] A tiny glass-fronted bar at the mouth of the Yanagi-koji alley, sister to the Yanagi-koji TAKA bar: about ten home-style obanzai on the counter, sake poured by the half-go — sometimes one brand at several polishing ratios — and a friendly owner who suggests warm sake in winter. Good for a quick drink or a second stop. Cash only; hours vary, so check.

chef_bio.background: A December 2022 review describes bar N as the second shop of the popular Yanagi-koji TAKA, a bar at night that serves obanzai in the day. Reviews from 2023 to 2026 describe a friendly owner who knows sake.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai with sake by the half-go.

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 visitor liked ordering sake in 90 ml half-go pours and found it easy to chat with the owner.
A January 2026 visitor took the owner's suggestion of warm sake on a cold day with the obanzai from the counter.
A July 2025 returning visitor thought the grilled eggplant needed longer, but loved the rest.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー、中京区中之町577-21 柳小路、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩約2分、営業時間の記載なし、予約可、現金のみ、カウンター、禁煙。口コミ (2022年12月〜2026年8月、英語): 柳小路 TAKA の2号店、昼はおばんざい、夜はバー、カウンターに10種ほどのおばんざい、肉じゃが、なすとトマトの炊いたもの、鮭ときのこの炒め物、蛸ときゅうりとわかめの酢の物、日本酒は半合 (90ml) から、同じ銘柄の精米歩合違い、2025年7月は水〜日13時〜21時、2026年1月は平日16時から。

cultural_comfort.note: Point at the obanzai on the counter; order sake by the half-go; cash only. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_takasegawa_kurio.gf_detail: Ask. Tofu, yuba and hot pots, but also tempura, wheat-gluten (fu) dishes and soy-seasoned sukiyaki (2024–25 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_takasegawa_kurio.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based hot pots, wagyu sukiyaki, Saikyo-miso black cod (2024–25 reviews).
kyoto_takasegawa_kurio.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:30; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, including online via the official site; advised at weekends (Tabelog; September 2024, February 2025). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). A renovated townhouse on the Takase river with window tables upstairs and tatami seating (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Kawaramachi south of Shijo, 3 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (Tabelog).
kyoto_takasegawa_kurio.notes: [Tofu and Kyoto hot pots · Takase river, a riverside townhouse] A renovated townhouse on the Takase river where upstairs window tables look over the water and, in spring, cherry blossoms: fresh yuba, clay-pot tofu, Kujo green onion and wagyu sukiyaki courses from about ¥5,000, and a signature yuzu rice porridge under a whole yuzu. Book at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a dining bar and Japanese restaurant on the Takase river, taking reservations through its website. A September 2024 review from a guest who has come every year for ten years describes an obanzai restaurant in a renovated townhouse.
chef_bio.specialty: Yuba, tofu and Kujo green onion hot pots; yuzu zosui.

anecdotes.text: A September 2024 visitor from northern Kanto has come once a year for ten years.
A May 2024 grandparent brought a university-student grandson here for the fresh fu.
A July 2025 diner liked the corn tempura and yuzu zosui but found drink prices a little touristy.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・日本料理、下京区四条河原町下ル船頭町273-1、四条河原町駅から徒歩3分、毎日17:00〜23:30、予約可 (公式サイトから)、カード可、座敷、禁煙。口コミ (2024年5月〜2026年3月、英語): 高瀬川沿いの町家、2階の窓際から川と桜、Kujo のねぎと黒毛和牛のすき焼きコース税込4,994円、柚子まるごとの柚子雑炊が一番人気、土鍋豆腐、湯葉の刺身、生湯葉の天ぷら3種968円、銀だらの Saikyo 味噌焼き1,320円、湯豆腐、すりおろした山芋の鍋、麩とアイスの黒蜜がけ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online; ask for a window table upstairs for the river view. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through March 2026.

kyoto_ginsui_shijo_ohashi.gf_detail: Ask. Single-serving hot pots and sukiyaki in soy-based broths (2021–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_ginsui_shijo_ohashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: duck, beef, pork and chicken hot pots and sukiyaki (2021–26 reviews).
kyoto_ginsui_shijo_ohashi.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00), dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). Charge ¥500 for drinks only, no service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「ドリンクのみの場合チャージ料500円、サービス料は無料」). 28 seats: sunken-kotatsu seating downstairs and private rooms for 2–10 upstairs, plus a terrace on the Kamo river in season (Tabelog; 2018–24 reviews). An ashtray on the river terrace (May 2024). Just south of the west end of Shijo-ohashi, 3 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (Tabelog).
kyoto_ginsui_shijo_ohashi.notes: [Hot pots and sukiyaki · Shijo-ohashi, on the Kamo river] A traditional house down a stone-paved lane by Shijo-ohashi serving one-person hot pots — duck, watercress and duck, beef, chicken — and good-value sukiyaki, with sunken-kotatsu seats, private rooms upstairs and a riverside terrace in the warm months. Solo diners welcome. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya serving sukiyaki and beef tongue by the west end of Shijo-ohashi. An August 2023 review describes a family business, with the owner and a twenty-something son running the room; a December 2021 review notes a sign welcoming solo hot-pot diners.

anecdotes.text: A December 2021 business traveller was drawn in by a "solo hot pot welcome" sign and had the watercress and duck hot pot.
An August 2023 diner queued before opening for the duck hot pot and found the room full soon after.
A May 2018 group had booked the riverside terrace but moved inside because it was too cold.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・すき焼き・牛タン、下京区四条大橋西詰南入ル、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩3分、12:00〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)、17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、水曜休み、予約可、カード可、ドリンクのみの場合チャージ料500円、サービス料は無料、28席 (1階は掘りごたつ、2階は個室)。口コミ (2018年5月〜2026年10月、英語): 一人鍋、鴨鍋3,500円、天然クレソンと鴨の鍋2,420円、牛・豚・鶏の鍋とすき焼き、karasumi と大根、鴨川のテラス、石畳の路地の古い家、家族で営む。

cultural_comfort.note: Each diner orders a separate hot pot; staff help cook; ask for the river terrace in season. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_shinya_meshi_zakoya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: scallop tempura, shrimp fried rice and soy-based seafood dishes (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shinya_meshi_zakoya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya — sashimi, seafood rice bowls, dried squid (2017–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shinya_meshi_zakoya.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun 20:00–5:00; closed Monday (Retty lists 20:00–6:00, last order 5:00). No reservations. Smoking allowed (Tabelog; January 2025). Cards and e-money; no QR. Often one cook alone, so expect a wait when busy (February 2023). In a narrow alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, 1F of the Higashi-Kiyamachi Building.
kyoto_shinya_meshi_zakoya.notes: [Late-night seafood · Kiyamachi alley, open till 5 a.m.] A tiny alley izakaya between Kiyamachi and Pontocho that only opens at 20:00 and runs till dawn, for market seafood when everything else has shut: seafood bowls, sashimi, scallop tempura and shrimp fried rice from a characterful cook. One diner found it cluttered with a grubby floor and smokers inside (January 2025). Closed Monday.

roles: Owner-cook, not named in a source; part of the Zakoya (雑小屋) group
chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2017 to 2026 describe a hidden alley shop and a quiet, attentive owner-cook with a strong presence who often runs it alone (February 2023; March 2024; August 2024), and call it the late-night shop of a group of Kyoto seafood izakaya with several Zakoya locations (January 2023; March 2024; January 2026). The group's size was not found.

anecdotes.text: February 2023: "Since the owner is managing everything by himself, let's keep in mind that there might be a slight wait during busy times."

January 2025: "The interior of the restaurant was quite cluttered with a lot of items, and the cleanliness of the floor was a bit concerning. Since this place allows smoking indoors, there were also people puffing away nearby."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 深夜めし雑小屋、食堂、中京区下樵木町202-1 東木屋町ビル 1F、祇園四条から274m、火〜日 20:00〜翌5:00、月曜休み、予約不可、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可。Retty: 火〜日 20:00〜翌6:00 (L.O. 5:00)、市場直送の魚介。口コミ (2017年10月〜2026年8月、英語): 雑小屋グループの深夜の店、木屋町と先斗町の間の路地、漁師めし (海鮮丼)、刺身の盛り合わせ、トロたく、まぐろと芽わさび、ほたての天ぷら、海老チャーハン、するめ、焼酎、ひとりで切り盛りする存在感のある店主、店内が雑然として床が気になり喫煙者もいたという声、可もなく不可もなくという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Late-night counter; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_motsuden_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: motsu-suki in a soy sukiyaki sauce, white-miso motsu-nabe, motsu katsu, udon and champon finishes (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_motsuden_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef offal hot pots, raw offal yukhoe, tongue (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_motsuden_kawaramachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 18:00–24:00; closing days vary. Reservations taken; groups of 9 or more confirm by phone. Fully booked by 19:00 on a November 2025 night. Order by QR code; pay at the register (July 2025). Motsu-suki for at least two servings when two or more dine, one serving allowed solo (August 2025). 30 seats; non-smoking; children welcome. Cards (incl. UnionPay) and PayPay; no e-money. 2F, above a horumon shop (August 2025). Opened 17 July 2025 (review).
kyoto_motsuden_kawaramachi.notes: [Motsu-nabe · Kawaramachi, garlicky offal sukiyaki] A clean, stylish second-floor offal house near Kawaramachi, opened in July 2025: garlic-heavy motsu-sukiyaki and white-miso motsu-nabe, a mixed raw-offal yukhoe, tongue and motsu katsu, with QR ordering and courses that fill up by seven. Solo diners may order one serving. Open nightly to midnight.

roles: Owner, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Opened 17 July 2025 (July 2025 review). Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a clean, stylish room upstairs from a horumon shop, QR ordering, fast drinks, an owner who let a solo diner order one serving of motsu-suki (August 2025), and full houses by 19:00 (November 2025). Whether "河原町店" has sister shops was not found.

anecdotes.text: August 2025: "the owner kindly told me that it's fine to order just one serving for a single guest… For two or more people, orders must be placed for at least two servings."
November 2025: "It's a popular spot that was fully booked by 7 PM today."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: もつ田 河原町店、もつ鍋・居酒屋、中京区備前島町309-1 2F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、毎日 18:00〜24:00、休みは変動、予約可 (9名以上は電話)、30席、禁煙、子供可、コース・飲み放題、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可。ホットペッパー: 五種類のホルモンをニンニクの効いた特製すき焼きタレで食べるもつすきやき、白味噌もつ鍋。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年11月、英語): 2025年7月17日オープン、QRコードで注文、スタミナもつすき、もつ田ユッケ、ハツ刺し、蒸しタン、酢もつ、すじ煮込み、もつカツ、締めのうどんやちゃんぽん、一人でも1人前で注文可 (2人以上は2人前から)、19時に満席、清潔でおしゃれ、1階はホルモンの店。

cultural_comfort.note: QR ordering; one serving allowed for solo diners.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_furuka_fuyacho.gf_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists gluten-free options, but no safety detail is given; fried shrimp, pasta and pizza are on the menu (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_furuka_fuyacho.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists vegetarian options; the menu is otherwise meat, cheese and seafood (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_furuka_fuyacho.hours_raw: Tabelog: 16:00–24:00 (last orders food 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed Thursday. Reviewers mention afternoon drinking from 15:00 (June 2025; October 2026). Reservations taken; private hire for up to 20 seated or 30 standing by phone. No service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「なし」 (the English page says 10% is added). 28 seats: 8 at the counter, 20 at tables. Non-smoking. English menu; sommelier; school-age children welcome. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR. 1F on the east side of Fuyacho-dori just north of Shijo, in the former Lemon Sakaba premises. Opened 9 June 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_furuka_fuyacho.notes: [Italian bar · Fuyacho by Shijo, afternoon wine and small plates] A green-hued Italian wine bar near Shijo that opens mid-afternoon: chicken pâté, salumi, Caprese, crispy shrimp, Margherita pizza and wagyu steak with a long wine list, at the counter or tables. Some found prices high for the portions (October 2025), choices of pasta and salad thin, and the restroom not clean (March 2026). No service charge. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 9 June 2025 (Tabelog) in the former premises of Lemon Sakaba (August 2025 review). Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a calm, stylish room with mood lighting, friendly staff and a wine list they praised.

anecdotes.text: October 2025: "the prices are a bit on the higher side. While the flavors are definitely reliable, the portion sizes give a somewhat overpriced impression."
March 2026: "The chicken pâté was exceptionally delicious!… The downsides are that the restroom wasn't very clean and the only pasta option was Neapolitan."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フルカ、イタリアン・バル・ワインバー、中京区桝屋町514 コリスアルタス 1F、京都河原町駅から徒歩5分、木曜以外 16:00〜24:00 (料理 L.O. 23:00、ドリンク L.O. 23:30)、木曜休み、予約可 (貸切は電話)、原文でサービス料「なし」、28席 (カウンター8、テーブル20)、禁煙、英語メニュー、ソムリエ、小学生以上可、野菜にこだわり・ベジタリアン対応・グルテンフリー対応の表示、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、2025年6月9日オープン。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年10月、英語): 緑がテーマ、昼から飲める、レモン酒場の跡、鶏のパテ、サラミと生ハム、カプレーゼ、オムレツ、オニオンリング、海老のフリット、マルゲリータ、ハンバーグ、和牛ステーキ、ナポリタン、ワインが豊富、値段の割に量が少ないという声、サラダやパスタの種類が少ないという声、トイレが清潔でないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; sommelier; no service charge.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_the_mimasuya_pontocho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tofu dengaku, nama-fu, fried eggplant and chicken, saikyo-yaki and soy-based course dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_the_mimasuya_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: duck, shrimp, sashimi and dashi in the courses (2026 reviews).
kyoto_the_mimasuya_pontocho.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 17:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); open all year — check before visiting. Reservations taken; the Kamo-river terrace (noryo-yuka, summer) requires a course booking. Charge ¥300 incl. tax — Tabelog, Japanese original 「チャージ300円（税込）」. 120 seats: 90 upstairs and 30 downstairs, with tatami; shoes off upstairs (March 2026). Non-smoking. Sommelier; children welcome. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR. On Pontocho south of Sanjo, by the park.
kyoto_the_mimasuya_pontocho.notes: [Creative Kyoto · Pontocho, Kamo River views and a summer terrace] A big two-floor Pontocho restaurant with Kamo River windows and a summer riverside terrace: Kyoto obanzai, tofu dengaku, duck and seasonal kaiseki, with terrace courses from about ¥6,400 including a drink. One terrace diner found the course dry and cold (August 2026). ¥300 charge. Open nightly.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a shoes-off second floor with round tables and glass windows on the Kamo River, a riverside terrace with attentive service, and prices reasonable for Pontocho. The みます屋 name is shared with みます屋 おくどはん on Sanjo, already in this app (kyoto_mimasuya_okudohan), and with listings for 先斗町 みます屋 本店 and Mimasuya Italiano on Pontocho (Hot Pepper; Tabelog) — four same-name shops in all, by these sources.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: "The course meal was a bit dry and cold, but I believe that's common for terrace dining. While most Japanese-style terrace courses tend to be around JPY 10,000, The Mimasu Ya offers…"
June 2026: "I was a bit worried that the staff might not notice me for additional orders since it was outdoors, but I was grateful for their attentive service."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: The みます屋、創作料理・日本料理・居酒屋、中京区先斗町通三条下ル松本町、阪急河原町駅から徒歩5分、京阪三条駅から徒歩6分、毎日 17:00〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:00、ドリンク L.O. 22:30)、年中無休、予約可、納涼床の席はコースの予約が必要、原文で「チャージ300円（税込）」、120席 (2階90、1階30)、座敷、禁煙、ソムリエ、子供可、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、京の旬の食材の会席と鴨川の納涼床。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): 2階は靴を脱いで上がり鴨川が見える、高瀬川コース6,380円 (1ドリンクと床の席、京風豆腐田楽、海老のうま煮、鴨ロース、胡麻のサラダなど)、床のコースとしては手頃、おばんざい、だし巻、なすと鶏の揚げ物、生麩、カンパチの刺身、西京焼き、京御膳、京都のビール、床のコースは冷めて乾いていたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off upstairs; terrace by course booking; ¥300 charge.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_bar_fish_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail and whisky bar with no menu — drinks are made to request; no food or gluten information (2019–2025 reviews).
kyoto_bar_fish_pontocho.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks only in the reviews; cocktails made to request (2019–2025 reviews).
kyoto_bar_fish_pontocho.hours_raw: Daily 20:00–5:00; open all year; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No menu or price list — ask for what you like; a charge of ¥220 per person (April 2025). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 25 seats: a counter and sofa tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog; 2022–2025 reviews). Down the stairs to the basement of the FORUM Kiyamachi-Pontocho building, near the south end of Pontocho (Tabelog; 2022–2024 reviews).
kyoto_bar_fish_pontocho.notes: [Bar · Pontocho, an aquarium underground] A dim basement bar near Pontocho's south end where arowanas, cichlids and soft-shelled turtles swim in tanks around the sofas. There is no menu or price list: ask for a highball or a cocktail to your taste — reviewers found it reasonably priced, with a small seat charge. One found the bartender's choice cocktails watery. Smoking allowed; open till 5 a.m.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bar of 25 seats open 20:00–5:00 all year. Reviewers from 2019 to 2025 describe a dim aquarium bar with no menu, where the bartender makes drinks to request and keeps a respectful distance.

anecdotes.text: A September 2024 visitor asked for a lemon sour the bar did not stock and was made a lemon-sour-style cocktail instead.
A September 2024 guest let the staff choose the cocktails, which were easy to drink but a bit watery; there is no Japanese sake.
An April 2025 visitor nervous about the missing price list found it very reasonable, with a ¥220 charge per person.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー、中京区鍋屋町220 FORUM木屋町先斗町ビル BF、祇園四条から134m、毎日 20:00〜翌5:00、年中無休、営業時間は変わることあり、予約可、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、25席、カウンターとソファ、喫煙可。口コミ (2018年7月〜2025年4月、英語): 先斗町の入口近く、地下への階段、水槽だらけのアクアリウムバー、アジアアロワナ、アフリカンシクリッド、スッポン、カエル、青や紫の薄暗い照明、メニューと値段表なし、好みを伝えて作ってもらう、ハイボール、カクテル、日本酒なし、チャージ1人220円 (2025年4月)、お任せのカクテルが少し薄かったとの声 (2024年9月)、入りにくい入口。

cultural_comfort.note: No menu — ask for what you like; small seat charge; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through April 2025.

kyoto_kyo_kurozakura_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not GF: yakiniku with sauces, kalbi rice bowls, kimchi and namul (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_kurozakura_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku restaurant (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_kurozakura_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 16:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; courses for 2 or more, bookable until noon on the day; same-day cancellations are charged (Tabelog; October 2024). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 62 seats with private and semi-private rooms (Tabelog). Orders by smartphone QR code (September 2024). On Kiyamachi north of Shijo; 2 min walk from Kawaramachi and Gion-Shijo Stns (Tabelog). Opened 5 January 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyo_kurozakura_kiyamachi.notes: [Yakiniku · Kiyamachi, A5 wagyu] A calm Kiyamachi yakiniku with private rooms, serving A5 and Miyazaki wagyu: yukhoe, raw tongue, harami and good-value courses up to an all-you-can-eat-and-drink set, plus a ¥1,200 lunch bowl. Some found the all-you-can-drink sake poor, the QR menu confusing, or one strip loin a little off-smelling. Lunch and dinner daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yakiniku and izakaya opened 5 January 2016 on Kiyamachi with a website at kiyamachi-kurozakura.com; a sister shop, Kurozakura Hachijoguchi, appears in our crawls. Reviewers describe a manager and staff attentive at company banquets (June 2023).

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner called the liver and garlic chives on the ¥9,500 all-you-can-eat-and-drink course the best ever.
A June 2024 guest found the all-you-can-drink sake tasted like shochu, even after reordering.
An October 2026 group after bowling noticed a slight odour in the thinly sliced strip loin.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉・バーベキュー・居酒屋、中京区鍋屋町211-2、阪急河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩2分、毎日 12:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)、16:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、予約可 (コースは2名から、当日12時まで、当日キャンセルは料金がかかる)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、62席、個室・半個室、2016年1月5日開店。口コミ (2022年4月〜2026年10月、英語): A5の和牛、宮崎牛のコース、9,500円の食べ放題・飲み放題コース、レバニラ、飲めるカルビ、記念日の肉ケーキ付きコース9,900円、ユッケ、生のタン、特選ハラミ、サーロインステーキ8,800円、リブロース6,900円、昼は1,200円から (豚カルビ丼、サラダ、もやしナムル)、QRコードでスマホ注文、飲み放題の日本酒が焼酎のようだったとの声 (2024年6月)、メニューがわかりにくいとの声 (2024年9月)、ロースに少し臭みがあったとの声 (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: QR smartphone ordering; private rooms; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and website; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_tachinomi_gabana_nishiki.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto pickles such as suguki, mizunasu and nukazuke, grilled firefly squid, salted salmon and shuto with sake and beer; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tachinomi_gabana_nishiki.vegan_detail: Ask. The pickle platters look plant-based, but some pickles use dashi (taru-dashi suguki); no ingredient information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tachinomi_gabana_nishiki.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–20:00, last order 19:30; hours may change (Tabelog). The operator page gives 11:30–20:00, closed over New Year (takakuraya.jp). Food can sell out before closing (August 2026). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). Standing counter and a small table area, open to the arcade; smoking allowed (Tabelog; March 2025). In Nishiki Market at the Teramachi end, next door to the pickle shop Nishiki Takakuraya; 2 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; operator page). Opened 1 November 2015 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tachinomi_gabana_nishiki.notes: [Standing bar · Nishiki Market, sake and pickles] A cheap, open-fronted standing bar beside a Nishiki pickle shop: Kyoto-only sake from about ¥600 and draft beer from ¥400, with plates of freshly made pickles — suguki, mizunasu — grilled firefly squid and salted salmon, to Showa-era songs. Open from late morning; food can sell out near closing. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the operator page: a standing bar beside Nishiki Takakuraya, the Kyoto pickle shop, for freshly made pickles and local sake from around Kyoto (できたてのお漬物と錦市場の賑わいを肴に、京都各地の地酒をお楽しみください). The same operator lists four more shops, among them HAPPY STAND KYOTO. Opened 1 November 2015 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Freshly made pickles with Kyoto sake (operator page).

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 group drawn in on the way elsewhere found the menu claiming "probably the cheapest in the world" and the taru-dashi suguki delicious.
A February 2025 Kyoto local had not eaten suguki since childhood and found it as good as ever.
An August 2026 visitor arriving just before closing found the food sold out apart from a pickle platter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 立ち飲み・日本酒バー、中京区錦小路通寺町東大文字町289-2、阪急京都河原町駅から徒歩2分、毎日 11:00〜20:00 (L.O.19:30)、予約不可、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、喫煙可、テイクアウト可、2015年11月1日開店。運営ページ: 「錦・高倉屋」の隣の立ち飲み店、できたてのお漬物と錦市場の賑わいを肴に京都各地の地酒を、11:30〜20:00、年末年始休み。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年8月、英語): 京都の酒のみ、Sawaya Matsumoto の純米600円、Kamikura の純米生原酒、生ビール400〜500円、Riku のハイボール500円、漬物の盛り合わせ、樽出しすぐき500円、水なす、白菜のぬか漬け、焼きほたるいか、塩鮭、酒盗、熱燗2合と漬物の盛り合わせで1,600円、昭和の音楽、閉店前は料理が売り切れ (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing only; some signs in other languages (February 2025); smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and operator page; reviews through August 2026.

kyoto_horumon_jaman_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Not GF: yakiniku with sauces, sukiyaki-style beef, Korean cold noodles (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_horumon_jaman_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a horumon and yakiniku restaurant (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_horumon_jaman_kawaramachi.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–3:00; irregular closing days; closed 31 December and 1 January (Tabelog). Last orders around 2:00 (September 2026). Reservations accepted, online too; busy late — full at 22:00 on a Monday (Tabelog; August 2026). No charge (Tabelog original なし). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 38 seats: 26 at tables, 12 at the counter; a space on the 3F for groups of 10 or more (Tabelog; October 2026). Designated smoking area per Tabelog; a reviewer says smoking is allowed inside (April 2026). In an alley between Kawaramachi and Kiyamachi; moved here on 18 November 2020 (Tabelog; July 2025).
kyoto_horumon_jaman_kawaramachi.notes: [Horumon yakiniku · between Kawaramachi and Kiyamachi, till 3 a.m.] A roomy late-night horumon shop in an alley, busy past midnight: cheap jaw meat and tetchan, thick tongue, a whole Angus harami, chicken sashimi and cold noodles, with bottles from a wine cellar. Counter for solo diners, an upper floor for groups. Smoking allowed at least in part.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a horumon yakiniku shop that moved to its present address on 18 November 2020. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a long-running late-night shop, more spacious after the move, with a wine cellar.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 regular from before the move finds the new shop more spacious and clean, and orders the ago every time.
A January 2026 diner was struck by the Angus harami, so large it is grilled whole and then sliced.
An October 2026 work party used the hidden third-floor space for groups of 10 or more and was told drinks could be brought in.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、中京区備前島町309-1、河原町駅が最寄り、毎日 18:00〜翌3:00、不定休、12月31日・1月1日休み、予約可、チャージなし、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、38席 (テーブル26、カウンター12)、分煙、2020年11月18日移転。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年10月、英語): 河原町通と木屋町通の間の路地、移転後は広くきれい、深夜も満席、ワインセラーからボトルを選べる、アゴ肉400円、テッチャン、センマイ、ウルテ、レバー、鶏刺し、厚切りタン、薄切りタン、アンガスのハラミ、カルビ、ユッケ、すき焼き風、ねぎサラダ、冷麺、赤ワイン500円、店内喫煙可との声 (2026年4月)、10名以上は3階の席、飲み物の持ち込み可との声 (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter for solo diners; open late; cards only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_horumon_jaman_kawaramachi.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26034913/ (35.006096, 135.769835); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区備前島町309番地 (lot) 24 m; nearest Kyoto record 63 m away; 2026-11-07

kyoto_tea_wave_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Matcha and hojicha sweets — Basque cheesecake, gâteau chocolat, brownie, pudding, raw chocolate, ice cream, kakigori — and tea drinks; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tea_wave_pontocho.vegan_detail: Ask. Straight teas such as saemidori and tea sodas are plant-based, but the sweets and lattes use dairy and nothing is described as vegan (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tea_wave_pontocho.hours_raw: 12:00–18:00 daily; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); waits of up to about 40 minutes at busy times (June and August 2026). Order and pay at a touch panel on the ground floor, collect your tray and climb to a seat on floors 2–5 — no lift mentioned (May and July 2026). Cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). In the MINATO / COCO Gallery KYOTO building, an art space, near Pontocho, about 200 m from Gion-Shijo Station (Tabelog; 2026). Opened 20 March 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tea_wave_pontocho.notes: [Matcha café · near Pontocho, five floors of art] A self-service matcha dessert café in a five-storey gallery building: order at a touch panel, then climb to a seat among the art — a matcha plate of cheesecake, ice cream and chocolate (about ¥1,450), lattes, hojicha shakes and summer kakigori. Expect a queue at weekends; stairs only.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the shop as a matcha-dessert specialist opened in 2025, with each floor of the building styled differently (May and July 2026). Tabelog’s name search lists TEA WAVE Honten and another shop near Tenmonkan-dori (Kagoshima) and one in Fukuoka.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 group waited about 40 minutes and shared a matcha plate, a chocolate matcha latte, a hojicha shake and a hojicha cheesecake.
A July 2026 visitor recommends it to matcha lovers who prefer things less sweet.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: TEA WAVE、カフェ、中京区鍋屋町209-2 MINATO / COCO Gallery KYOTO、祇園四条駅から216m、毎日12:00〜18:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー可、2025年3月20日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 抹茶の甘味の専門店、5階建てのアートスペース、1階のタッチパネルで注文と支払い、2〜5階の好きな席へ、抹茶プレート1,400〜1,450円 (バスクチーズケーキ、アイス、ガトーショコラ、生チョコ)、チョコ抹茶ラテ800円、さえみどり700円、ティーソーダ700円ほど、抹茶プリン、ほうじ茶のバスクチーズケーキ、ほうじ茶シェイク、夏の抹茶とほうじ茶のかき氷、混むと40分ほど待つ。

cultural_comfort.note: Touch-panel ordering; self-service; stairs to every floor.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_tea_wave_pontocho.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26042768/ (35.005185, 135.770699), offset about 5.6 m north-east to (35.005225, 135.770729) because 和彩たか (kyoto_wasai_taka_kiyamachi) sits within 5 m; cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区鍋屋町209番地 (lot) 25m; 2026-11-07

kyoto_sushi_yabuuchi.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi and side dishes ordered à la carte — nigiri, grilled fish, karasumi, crab in season; soy sauce and tsume not described (reviews).
kyoto_sushi_yabuuchi.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 18:00–22:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). By introduction only; à la carte only; budget from ¥15,000 (Tabelog remarks) — reviewers spend ¥20,000–30,000 (2017–2020). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 16 seats: 10 at the counter and a private room for 6 (Tabelog). Upstairs on the north-east corner of Gokomachi and Nishikikoji, by Nishiki Market (Tabelog; 2017). Opened 17 May 2012 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_yabuuchi.notes: [Sushi · by Nishiki Market, introduction only] A small upstairs sushi counter at Gokomachi-Nishikikoji where you order à la carte from the day’s market fish — nodoguro, uni, kohada, kuruma ebi, crab in season. By introduction only; from about ¥15,000; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s remarks say the restaurant is by introduction only, à la carte only, with a budget from ¥15,000. Earlier reviewers describe a lively owner front of house and a quiet chef behind the counter (2018, 2020); a June 2025 visitor praised a chef who prepares everything from scratch.
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte nigiri from the market.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 visitor, there on a recommendation, worked through nine kinds of nigiri and found the purple uni at its best.
A November 2023 regular came for crab on the opening day of the season.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鮨 やぶ内、寿司、中京区御幸町通錦小路東北角 さしあのビル2F、河原町四条から徒歩5分、火〜日 18:00〜22:00、月曜定休、紹介制、アラカルトのみ、予算15,000円から (備考)、カード可 (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、16席 (カウンター10、個室6)、2012年5月17日オープン。口コミ (2017〜2025年、英語): のどぐろの焼き物、鳥貝、中トロ、ムラサキウニ、コハダ、車海老、鱧、穴子、つぶ貝、はまこ、とろたく、からすみ (2025年6月)、蟹の解禁日、蟹味噌とシャリ、元気な店主と寡黙な職人、天然うなぎ。

cultural_comfort.note: By introduction only; à la carte from about ¥15,000.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; latest review June 2025.

kyoto_sushi_yabuuchi.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26021720/ (35.005089, 135.766421); GSI resolves the address only to the wrong town, but OSM Nominatim reverse-geocodes the Tabelog point to 錦小路通, matching the address (north-east corner of Gokomachi and Nishikikoji); 2026-11-07

kyoto_saimi_takii_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese dishes and hot pots — hamo nabe and hamo sukiyaki, gyu-suki, pork shabu, sesame tofu, dashimaki, soba; no gluten information (reviews).
kyoto_saimi_takii_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamo, beef, pork and jidori dishes, hot pots in dashi (reviews).
kyoto_saimi_takii_pontocho.hours_raw: Hours are not listed on Tabelog — phone ahead (075-213-3153). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX) and e-money (Tabelog). A kawadoko deck over the Kamo in season (2022–2026). A smoking area for heated tobacco only (Tabelog). À la carte welcome as well as courses (May 2026). On Pontocho, about 200 m from Gion-Shijo Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_saimi_takii_pontocho.notes: [Japanese · Pontocho kawadoko, hamo and beef hot pots] A Pontocho house with a deck over the Kamo in summer, now run by the founding chef’s two sons: hamo sukiyaki and hamo hot pots, gyu-suki, Omi beef with Kujo onion, sesame tofu and dashimaki, with courses or à la carte. Hours unlisted — phone ahead.

chef_bio.background: A regular of nearly 30 years writes that the long-time chef has retired and the chef’s two sons now run the kitchen well (March 2026). Earlier reviewers mention welcoming owners (July 2022).

anecdotes.text: A seven-time regular of nearly 30 years brought a junior from a college rakugo club to the counter in March 2026.
A May 2026 walker was welcomed with “feel free to order à la carte” and had Omi beef, soba and a beer by the river.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 彩味 たき井、日本料理、中京区先斗町四条上ル松本町161-1、祇園四条駅から215m、営業時間の記載なし、予約可、カード (JCB・AMEX)・電子マネー可、加熱式たばこ専用の喫煙所。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 夏の川床、鱧すき (締めの雑炊)、鱧鍋のコースと焼き鱧、牛すき鍋、近江牛と九条ねぎの炒め、そばのセット、ちりめん山椒ご飯、胡麻豆腐、筍の炊いたん、だし巻き、地鶏の焼き物、豚しゃぶ鍋、〆張鶴、長年の料理人が引退し二人の息子が継ぐ (2026年3月)、アラカルトも可。

cultural_comfort.note: Hours unlisted — phone ahead; kawadoko in season.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_tabemonya_massan.gf_detail: Ask. Fish-led izakaya dishes — sashimi with house dressings, sushi, obanzai, horse-meat shabu, matsutake fried rice; no gluten information (2025 reviews).
kyoto_tabemonya_massan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, sushi, tuna and horse meat (2025 reviews).
kyoto_tabemonya_massan.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 17:00–24:00; closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter and 8 in booths (Tabelog). Smoking allowed at all seats (September 2025). Upstairs in alley no. 15 between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, north of Shijo — easy to miss (Tabelog; August 2025).
kyoto_tabemonya_massan.notes: [Izakaya · Kiyamachi-Pontocho alley, upstairs, the owner’s fish] A tiny upstairs izakaya hidden in an alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, where the owner, Massan, has cooked for about 26 years: very fresh sashimi with house dressings, Oma tuna, horse-meat shabu, sushi, obanzai and, in season, matsutake fried rice. Smoking allowed; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: An August 2025 first-timer learned the shop has run for 26 years and that the owner goes by “Massan”, like the shop. A February 2025 reviewer says the owner runs everything single-handed, a little stern at first but good company; earlier reviewers describe a couple running it (2023, January 2024).
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi with house dressings; matsutake fried rice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 regular travels from Aichi for the early matsutake and takes the fried rice home for breakfast.
A June 2025 guest, an hour late after a flight delay in heavy rain, was still kindly seated.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食べもん家 まっさん、居酒屋、中京区木屋町四条上ル15番ロージ2F、火〜日 17:00〜24:00、月曜定休、予約可、カード可、16席 (カウンター8、ボックス8)。口コミ (2025年、英語): 創業26年、店主の呼び名は「まっさん」、ひとりで切り盛り、目の前でさばく新鮮な魚、トリュフやポン酢系の自家製ドレッシングで食べる刺身のつま、大間のまぐろ、しめ鯖にレモン、馬刺しのしゃぶしゃぶ、初夏からの早松茸と松茸の炒飯の持ち帰り、ネタの大きな寿司、おばんざい、全席喫煙可、路地の2階で見つけにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny hidden counter; smoking allowed; the owner guides you on how to eat things.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through January 2026.

kyoto_babirusa_enmachi.gf_detail: Ask. Rice dishes — chicken rice, biryani, curry with basmati — but laksa noodles, soy sauces and you tiao contain wheat (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_babirusa_enmachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken rice, pork-rib bak kut teh, shrimp-coconut laksa (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_babirusa_enmachi.hours_raw: Mon–Wed, Fri and Sat 11:30–22:00; Sun 11:30–18:30; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Open straight through the afternoon (March 2026 review). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese original says 「サービス料チャージ料ともに無し」 (none). Cards: AMEX only; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 seats — 6 on the first floor, 4 up a steep stair (Tabelog; October 2026 review); non-smoking. Biryani tends to sell out by about 14:00 (July 2026 review). 5 min from JR Enmachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_babirusa_enmachi.notes: [Singaporean · Enmachi] A tiny one-person kitchen near Enmachi Station: Hainanese chicken rice with three sauces, Malaysian-style bak kut teh, shrimp-coconut laksa and a daily biryani that sells out by mid-afternoon, for about ¥1,200–1,500. Open all afternoon; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 17 September 2022 (Leaf Kyoto, July 2023). Chef Yajima was involved in launching Five Star Cafe, a Singaporean restaurant popular in Tokyo, and has a long history with ethnic cooking (Leaf Kyoto). The owner runs the restaurant alone (July 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner asked whether the bak kut teh was Singaporean or Malaysian, was told more Malaysian, and ordered it.
An October 2026 regular calls this the place for biryani; that day's autumn version had sweet potato, chestnut and pumpkin with curry.
In December 2025 a diner spending a local Ittoku pass found it closed on the first try and came back for biryani and bak kut teh.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バビルサ、シンガポール料理・インド料理、中京区西ノ京北円町63、JR円町駅から徒歩5分、月〜水・金・土 11:30〜22:00、日 11:30〜18:30、木曜休み、予約可、サービス料・チャージ料なし、カードは AMEX のみ、電子マネー・QR 不可、10席 (1階6、2階4)、禁煙。Leaf Kyoto (2023年7月、英語): 2022年9月17日開店、Chef Yajima は東京の人気シンガポール料理店 Five Star Cafe の立ち上げに関わった、海南チキンライス950円 (スープ付き、黒醤油・チリ・生姜のソース)、バクテー、ラクサ、自家製レモングラスティー。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 店主が一人で営む、チキンライス1,200円 (2026年3月)、マレーシア風のバクテー1,250円、海老とココナッツのラクサ、日替わりのビリヤニとカレー、魯肉飯、カヤアイス、油条、ビリヤニは14時ごろに売り切れることも、急な階段。

cultural_comfort.note: One-person shop; steep stairs to the upper seats.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_sakanoue_shoten_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Salt-grilled tongue is offered, but miso and soy-based sauces, tail soup and tororo come with the sets (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakanoue_shoten_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef-tongue restaurant (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakanoue_shoten_kawaramachi.hours_raw: Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun and holidays 11:30–22:30 (food last order 21:45, drinks 30 min before close); closed Thursday (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 60 seats with tables, sunken kotatsu seating, tatami rooms and private rooms for 2 to 20; shoes off at the entrance; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog; August and October 2026 reviews). In a renovated shop building dating from 1914, the Taisho era (two August 2026 reviews); 2F per the official site. 1 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn exit 3 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sakanoue_shoten_kawaramachi.notes: [Sendai beef tongue · Shijo-Kawaramachi] A beef-tongue specialist a minute from Kawaramachi Station, in a renovated 1914 house with tatami and private rooms: thick charcoal-grilled tongue sets with salt, miso or sauce, tail soup and rice, plus boiled tongue and stew. Lunch about ¥2,000–3,000; dinner ¥3,000–5,000. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 18 February 2015 (Tabelog). The official site lists this Shijo-Kawaramachi shop only.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 regular on a third visit always orders the small aged-tongue set with a mini salad and prefers the salt version.
Eight pottery friends booked an October 2026 lunch of tongue and wagyu nigiri and were seated at once.
An August 2026 family found the century-old setting surprisingly easy with children.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 牛たん専門店 坂之上商店 四条河原町店、牛タン・居酒屋・肉料理、中京区河原町通四条上ル米屋町388、阪急河原町駅3番出口から徒歩1分、月〜水・金〜日・祝 11:30〜22:30 (料理 L.O. 21:45)、木曜休み、予約可、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、60席、個室 (2〜20名)、座敷、掘りごたつ、禁煙、子ども可、2015年2月18日オープン。公式サイト: 四条河原町店 (2F) のみ。ホットペッパー: 牛タン堪能コース5,000円 (予約制)。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): 1914年 (大正) の建物を改装、靴を脱いで上がる、炭火で焼く熟成牛たん、塩・味噌・たれ、テールスープ、とろろ、熟成牛たん1,868円、茹でタン1,099円、牛たんまぶし御膳4,244円、めぐり御膳、牛たんシチュー、和牛のにぎり、牛たん食べ比べ。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off; choose a sauce for the tongue.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_fujii_no_purin_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. Puddings and jellies; the buckwheat-tea pudding comes with buckwheat grains. Flour use not described (reviews).
kyoto_fujii_no_purin_shijo.vegan_detail: Ask. Soy-milk puddings without eggs are offered (May 2023 review), but whether any are fully vegan is not stated.
kyoto_fujii_no_purin_shijo.hours_raw: Mon, Thu and Fri 11:00–21:00; Tue, Sat and Sun 10:00–21:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Takeout only; no bookings (Tabelog; 2023–26 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Gift boxes available (June 2026 review); best eaten within three days, with an ice pack for two hours (February 2024 review). On Shijo-dori east of Teramachi, by the bus stop, beside Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; 2023 and February 2026 reviews).
kyoto_fujii_no_purin_shijo.notes: [Pudding · Shijo-Kawaramachi] The takeout pudding shop of 日本料理 藤井, the kaiseki restaurant near the Philosopher's Path: a silky Tanba-egg pudding with caramel and gentle soy-milk puddings — hojicha, black sesame, buckwheat tea with kuromitsu — about ¥500 each, in gift boxes too. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Cooks of 日本料理 藤井 (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 July 2022 (Tabelog; February 2026 review), selling the pudding served as dessert at 日本料理 藤井, the kaiseki restaurant near Ginkaku-ji on the Philosopher's Path (May 2023 and February 2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 shopper bought several puddings in gift boxes and one buckwheat pudding to try — subtly sweet with a crunch.
A January 2025 visitor found the black sesame soy-milk pudding refreshing rather than heavy.
A February 2026 first-timer was drawn by the line-up of soy-milk, tea and buckwheat puddings from a kaiseki kitchen.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理 藤井のぷりん、洋菓子、下京区四条通寺町東入ル御旅宮本町13-3、京都河原町駅から82m、月・木・金 11:00〜21:00、火・土・日 10:00〜21:00、水曜休み、予約不可、テイクアウト、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2022年7月1日オープン。口コミ (2023年1月〜2026年6月、英語): Ginkaku-ji 近く Philosopher’s Path の日本料理 藤井のデザートのプリン、Tanba の卵黄・生クリーム・牛乳のなめらかぷりんとカラメル、卵を使わない豆乳プリン (抹茶、紅茶、ほうじ茶、そば茶とそばの実と黒蜜、黒ごま)、豆乳プリンのコーヒーゼリー、かぼちゃ、パイナップルのゼリー、各500円、ギフトボックス、3日以内に、保冷剤2時間。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeout counter.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews dated through June 2026.

kyoto_fujii_no_purin_shijo.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26037935/ (35.003854, 135.767714); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市下京区御旅宮本町13番地 (lot) 19m; 2026-11-07

kyoto_kito_kito_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi and grilled fish, but tempura, noodles and soy-seasoned dishes are on the menu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kito_kito_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood restaurant; wagyu, duck and chicken dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kito_kito_shijo.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Monday (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 34 seats: a counter of 9, tables, a tatami room for 8 and semi-private rooms for 4–6, some on the second floor; designated smoking area; children welcome (Tabelog; May and July 2026 reviews). Service can be slow when busy — an hour's wait for dishes on a full September night, and a chaotic kitchen, two September 2026 reviewers note. 10 seconds from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn exit 1B; just off Kiyamachi (Tabelog; April 2026 review).
kyoto_kito_kito_shijo.notes: [Hokuriku seafood izakaya · Shijo-Kawaramachi] A calm, stylish izakaya steps from Kawaramachi Station serving Kanazawa fish — nodoguro, gasu-ebi, shiro-ebi in sashimi platters you build from the blackboard — plus thick mackerel sushi and seasonal tempura with sake. About ¥8,000–15,000. Can be slow when full; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 November 2012 (Tabelog). A September 2026 reviewer who had visited long before thought it now run by different people, with a Japanese head chef directing a mostly foreign staff.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 first-timer chose favourites for the sashimi platter and was told the abalone would be served whole.
An April 2026 diner liked the Sapporo Lager Akaboshi served with an aluminium cooler to keep it cold.
A November 2026 diner, ordering five kinds of sashimi from the blackboard, found the gasu-ebi as fresh as in Kanazawa.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 喜人来人、海鮮・居酒屋・日本料理、下京区四条通小橋西入真町90-6、阪急河原町駅1B出口から徒歩10秒、火〜日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、月曜休み、予約可、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、34席 (カウンター9、テーブル、8名の座敷、4〜6名の半個室)、分煙、子ども可、2012年11月10日オープン、魚・日本酒・焼酎・ワインにこだわる。口コミ (2026年3〜11月、英語): Hokuriku (Kanazawa) の魚と Kaga 野菜、黒板から選ぶ刺身の盛り合わせ (のどぐろ、平目、マハタ、鰹、縞鯵、ガスエビ、白エビ、鮑)、厚い鯖寿司、Gorojima 金時の天ぷら、牛すじ大根、和牛ステーキ、自分で焼く鴨ロース、たこの梅肉和え、手羽、鶏ガラの麺、雑炊、赤星を保冷ケースで、2階の席、混むと料理が遅いという声が2件、日本人の料理長と外国人のスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: Blackboard fish list; staff help build a sashimi platter.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_link_tower_sando.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: battered fried chicken, a chicken-katsu sandwich and fries (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_link_tower_sando.hours_raw: 11:00–23:00 (last order 22:30), daily (Tabelog). No reservations. Order at the counter; a buzzer calls you for some drinks (August 2023). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). 6 counter seats plus the shared 300-seat food hall; non-smoking; English menu (Tabelog). In the Kyoto Tower Sando B1F food hall, 2 min walk from Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_link_tower_sando.notes: [Fried chicken bar · Kyoto Tower Sando food hall] A six-seat counter in the food hall under Kyoto Tower, frying chicken to order — juicy thigh and breast in a light, crisp coat — with mega highballs and fruit highballs. A tasting set with a beer is about ¥1,000–1,300; a ¥1,000 senbero set suits a quick drink before the train. Open daily 11:00–23:00. Branch of Link at Kawaramachi-Sanjo.

roles: Not named; a branch of the fried-chicken-and-highball bar Link in Kawaramachi-Sanjo (August 2025 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 14 April 2017 (Tabelog). Tabelog’s introduction: juicy fried chicken cooked slowly at ultra-low temperature, many cuts, extra-fizzy highballs, a chicken tasting set for first-timers and a chicken-katsu sandwich set at lunch. An August 2025 reviewer calls it the branch of the Kawaramachi-Sanjo Link known for juicy chicken and highballs.
chef_bio.specialty: Fried chicken tasting set with a highball.

anecdotes.text: A five-time regular (June 2026) praised the crisp, fluffy coat and moist meat.
An August 2023 visitor ordered the "mega" highball and was handed a slightly larger plastic cup.
A July 2024 visitor who used to struggle with highballs was won over by the fruit highballs.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: リンク 京都タワーサンド店、鶏料理・居酒屋・ダイニングバー、下京区烏丸通七条下ル東塩小路町721-1 京都タワーサンドB1F、京都駅から徒歩約2分、毎日 11:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー可、6席 (別にフードコート300席)、禁煙、英語メニュー、2017年4月14日オープン。公式紹介: 超低温でじっくり揚げるジューシーな唐揚げ、部位いろいろ、強炭酸ハイボール、初めてなら「唐揚げ食べ比べセット」(むねともも、ドリンク付き)、ランチはチキンカツサンドのセット。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 食べ比べセット1,000〜1,300円、5種の部位のセット、皮ポン酢、せんべろセット1,000円 (生ビールかメガハイボールとおつまみ2品)、フルーツハイボール、ポテト、河原町三条のリンクの支店。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; food-hall counter (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_south_bound.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, pizza and fritters alongside charcoal grills, pâté, bagna cauda and fish dishes; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_south_bound.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat and seafood plates; bagna cauda is anchovy-based (reviews).
kyoto_south_bound.hours_raw: 17:00–1:00, Tuesday–Sunday and holidays; closed Monday, or Tuesday when Monday is a holiday (Tabelog). Bookings accepted. Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 13 seats: about 9 at the counter and a table for 4; heated tobacco only; free Wi-Fi; sommelier (Tabelog; June and August 2026). Run by two friends — one cooks, one serves (June and September 2026). On Koin-dori, 3 min walk from Hankyu Omiya Stn (Tabelog; July 2026).
kyoto_south_bound.notes: [Italian wine bar · Shijo-Omiya, natural wine late] A small, homey counter on Koin-dori run by two old classmates — one cooking, one pouring — with around 100 natural wines and Italian plates till 1 a.m.: seasonal pasta, charcoal-grilled spare ribs, pâté, bagna cauda and seasonal fish. Half portions for solo diners. About ¥5,000–8,000. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 20 August 2024 (Tabelog); an August 2026 reviewer noted the second anniversary. Tabelog’s introduction: signature pasta and charcoal-grilled dishes with about 100 natural wines, wine tasting to find favourites, counter and table seating, a bar for a second or third stop.
chef_bio.specialty: Pasta and charcoal grills with natural wine.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 couple booked for 22:30 and found both staff chatting with everyone at the counter.
An August 2026 solo diner was offered half portions and was full after three dishes.
A September 2026 first-timer at a small celebration learned the two owners were classmates and recommended the bagna cauda.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: SOUTH BOUND KYOTO、イタリアン・ワインバー、中京区壬生坊城町55 坊城ビル1F、阪急四条大宮駅から徒歩3分 (211m)、火〜日・祝 17:00〜翌1:00、月曜定休 (祝日の場合は火曜休み)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、13席、加熱式たばこのみ、Wi-Fi、ソムリエ、2024年8月20日オープン。公式紹介: 名物のパスタと炭火焼き、約100種の自然派ワイン、ワインのテイスティング、カウンターとテーブル、2軒目3軒目にも。口コミ (2026年、英語): 本日のパスタ (穴子と焼き茄子1,580円)、スペアリブ、パテ・ド・カンパーニュ、バーニャカウダ、明太子のフリット、トリッパのトマト煮、鯛の紙包み焼き、わかさぎのフリット、貝とみょうがのマリネ、筍と山椒、ピザ、ハーフサイズ、店主2人は同級生、1人が料理・1人が接客、後院通、2周年。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; ask the staff about wines.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_robinson_karasuma.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: a bakery-café restaurant whose lunches centre on all-you-can-eat house breads and pasta (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_robinson_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: ham salads, cream soups, fish and meat courses (reviews).
kyoto_robinson_karasuma.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–16:00 (last order 15:00), dinner 17:30–21:30 (last order 21:00); closed Tuesday, with monthly closing days posted on the official site (Tabelog; official site, October 2026). Bookings recommended — lunch fills from opening (September 2026). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 100 seats including private rooms with sunken seats; the second floor for groups of 10–20; party plans; non-smoking (Tabelog). In a Kyoto townhouse on Bukkoji-dori just west of Karasuma, 2 min walk from Shijo Stn Exit 6 (Tabelog).
kyoto_robinson_karasuma.notes: [Italian bakery café · Shijo-Karasuma, bread-basket lunches in a townhouse] A stylish townhouse restaurant a block from Shijo-Karasuma, known for lunches where staff keep bringing warm house breads — focaccia, mentaiko, tea bread — to go with salad and pasta (course about ¥2,900). Dinner is French-Italian courses; private rooms and an upstairs for groups. Book: lunch fills at opening. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site (dreamwks.com): Robinson Karasuma, Italian in Kyoto; the sister Robinson Kobe closed on 31 August 2025; anniversary courses, lunch private-room party plans in the storehouse room, and girls’-night courses. Tabelog: a boulangerie café dining room, French-Italian with seasonal ingredients, party plans for up to 80.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 lunch guest found a queue of booked parties before the 11:30 opening.
An October 2026 big eater returning after years came for the bread but felt the staff came round with it too seldom.
A July 2026 group added a dessert plate to the lunch course for a farewell party.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (dreamwks.com): 京都烏丸でイタリアンならRobinson、11月の定休日のご案内 (2026年10月)、9月2日からのランチ・ディナーメニュー (2026年8月)、ロビンソン神戸は2025年8月31日で閉店、ロビンソン烏丸の女子会コース、蔵の個室を貸し切るランチの会プラン、アニバーサリーコース。食べログ: イタリアン・カフェ・フレンチ、下京区仏光寺通烏丸西入ル釘隠町238-240、四条駅6番出口から徒歩2分、昼11:30〜16:00 (L.O. 15:00)、夜17:30〜21:30 (L.O. 21:00)、火曜定休、カード・PayPay可、100席 (掘りごたつの個室、テーブル)、2階は10〜20名の貸切、宴会は80名まで、禁煙、Boulangerie cafe dining Robinson、町家でフレンチ・イタリアン。口コミ (2026年、英語): パン食べ放題のランチ、10種以上のパン (バジルのフォカッチャ、明太子、胡椒、紅茶)、ランチコース2,900円、サラダランチ、トマトとアスパラのパスタ、ペペロンチーノ、サーモンのフライとタルタル、ヴィシソワーズ、スモークサーモンのカルパッチョ、鶏ももローストのディナーコース、開店前から予約客の列。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead for lunch.

existence.note: Official site with an October 2026 notice; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_gion_kaburaya.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai and Kyoto dishes seasoned with soy sauce and miso, plus kushikatsu and tempura; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_gion_kaburaya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi from kombu and katsuobushi, fish and meat dishes (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_kaburaya.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 (last food order 21:00), daily; irregular closures (Tabelog). Bookings recommended; tables limited to 2 hours (2.5 for courses); no-shows after 20 minutes may be cancelled; L-shaped counter in the main building (Tabelog). Table charge ¥440, not for courses (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 80 seats with semi-private and private rooms for 2–30; separated smoking area; English menu; small children welcome (Tabelog; June 2026). On the first lane west off Hanamikoji south of Shijo, 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_kaburaya.notes: [Obanzai izakaya · Gion off Hanamikoji, Kyoto vegetables] A renovated townhouse just off Hanamikoji serving obanzai and Kyoto dishes built on vegetables picked up from Kamigamo and Fushimi growers, with stock from an old Kyoto kombu and bonito wholesaler: Kamo-aubergine agedashi, hamo two ways, saikyo-grilled fish, kushikatsu. Reasonable for Gion — about ¥4,000–8,000. English menu; families welcome.

roles: Chef not named; operated by Groupe ZION, which also runs a live and party space (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s introduction: signature obanzai and Kyoto vegetables sourced through its own channels — heirloom and organic vegetables collected from growers in Kamigamo, Kamitoba and Fushimi — with brewery-direct soy sauce and miso, and kombu and katsuobushi from a long-established Kyoto wholesaler, served izakaya style. The operator’s site names Groupe ZION, running 祇園 蕪屋 and the live and party space SPACE ZION.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 family with a preschooler found a semi-private room — rare in Gion for small children.
An October 2026 guest came after a Kyo-mai dance performance at Gion Kobu for a seasonal two-tier starter.
An October 2026 diner ordered the grilled-octopus shabu over the obanzai and found it underwhelming.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園 蕪屋、日本料理・居酒屋、東山区祇園花見小路四条下ル一筋目西入ル南側、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、阪急河原町駅から徒歩8分、毎日 17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 料理21:00)、不定休、席は2時間 (コースは2時間半)、20分以上の遅刻はキャンセルの場合あり、本館のカウンターはL字、英語メニュー、席料440円 (ランチとコースは無し)、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可、80席、個室・半個室、分煙、インボイス T4130001046380。公式紹介: 名物のおばんざいと独自ルートの京野菜、上賀茂・上鳥羽・伏見の農家から京の伝統野菜や有機野菜を自ら引き取り、蔵元直送の天然醸造の醤油と味噌、京都の老舗問屋の昆布と鰹節、居酒屋スタイルの京料理、期間限定の京野菜のぶりしゃぶ。運営サイト (cabura.co.jp): Groupe ZION、ライブ&パーティースペース SPACE ZION・祇園 蕪屋。口コミ (2026年、英語): 加賀なす、鮎の塩焼き、鱧の湯引きとお造り、鰆の西京焼き、賀茂なすの揚げ出し、おばんざい3種、たこぶつ、焼きだこしゃぶ、霜降りのローストビーフ、土瓶蒸し、京風のソースの串カツ、鱧のコース、子ども連れでも。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing with online booking; reviews dated through October 2026.
